9b47cc563479589cfd68.title: Human Resources Generalist
9b47cc563479589cfd68.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

**\*\*Remote Position. Must reside within 1 hour of Marshfield, WI\*\***

The Human Resources Generalist serves as a key member of the Human Resources team, providing comprehensive support and guidance across all areas of human resources. This role independently manages and supports employee relations, recruitment and onboarding, performance management, training and development, benefits administration, and HR compliance and recordkeeping. Partners with managers and employees to interpret and apply HR policies and procedures, address workplace concerns, resolve employee relations matters, and promote consistent and effective HR practices. Exercises sound judgment and discretion in handling confidential and sensitive matters while supporting organizational objectives and fostering a positive, productive work environment.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

* Serves as a trusted HR resource and advisor to employees and managers by interpreting and applying HR policies, employment practices, and applicable employment laws. Provides guidance on employee relations, conflict resolution, coaching, and performance management. Investigates employee complaints and concerns, evaluates findings, and recommends appropriate resolutions and corrective actions.
* Partners with hiring managers to assess staffing needs and collaborates with the Recruiting Manager to develop recruitment strategies, evaluate candidates, and facilitate hiring activities. Provides guidance on talent acquisition practices and participates in workforce planning and recruitment initiatives.
* Coordinates and oversees new employee orientation and onboarding to support effective integration into the organization. Ensures required employment documentation, benefits enrollment, and initial training activities are completed and identifies opportunities to improve the onboarding experience.
* Advises managers on establishing performance expectations, setting goals, conducting performance evaluations, and addressing employee performance concerns. Provides recommendations regarding performance improvement plans, disciplinary actions, and employment terminations to promote consistency, accountability, and compliance with organizational policies and applicable employment laws.
* Oversees the accuracy and maintenance of HRIS data, personnel documentation, and required employment records in accordance with organizational policies and applicable requirements. Analyzes workforce data and prepares HR reports and metrics to support organizational planning, workforce decisions, and audits.
* Provides guidance to employees and managers regarding employee benefits, enrollment, and benefit changes. Supports benefits administration, leave management, unemployment claims, and related employment matters, ensuring processes are handled accurately and in accordance with applicable requirements.
* Oversees and performs the administration of Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) requests, including evaluating eligibility, coordinating required notices and documentation, monitoring leave usage, and communicating applicable requirements to employees and managers. Provides guidance and direction to the HR Coordinator regarding FMLA processes, reviews documentation and administrative practices for accuracy and compliance, and directly manages complex or escalated leave matters as appropriate.
* Identifies organizational and departmental training needs and coordinates the development, implementation, and delivery of employee and manager training programs. Provides guidance and resources to managers on employee development, performance coaching, and HR-related training requirements. Evaluates training effectiveness and recommends improvements.
* Monitors HR policies, procedures, and employment practices to promote consistent application across the organization. Identifies potential policy and compliance concerns, recommends revisions or corrective measures, and advises managers on appropriate policy interpretation and enforcement.
* Participates in the development, implementation, and evaluation of system-wide HR programs, initiatives, and special projects, including employee engagement, retention, workforce development, and process improvement efforts.
* Promotes a positive, productive, and inclusive work environment by identifying workplace concerns, evaluating employee feedback, and recommending opportunities to strengthen employee engagement and organizational effectiveness.
* Maintains regular and reliable attendance and adherence to established work schedules.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Associate's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field required; bachelor's degree preferred.
* Minimum of five years of progressively responsible human resources experience, with demonstrated experience across multiple HR functions, including recruitment, employee relations, performance management, benefits administration, and employment compliance.
* Demonstrated experience independently advising managers on employee relations matters, interpreting HR policies and employment practices, evaluating workplace concerns, and recommending appropriate courses of action required.
* Previous healthcare experience preferred; experience working in a remote or multi-site environment preferred.

**CERTIFICATIONS / LICENSES**

* Valid Wisconsin Driver’s License required with an acceptable motor vehicle record (MVR), per FHC guidelines.
* PHR or SHRM-CP certification is preferred

Equal Opportunity Employer

Responsibilities:

Under the supervision of the applicable manager, the In-Home Services Coordinator ensures the proper delivery of services to active PACE In Home Services Participants. Responsible for oversight and management of the In-Home Services schedule and any associated orders, Individualized Service Plans, and Care Plans. Accountability to compliance with contractual agreements and Participant care coverage.

This is a remote position.

**Essential Functions and Work Responsibilities**

**Functional Category:** Client Support Oversight

**Estimated Percent of time Spent:** 50%

* Serves as liaison between the client, family and/or caretaker(s) and InnovAge PACE In Home Services.
* Informs clients of other services offered by InnovAge PACE that may be of use to them, as appropriate.
* Ensures that all schedules meet the Plan of Care (PoC, applicable Provider orders, and are staffed with the appropriate qualified personnel.
* Notifies clients/caregivers and employees of changes in schedule in a timely and courteous manner and documents all changes and notifications to clients regarding their schedule.
* Responsible for the coordination of agency services with the services of other community agencies or PACE services.
* Observes confidentiality and safeguards all client related information.
* Investigates, resolves, and reports any problem related to client care and/or employee wellbeing to Manager.
* Responsible for immediately reporting to Manager any occurrences and/or complaints and collaboratively investigates and resolves the issue.
* Participates in the selection of workers to meet the standards for appropriate worker/client match.
* Participate in daily stand-ups to relay pertinent information in relation to clients and staff.
* Participates in On-Call rotation.
* Maintains up-to-date and ongoing client schedules including daily and/or ongoing I.H.S PCW/C.N. A/LPN/RN visits, assessments, and supervisory visits.
* Completes, daily, verification of scheduled shifts and visits to confirm completion of all tasks by field employees.
* Maintains open lines of communication with the field, centers, and I.H.S leadership regarding barriers, needs, and scheduling updates.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Functional Category:** Administration

**Estimated Percent of time Spent:** 50%

* Responsible for the maintenance and review of client records for compliance with Federal, State, and local laws, accrediting Organization Standards and company policies and guidelines.
* Responsible for software implementation based on standardized process.
* Utilizes the system to provide information and reporting as assigned and needed for compliance and operations oversight.
* Ensures manager is aware of any job performance concerns related to field personnel.
* Schedules field staff to provide service for care recipients who are enrolled with InnovAge PACE.
* Ensures that all schedules meet the Plan of Care (PoC), provider orders as applicable, and are staffed with the appropriate qualified personnel.
* Schedules care staff in the most effective and efficient manner that minimizes the expense of staff mileage and travel/overtime.
* Notifies clients/caregivers and employees of changes in schedule in a timely and courteous manner and documents all changes and notifications to clients regarding their schedule across all applicable electronic health records (E.H.R).
* Always uses discretion with agency and client information.
* Answers telephones and transfers appropriately.
* Accept intake/referral/inquiry calls as needed, providing positive company representation.
* Responsible for following company policies/procedures to ensure effective and efficient operations.
* Collaborates with other team members to obtain quality, census, and revenue goals.
* Responsible for completion of Standard Operating Procedures timely.
* Perform backup Manager duties as designated and assigned.
* Helps set the tone with field staff and colleagues to ensure morale, teamwork, and that the positive employment culture of the organization is maintained.
* Attends meetings as needed and assigned to assist with morning meetings, IDT meetings, mini team meetings, client & family meetings, and other meetings as assigned.
* Effectively directs field staff as related to scheduling and coordination through motivation and positive reinforcement.
* Builds rapport and relationship with field staff and colleagues to allow successful day to day I.H.S Operations

**Qualifications**

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**REQUIRED**

* High School Diploma or GED
* 2 years’ related administrative experience.

**PREFERRED**

* 2 years’ in the areas of gerontology and/or medical/social services.
* 1 year scheduling or logistics management experience.
* 1 year in the health care profession

*The pay offered for the position will take into consideration the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity, among other factors.* *InnovAge offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical, dental and vision insurance, short and long-term disability, life insurance and add, supplemental life insurance, flexible spending accounts, 401(k) savings, paid time off, and company paid holidays.*

b81f1b18be3f2eba8f8f.title: Benefits Coordinator
b81f1b18be3f2eba8f8f.description:
### **Job Description**

At K&L Gates, we are looking for smart, imaginative and hard-working people with diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas to join us. Perhaps our search for talented visionaries and your search for important and impactful work lead to the same place.

Position Summary

The Benefits Coordinator is a member of the HR Operations Team and serves as a primary front-line resource for partners and employees seeking day-to-day benefits and leave administration support. The role combines employee inquiry resolution and case ownership with transactional benefits administration, day-to-day leave case coordination, and recurring operational responsibilities. Using the firm’s intake and case-management system, the Benefits Coordinator receives, researches, documents, tracks, and resolves benefits and leave inquiries within the coordinator level of responsibility, while recognizing and escalating matters that require strategic Benefits leadership, leave expertise, policy or legal interpretation, vendor intervention, or support from another internal team.

The Benefits Coordinator delivers clear, accurate, professional, and empathetic service; helps employees navigate plan and leave information and available resources; maintains complete case documentation; and follows assigned matters through resolution. The role also supports benefit program administration, leave tracking and coordination, data accuracy, required notices, communications, compliance-related processes, and seasonal priorities such as Open Enrollment. Through close partnership with the Operations Team and strategic Benefits team, the coordinator helps improve processes, knowledge resources, and the overall employee benefits and leave experience.

Reporting/Organizational Relationship

* Reports to the Senior Manager, Global Benefits.
* Maintains a dotted-line reporting relationship to HR Operations Team management.
* Collaborates regularly with strategic Benefits leaders and specialists, HR colleagues, Payroll and HRIS partners, HR Business Partners, internal business teams, leave and disability administrators, and external benefits vendors.

Key Responsibilities

* Serve as a primary front-line resource for day-to-day benefits and leave questions received through the firm’s established intake channels, providing accurate, timely, professional, and empathetic support.
* Use the firm’s intake and case-management system, including Dovetail HR Case Management, to receive, categorize, research, document, track, manage, and close assigned benefits and leave inquiries; complete required system training; maintain complete case notes and an appropriate audit trail; use available reporting and analytics tools; and contribute to ongoing improvements in case-management practices.
* Research and resolve routine to moderately complex questions within established plans, policies, procedures, and coordinator-level authority, translating benefits and leave information into clear, employee-friendly language.
* Help employees navigate benefit programs, leave processes, documentation requirements, vendor resources, and self-service tools, encouraging effective self-service when appropriate.
* Maintain ownership of assigned matters through resolution or formal handoff, coordinating follow-up with employees, internal partners, and external vendors and handling sensitive situations with tact, discretion, composure, and sound judgment.
* Coordinate day-to-day employee leave administration in accordance with established policies, procedures, service expectations, confidentiality requirements, and management guidance.
* Open and maintain leave cases, including collecting and tracking documentation; monitoring dates, status changes, extensions, return-to-work activity, and outstanding actions; and maintaining accurate trackers, system records, correspondence, and case notes.
* Provide employees with standard information about leave processes, available benefits, required steps, documentation expectations, and appropriate vendor or internal contacts, without making policy exceptions or legal determinations.
* Coordinate routine leave communications, notifications, and administrative actions with employees, HR Business Partners, Payroll, HRIS, office administration, managers, and leave or disability vendors in accordance with established confidentiality and need-to-know protocols.
* Support approved leave status, benefits continuation, payroll-related information, return-to-work updates, and transitions between leave, disability, return to work, and other employment statuses by coordinating required administrative and system steps with the appropriate teams.
* Follow up with leave and disability vendors regarding claim status, missing documentation, benefit determinations, payments, administrative questions, and unresolved service issues, escalating complex, sensitive, accommodation-related, legal, employee-relations, pay-related, precedent-setting, or unresolved matters to the appropriate subject-matter owner.
* Exercise sound judgment to distinguish benefits and leave matters that can be resolved at the coordinator level from those requiring strategic Benefits leadership, specialist, HR Business Partner, Legal, Employee Relations, Payroll, vendor, or other internal-team involvement.
* Escalate matters appropriately with complete background and documentation, coordinate with relevant internal and external contacts, and keep employees informed of status, next steps, and required actions through resolution or formal handoff.
* Follow established procedures and remain within the role’s authority, avoiding independent interpretation of plan provisions, leave laws, medical information, or policy requirements and not making unauthorized exceptions.
* Perform benefits processes associated with onboarding and departures, including required benefits notices and follow-up, and assist with processing and validating approved benefits and leave-related changes in the firm’s HRIS and related systems.
* Provide administrative and transactional support for domestic and international benefits programs, including documentation, recurring processes, employee communications, data, enrollment, invoices, and vendor-related activities in accordance with established procedures.
* Audit HRIS and vendor reports and investigate routine eligibility, enrollment, leave, vendor, payroll, and data discrepancies to support accurate records and compliance with applicable plan and process requirements, escalating complex or unresolved issues as appropriate.
* Process benefits invoices and maintain organized records, trackers, supporting documentation, and standard operating procedures in accordance with established approval, payment, retention, and documentation requirements.
* Draft, review, coordinate, and track recurring employee communications and complete assigned compliance-related operational tasks and reconciliations, including ACA and HIPAA program support, under established procedures and management oversight.
* Provide operational support for assigned benefits, leave, and employee programs, which may include wellness initiatives, service awards, relocation administration, and other recurring programs retained within the Benefits Operations Team.
* Support Open Enrollment and other high-volume periods through employee inquiry resolution, case management, communications, data review, testing, coordination, and issue follow-up.
* Assist with projects, audits, implementations, and other department or cross-functional priorities, adjusting priorities and providing additional coverage during leave cycles, seasonal peaks, deadlines, team absences, and emerging service needs.
* Identify recurring questions, case trends, process gaps, and confusing plan or policy language and recommend practical improvements to communications, employee resources, procedures, case-management practices, and service delivery.
* Develop, maintain, and improve benefits and leave knowledge resources, standard responses, support documentation, procedures, and self-service content in collaboration with Operations and strategic Benefits leadership.
* Appropriately use technology, automation, AI-enabled tools, case analytics, and operational feedback to improve efficiency, accuracy, knowledge management, consistency, employee self-service, and the overall benefits and leave experience; share relevant insights with appropriate partners while protecting confidentiality and exercising sound judgment.

Qualifications

Required

* Benefits administration, leave administration, HR operations, HR shared services, or comparable employee service experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain benefits and leave process information clearly and in employee-friendly language.
* Demonstrated customer and service orientation, with the ability to respond professionally and empathetically in sensitive or stressful situations.
* Sound judgment and the ability to research questions, follow established guidance, recognize the limits of authority, and escalate appropriately.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate data, case notes, leave tracking, records, and follow-through.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle employee, medical, benefits, and leave information with discretion.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, inquiries, and active leave cases in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and responsiveness.
* Comfort learning and working across HRIS, benefits administration, leave or disability vendor, case-management, and Microsoft Office tools, including Excel.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn and adopt new technologies, including AI-enabled tools, to support service delivery, knowledge management, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.
* Ability and willingness to support seasonal workload peaks, including Open Enrollment.

Preferred

* Approximately 1-3 years of benefits administration, leave administration, HR support, employee service, or related experience.
* Working knowledge of health and welfare benefits, retirement programs, eligibility and enrollment processes, disability benefits, common leave processes, and common benefits compliance concepts.
* Experience coordinating employee leave cases, maintaining leave records, working with leave or disability vendors, or supporting return-to-work administration.
* Experience with PeopleSoft or another HRIS, a benefits administration platform, a leave-management platform, or an HR case-management system.
* Experience supporting benefits or leave communications, reconciliations, audits, vendor coordination, or Open Enrollment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Compensation Salary: $63,894 - $ 95,842 / year

The compensation salary for this position will be determined during the interview process and will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to prior experience, relevant expertise, current business needs, and market factors.

16aa33d96a36c1debb57.description:
**Case Closing Coordinator**
============================

**Location:** California (Remote / Work From Home)

**Schedule:** Monday-Friday | 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

**Join Lynx, a Subsidiary of U.S. Legal Support**
-------------------------------------------------

Lynx, a subsidiary of U.S. Legal Support, provides industry-leading legal support services to law firms, corporations, insurance carriers, property management companies, and government agencies nationwide. Our team is dedicated to delivering accurate, timely, and professional service while supporting clients through every stage of the legal process.

We're looking for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys reviewing documents, ensuring accuracy, and managing critical deadlines. If you thrive in a fast-paced remote environment and take pride in producing high-quality work, we'd love to hear from you.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a **Case Closing Coordinator**, you will play a critical role in the final stage of the legal support process by reviewing, finalizing, and closing cases to ensure accuracy, compliance, and client satisfaction.

This position requires strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to understand and manage legal documentation, including affidavits of service, returns of service, invoices, and supporting case materials. The ideal candidate is highly organized, process-driven, and committed to maintaining the highest quality standards while working independently in a remote environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Case Review & Quality Assurance**

* Review completed jobs for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with client and legal requirements.
* Verify case information, including parties, addresses, service details, and supporting documentation.
* Perform thorough quality control reviews before documents are submitted to clients or courts.
* Ensure all files meet company standards and client expectations.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies prior to case closure.

### **Documentation & Case Closing**

* Generate affidavits of service and returns of service in accordance with jurisdictional requirements and client specifications.
* Ensure all closing documentation is properly formatted, completed, signed, notarized, and filed when required.
* Review service-related documents for accuracy and completeness.
* Maintain organized records and supporting documentation throughout the closing process.
* Finalize and close cases within established timelines.

### **Billing & Compliance Review**

* Review invoices to ensure all services performed are accurately reflected and billed appropriately.
* Verify supporting documentation aligns with billed services.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, legal requirements, and client-specific guidelines.
* Assist in maintaining accurate records and audit trails.

### **Communication & Operational Support**

* Communicate with process servers, clients, and internal teams to clarify missing information or resolve discrepancies.
* Follow up on outstanding documentation and incomplete files.
* Assist with monthly eviction notice entry and processing.
* Support operational workflow initiatives and departmental projects as needed.
* Identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve processes and quality.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Ability to interpret and review legal documentation.
* Professionalism when handling sensitive and confidential information.
* Collaborative approach and willingness to support team objectives.
* Self-motivation and accountability while working remotely.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Experience in administrative support, legal support, records management, document review, process serving, or related operational roles.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work effectively in a deadline-driven environment.
* Strong organizational, communication, and multitasking skills.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in legal services, process serving, litigation support, or related industries.
* Familiarity with affidavits of service, returns of service, court documentation, or legal filings.
* Experience performing quality assurance, compliance review, or document review functions.
* Experience working in a remote environment.
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

**Why Join Lynx?**
------------------

At Lynx, you'll be part of a team dedicated to delivering accurate, timely, and exceptional legal support services. We offer opportunities for professional development, career growth, and meaningful contributions within a collaborative and supportive work environment.

**Benefits**
------------

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Professional Development and Career Growth Opportunities
* Remote Work Flexibility
* Collaborative and Team-Oriented Work Environment

**Our Culture**
---------------

At Lynx and U.S. Legal Support, our people are our greatest asset. We foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and service excellence. We value employees who take ownership of their work, support one another, and are committed to delivering exceptional results for our clients.

As a Case Closing Coordinator, you'll play a vital role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the final work product our clients depend on.

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

* Prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer.
* Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing and data entry.
* Ability to review detailed legal documents with a high degree of accuracy.
* Ability to communicate effectively via phone, email, video conferencing, and messaging platforms.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

This position is fully remote and operates from a home office environment within California. Employees routinely use computers, phones, scanners, printers, and other technology to support daily operations and document management activities.

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

No regular travel is required for this position.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as business needs change.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
--------------------------------

Lynx and U.S. Legal Support are Equal Opportunity Employers and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

**Work Authorization**
----------------------

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. U.S. Legal Support participates in E-Verify where required by law.

d1e2cffd6db5532a35ae.description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

  

**Job Introduction**
--------------------

The OEM Partnership team is expanding its engagement with automotive OEM clients and large dealer groups. As the volume and complexity of partnership opportunities grow, there is a critical need for a dedicated operations professional who can manage, track, and organize complex data sets, pipeline activity, and cross-functional deliverables. This role will serve as the operational backbone of the OEM Partnership team, ensuring that all client-facing activities are supported by accurate data, streamlined processes, and well-prepared materials. Without this role, the team risks losing visibility into key opportunities, experiencing delays in reporting, and being unable to scale efficiently. This position directly supports Tekion's strategic growth objectives within the OEM channel.

  
  

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

* Manage and maintain OEM partnership pipeline data within Salesforce, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely updates across all stages of the opportunity lifecycle.
* Track, organize, and analyze complex data sets related to OEM partner engagements, dealer group activity, and market opportunities to provide actionable insights to leadership.
* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and tracking tools in Salesforce and Excel to monitor key performance indicators, deal progress, and team activity.
* Prepare high-quality PowerPoint presentations, executive summaries, and briefing materials for OEM client meetings, quarterly business reviews, and internal leadership updates.
* Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure alignment on OEM partnership initiatives and deliverables.
* Support the SVP of OEM Partnership with meeting preparation, follow-up action tracking, and operational cadence management.
* Identify process gaps and proactively recommend improvements to enhance team efficiency, data quality, and reporting capabilities.
* Serve as a key point of contact for operational inquiries from OEM clients and large dealer groups, maintaining a professional and knowledgeable presence.
* Assist in the coordination of limited travel engagements (less than 20%) for OEM client visits, industry events, and dealer group meetings.
* Maintain organized records of all partnership agreements, communications, and key milestones.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in an operations, sales operations, or business operations role within the automotive industry.
* Strong automotive industry knowledge, including familiarity with OEM structures, dealer networks, and franchise operations.
* Exceptional attention to detail with a proven ability to manage, track, and organize large and complex data sets.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data modeling, complex formulas) and Microsoft PowerPoint (executive-level presentation design).
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM, including pipeline management, report building, and dashboard creation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with automotive OEM clients and senior executives.
* Self-starter mentality — seeks guidance and direction on objectives but independently determines the best path to execution without needing step-by-step instruction.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Automotive Management, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Willingness to travel up to 20% as needed for client meetings, industry events, and dealer group engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Direct OEM experience working within or alongside an automotive manufacturer's partnership, sales, or dealer operations team.
* Experience working with large dealer groups (e.g., AutoNation, Lithia, Penske, Hendrick, Larry H. Miller) and understanding their operational dynamics.
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) in addition to Excel.
* Familiarity with SaaS or technology platforms serving the automotive retail industry.
* Project management experience or certification (PMP, Six Sigma, or equivalent) is a plus.

**Perks & Benefits**
--------------------

* Competitive compensation and generous stock options
* 100% employer-paid top-of-the-line medical, dental and vision coverage
* Great benefits including unlimited PTO, parental leave and free snacks and beverages
* The opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley’s most dominant and successful companies
* Be part of an early stage, hyper-growth start-up with the opportunity to grow and prosper
* Work on the latest and coolest technologies – everything is home-grown and built ground-up
* A dynamic work environment with a strong sense of community and collaboration
* The open and transparent culture that encourages innovation, rewards performance and discourages hierarchy
* Exciting opportunities for career growth and development

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

**About the team**
------------------

The Senior Specialist, Account Services supports Zillow’s account-focused teams by managing moderately complex operational workflows, resolving issues, and coordinating with cross-functional partners to deliver a consistent, high-quality experience for customers and internal stakeholders. This role uses data, standardized processes, and strong communication skills to ensure account activities are executed accurately, risks are identified early, and opportunities to improve service and efficiency are surfaced and implemented.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Client Experience Specialist on the New Construction team, you will onboard and educate home builders on how to get the most from Zillow's New Construction products. You will partner with sales to set new advertisers up for success, manage a team book of business, and resolve issues that come up after launch. If you are detail-oriented and self-driven and want to build a career with the nation's largest real estate network, this role is for you.

**You Will Get To:**
--------------------

* Onboard new home builder clients and guide them through the full launch process
* Resolve issues that arise after launch
* Educate clients on capturing high-quality content for their New Construction listings
* Partner with sales to set new advertisers up for success by accurately explaining how listings and display products work
* Manage a team book of business across the New Construction advertising lifecycle, including self-serve and small-to-medium business partners through a shared case queue
* Build deep knowledge of New Construction products, features, and CES internal workflows
* Use sound judgment to solve complex customer and internal problems
* Communicate openly with customers and teammates across departments

U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $35.60 - $56.80 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**

* You take ownership of your work and deliver accurately, with strong attention to detail, in a fast-changing environment.

* Experience in online advertising sales is a plus.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

efd4a5b444cc6de8241d.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Operations Support, Specialist serves as a primary for shipping and receiving operations, combining daily material-handling responsibilities with team guidance, training, safety oversight, audit readiness, and operational problem-solving. The role is the first point of escalation for receiving discrepancies, errors, system roadblocks, and internal or external inquiries, and partners with the supervisor when additional support or resolution is required.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Hands-on receiving operations:** Spend a significant portion of the shift, often up to 50%, actively receiving materials, unloading trailers, and operating approved material-handling equipment.

* Demonstrated ability to train employees, coordinate daily work, solve operational problems, and communicate effectively with internal and external partners.

368144ed9992a29a4b68.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

**General Description:**

The Associate Director, Strategy & Operations will report to the Chief of Staff to the North America General Manager and serve as a strategic partner to the North America leadership team, helping advance the organization’s highest-priority business initiatives.

This role will combine strategy and business problem-solving with disciplined program management. The individual will work across functions to frame complex business challenges, develop actionable strategies, translate strategic priorities into execution, and drive high-impact initiatives from concept through implementation. The role will establish clear plans, milestones, timelines, budgets, and accountability while synthesizing insights and data into recommendations that accelerate decision-making and business performance.

The ideal candidate brings experience in management consulting, strategy, business transformation, program management, or a similar internal strategy and operations role within pharmaceuticals or biotechnology. This individual should be equally comfortable developing an executive-level recommendation, facilitating a leadership working session, and rolling up their sleeves to ensure an initiative is delivered successfully.

The role will also contribute to emerging North America capabilities, including digital transformation, omnichannel execution, and AI-enabled ways of working.

**Essential Functions of the job:**

  

* Drive the development and execution of key cross-functional commercial and medical projects across North America, establishing clear project plans, milestones, timelines, and accountability frameworks to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery aligned with the priorities of the North America General Manager and Chief of Staff.
* Partner with the North America GM Office and functional leaders to identify, structure, and address critical strategic and operational business challenges.
* Develop strategic frameworks, business cases, executive recommendations, and roadmaps to support leadership decision-making.
* Translate North America strategic priorities into clear initiatives, workstreams, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives from strategy development through implementation, ensuring alignment, accountability, and execution.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across North America, including Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and Corporate Affairs, to align projects with organizational goals, maintain momentum, and ensure delivery within scope and budget.
* Identify interdependencies, barriers, and emerging risks across initiatives and work with stakeholders to develop solutions; monitor business impact and recommend adjustments as priorities or market conditions evolve.
* Serve as a thought partner to the Chief of Staff, GM Office, and North America leaders on priority business topics.
* Design and facilitate strategic working sessions that enable leadership teams to solve problems, align around decisions, and accelerate action.
* Develop clear, concise executive-level presentations and communications that synthesize complex business issues and recommendations.
* Champion AI enablement across North America commercial and medical functions, identifying and implementing AI-powered tools and workflows that improve productivity, decision-making, and customer engagement, and partnering with relevant teams to scale
* adoption.
* Support digital initiatives, including digital channel strategy, omnichannel execution, and emerging promotional technologies to advance the North America commercial and medical agenda.
* Identify opportunities to improve how the North America organization operates, including new processes, capabilities, and ways of working.
* Help foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and disciplined execution.

**Education Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, life sciences, economics, finance, marketing, or a related discipline; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

**Required Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree with 8+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business transformation, commercial strategy, program management, or a comparable strategy and operations role strongly preferred.
* Pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience required, either directly or through consulting engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, conduct analyses, generate insights, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Demonstrated track record leading complex cross-functional initiatives and managing project plans, milestones, timelines, budgets, dependencies, and risks in a highly matrixed organization.
* Strong strategic thinking coupled with the ability to move from strategy to execution.
* Strong executive communication and presentation capabilities, including the ability to synthesize complex issues into concise recommendations for senior leaders.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working with qualitative and quantitative information to support decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and build alignment among diverse stakeholders.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a high level of initiative and comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Experience with digital transformation, omnichannel initiatives, and/or AI-enabled business initiatives preferred.

d8aa841514b9c0b6782f.description:
**Documentation Coordinator**

**Location:** Remote  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Company:** HMS

**Position Summary**

HMS is seeking a detail-oriented **Documentation Coordinator** to support a healthcare quality review and validation project. This fully remote position is responsible for the intake, review, preparation, and organization of medical record documentation used by a team of clinical reviewers.

The Documentation Coordinator will help ensure records are complete, properly organized, and ready for review; coordinate the assignment of cases to reviewers; track documentation through the review process; and assist with project Help Desk inquiries. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with sensitive healthcare information, and able to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Receive and process medical records and supporting documentation submitted for review.
* Conduct an initial review of records to confirm completeness and identify missing or incomplete documentation.
* Prepare, organize, and redact documentation as needed before records are assigned for review.
* Maintain accurate tracking of records throughout the intake and review process.
* Assign cases to project reviewers based on established procedures, workload, and project requirements.
* Monitor case assignments and help ensure records move through the review process within established timelines.
* Assist with responding to project Help Desk inquiries related to record submission, documentation requirements, review status, and other routine questions.
* Escalate incomplete records, unusual submissions, or other issues to appropriate project staff.
* Maintain the confidentiality and security of medical records and other sensitive information.
* Follow established project procedures, documentation standards, and quality control requirements.
* Support other administrative and documentation activities associated with the project, as needed.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Experience working with medical records, healthcare documentation, document management, or healthcare administrative processes preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent documentation.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple records, assignments, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.
* Strong written communication and customer service skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting healthcare quality review, medical record review, validation, or audit activities.
* Familiarity with HIPAA and appropriate handling of protected health information (PHI).
* Experience supporting a Help Desk, shared mailbox, or similar customer inquiry function.

Points of Collaboration

* Oversee companion app management for relevant brands: content update coordination, user experience issue tracking, and vendor communication for fixes and releases
* Monitor refill coordination program performance for relevant brands: ensuring vendor-managed outreach is meeting refill timing targets and SLAs
* Monitor adherence metrics for relevant brands daily and weekly: refill rates, reminder response rates, program enrollment, persistence trends, and drop-off indicators

3b3ad6af9b9604da5d29.description:
**Job Description**

At WSFS Bank, we empower our Associates to grow their careers, guide our customers to secure their financial futures, and actively support our Communities so they can fully thrive. Careers with WSFS Bank offer an inclusive and supportive culture, competitive salaries, advancement opportunities, and more. We are the region's locally headquartered bank and wealth management company. We are honored to consistently be named a Top Workplace by our Associates, who make a difference every day for the people, businesses, and Communities we serve. We Stand For Service® is more than part of our name, it’s our mission and our purpose.

The Facilities Maintenance Specialist is responsible for performing a wide range of maintenance, repair, inspection, and facility support services to ensure the safe, efficient, and professional operation of company-owned and leased facilities. This position will be primarily stationed at a designated home location but must maintain the flexibility and availability to travel between facilities as needed to support operational requirements, preventive maintenance programs, special projects, emergencies, and coverage needs. The incumbent will perform routine and corrective maintenance activities, coordinate with vendors and contractors, and provide exceptional customer service while maintaining a safe and productive workplace environment.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Perform routine maintenance, repair, and troubleshooting of building systems, fixtures, furniture, and equipment.
* Complete work orders related to plumbing, electrical, HVAC, carpentry, lighting, painting, and general building maintenance.
* Conduct preventative maintenance inspections and activities in accordance with established schedules and procedures.
* Perform facility walkthroughs to identify maintenance, safety, housekeeping, operational, and appearance-related issues requiring attention.
* Respond promptly to maintenance requests and service calls while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Perform light plumbing repairs including faucet, toilet, sink, and fixture maintenance.
* Conduct minor electrical repairs including replacement of light fixtures, lamps, ballasts, switches, outlets, and related components.
* Perform carpentry and repair work including door adjustments, hardware replacement, furniture repairs, and minor construction activities.
* Coordinate and escort contractors, vendors, and service providers while ensuring compliance with company policies and site requirements.
* Assist with building inspections, site assessments, and facility condition evaluations.
* Support office moves, reconfigurations, furniture installations, workstation adjustments, and space planning projects.
* Perform day porter services as needed, including conference room setups, stocking common areas, workplace appearance inspections, and response to routine facility requests.
* Monitor facility systems and equipment and report deficiencies or recommended improvements to management.
* Assist with emergency response activities and participate in business continuity and facility recovery efforts when required.
* Support safety initiatives by identifying potential hazards and ensuring corrective actions are completed in a timely manner.
* Maintain maintenance records, inspection documentation, work order updates, and inventory records accurately and timely.
* Monitor inventory levels of maintenance supplies, tools, and equipment and submit replenishment requests as needed.
* Travel between company facilities to provide maintenance support, project assistance, emergency response, and operational coverage.
* Maintain company-issued tools, equipment, and vehicles in a safe and professional manner.
* Support Facilities Management with special projects, workplace improvements, and other assignments as directed.
* Maintain flexibility to support maintenance operations, facility services, day porter functions, mail services activities including sorting, distributing, collecting, processing, and delivering incoming and outgoing mail, packages, accountable items, interoffice correspondence, and courier shipments, as well as other operational priorities based on business needs.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Technical, vocational, or trade school training in facilities maintenance, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, or related field preferred.
* Minimum of three (3) years of commercial building maintenance, facilities maintenance, property operations, or related experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of basic electrical, plumbing, HVAC, mechanical, and building maintenance practices.
* Experience utilizing computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) or work order management software preferred.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Ability to safely operate maintenance tools, equipment, ladders, and related devices.
* Must be willing and able to travel regularly between company facilities within the assigned geographic region.
* Must maintain reliable transportation and the flexibility to adjust work locations based on operational needs, staffing requirements, emergency situations, and special projects.

32ec8d55d0b7a1cfd1e4.description:
Overview:

The Events and Outreach Coordinator is an integral team member who provides high level administrative support to the Chair and Department Manager, ensuring the smooth daily operations of the office. In this crucial role, the incumbent will play a pivotal part in facilitating and enhancing office efficiency and supporting the broader team's work. Their responsibilities encompass maintaining a strong sense of integrity and financial stewardship, offering departmental support, acting as the seminar coordinator and faculty recruiting coordinator, an administrator for NSF REU programs that come into the department, and the coordinator for the Princeton Catalysis Initiative.

The Events and Outreach Coordinator will independently coordinate all research seminars; oversee billing and membership activities for the department's corporate affiliates program; maintain departmental directories and distribution lists; create content for the department's website; provide administrative and grants support for an NSF REU program and the Princeton Catalysis Initiative, be the primary point of contact for administrative planning and financial coordination of faculty recruiting efforts within the department.

Some night and weekend work required to support events.

Responsibilities:

Faculty Recruiting and Reappointments: Plans on-site visits for junior and senior candidates, managing a roster of ten to twenty individuals from December to May. Processes reimbursements for candidates following the visits. Assists the Chair's assistant with planning for senior faculty and second junior faculty visits. Maintains meticulous financial records for end-of-year reconciliations.

Seminar Planning: Independently coordinates all logistics and provides on-site management for departmental seminars (3-5 per week). Arranges travel and lodging for speakers, books conference rooms and auditorium, prepares and distributes seminar announcement email messages. Coordinates speaker schedule with multiple faculty meetings and meal arrangements with students, postdocs, and faculty. Sets up presentation technology/AV equipment. Updates departmental web page with seminar announcements on a weekly basis, using WordPress. Processes speakers' business travel reimbursements. Plans 5-10 yearly larger symposiums for guests including seminar, reception, and faculty dinner. To review the current roster of seminars, please visit the current events schedule at https://chemistry.princeton.edu/department/seminars-events.

Princeton Catalysis Initiative Support: Assists the Director with compiling application materials for annual grant cycle. Oversees website development, including content and details of affiliated people e.g., adding people, updating titles or contact information, etc. Adds news stories or PCI-supported publication announcements. Publishes calls for proposals and annual symposium materials, including pre-symposium announcements - listing speakers, and post-symposium stories documenting the symposium. Handles all logistical planning for the annual PCI Symposium. Responsible for guest travel and lodging arrangements, meals, AV set-up, developing printed materials, and processing for a multi-day symposium with external attendees. Trains student hosts for the event and provides day-of on-site event management. Upon the completion of the symposium, receives, compiles, organizes, and disseminates all proposals to the faculty review committee. Visit https://pci.princeton.edu/ to learn more about the Princeton Catalysis Initiative.

NSF REU Administrative Support: Supports faculty with pre and post award responsibilities for NSF Research Experience for Undergraduates Program. Administers the application website and maintains student records. Handles financial onboarding and payments for participants, as well as all payments for expenses related to the program. Compiles data related to students’ educational and career outcomes, and advancement per NSF guidelines. Ensures that programming and logistics follow University guidelines for undergraduate summer programs. Completes NSF annual report for review by faculty and helps to prepare renewal applications. Assists student services team with other summer programming responsibilities as needed.

Industrial Associates Program: Manages the administrative aspects of the Industrial Associates Program. Keeps track of membership rates and processes annual invoices. Deposits payments from members. Maintains a shared spreadsheet with membership information relevant to the department's business office. Administers membership benefits, including library access and course registrations. Information about the Industrial Associates Program can be found at https://chemistry.princeton.edu/research-facilites/industrial-associates-program.

Departmental Event Planning and Community Management: Organize all departmental events commissioned by the Chair, including but not limited to holiday dinners and luncheons, faculty colloquia, alumni receptions, and other ad hoc events. Assists the Administrative Services Manager and Manager for Educational Programs, Outreach, and Events with community-building events for postdocs and graduate students. With the department manager and Chair's assistant, plans logistics for faculty and staff meetings, including scheduling, room bookings, and food ordering. Maintains and updates all department directories and email distribution lists (for over 400 people).

Support undergraduate course exam prep including making and supervising exam copying for large service courses.

Assists with other departmental responsibilities as needed.

  
Qualifications:

* Required qualifications include:
  + Associates or other 2-year degree
  + 1-3 years of relevant experience
  + Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, flexibility, and the ability to multi-task
  + Excellent and professional verbal and written communication skills
  + Exceptional diplomatic skills, and the ability to remain calm under pressure
  + Attention to detail, accuracy and the ability to set priorities are critical
  + Proficiency with Microsoft Suite is required, including experience and proficiency in the use of functions in Excel
  + Understanding of budgets and financial statements
* Preferred qualifications include
  + Experience and competence in maintenance/updating of content management systems (CMS) such as Wordpress
  + Basic proficiency in image and photo editing software
  + Familiarity with Princeton University business applications, helpful (Concur, PeopleSoft, etc.)

Princeton University is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The posted salary range represents the University's good faith and reasonable estimate for a full-time position; salaries for part-time positions are pro-rated accordingly.

If the salary range on the posted position shows an hourly rate, this is the baseline; the actual hourly rate may be higher, depending on the position and factors listed above.
