Customer Service Representative (CSR II)
  
  
**Summary of Position:**  
The Customer Service Representative II (CSR II) is responsible for fielding customer inquiries regarding release of information (ROI) requests for patient medical records while maintaining consistent service standards and metrics. The CSR II provides issue resolution, status updates concerning medical record requests, and posts corrective action notes in the corporate database to facilitate timely and accurate release of information processing.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities:**  

* Ability to support customer service calls for multiple lines of business
* Proficient in the use of Department resources (CS Notebook, Protocols, VRM etc.)
* Receive inbound phone inquiries from requester clients regarding patient medical records (8 - 10 calls per hour)
* Manage customer concerns and questions regarding status of requests, invoice/fee issues, request remediation, etc.
* Actively document call details in VRM and RingCentral during call handling to ensure timely call resolution (ACW >40 seconds)
* Respond to all calls in a professional manner consistent with identified standards and metrics (QA Score of >93)
* Manage requests queues for client support made via voicemail and/or email (20 per hour)
* Serve as a training buddy for new hires
* Ability to data enter request
* Maintain positive relationships with customers and ROI requestors (attorneys, insurance companies, state disability
* offices, record copy services, peer organizations, doctor’s offices, patients, and others) including internal customers
* Maintain strong knowledge of HIPAA, HITECH, state/federal rulings, and statutes, as well as customer specific requirements
* Adhere to schedule for Breaks/Lunches, minimize time in “unavailable and consistently achieve a “Working Rate” of >85%
* Ensure that queued calls are answered timely (Call refusal average of >1 per day)
* Limit unscheduled absences (no more than 5 unscheduled absences in a 12-month period)
* Live by and promote Verisma Core Values
* Performs other duties as assigned to meet the needs of the department and the Company

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* HS Diploma or equivalent, some college preferred
* 3+ years of customer service experience, or consistently exceed expectations in the duties described above for a period of >1 year.
* 1 year of experience in a healthcare setting, preferred
* Knowledge of HIPAA and state regulations related to the release of Protected Health Information, preferred
* Strong verbal communication skills.
* Flexibility, strong problem-solving skills.
* Computer knowledge, including accurate keyboarding skills required.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong level of patience to resolve customer concerns
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and capacity to build effective relationships with co-workers and customers.
* Ability to work effectively and independently in high volume & fast-paced environments.

**CalOptima**

  
  
**Join Us in this Amazing Opportunity**  
  
**The Team You'll Join**  
  
We are a mission driven community-based organization that serves member health with excellence and dignity, respecting the value and needs of each person. This position has been approved to be **Full Office**.  
  
  

* *If telework is approved, you are required to work within the State of California only and if Partial Telework, also come in to the Main Office in Orange, CA, at least two (2) days per week minimum.*

  
  
The Customer Service Representative (CSR) will be the first line of contact for CalOptima Health's members and providers. You will assist members and providers with questions and/or complaints related to the Medi-Cal programs for Orange County. You will provide information regarding eligibility, enrollment, benefits and services to CalOptima Health's eligible members and providers. Together, we are building a stronger, more equitable health system.

  + Assists the team in carrying out department responsibilities and collaborates with others to support short and long-term goals/priorities for the department.
  + Addresses member and provider inquiries, questions and concerns in all areas including eligibility, enrollment, claims or authorization status, benefit interpretation and referrals/authorizations for medical care in-person or telephonically.
  + Enters accurate and complete documentation into internal application systems regarding all concerns and/or inquiries from the member and provider interaction.
  + Communicates, builds and maintains internal and external relationships by prompt and accurate service delivery.
  Identifies and communicates challenges that might arise with the use of professional judgment while adhering to departmental policies and procedures.
5% - Other-
Completes other projects and duties as assigned.

* 6 months of Medi-Cal/Medicaid or health services experience.

From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

Your insurance knowledge can make a complicated question feel simple and a challenging situation feel more manageable. As a Customer Service Representative, you’ll connect with customers, listen to their needs, answer policy questions, and help find solutions that support a positive experience. You’ll bring together your insurance knowledge, communication skills, and customer-first mindset to build trust and create meaningful connections. If you enjoy solving problems, helping people, and turning conversations into positive outcomes, this role gives you the opportunity to make a difference for customers every day.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Inputs and tracks into the appropriate databases.
* Remain current on new marketing campaigns in order to respond appropriately to marketing related inquiries using all available resource tool.
* Be able to handle any requests regarding customer documentation (to include all documents sent out by our company) and be able to clearly explain them including any follow-ups required on our customer’s part and updates as warranted
* Working knowledge of insurance policies and related processes and procedures.
* Demonstrates accuracy in processing changes to customer policies based on the information provided and identifies opportunities for cross sales (if applicable).

* Ensure facilitation of first call resolution and customer satisfaction on all transactions handled.
* Resolve routine, complex, and unique questions/issues.

Consumer Protection, Customer Data Management, Performance Management (PM), Relationship Building, Stakeholder Relationship Management

eaa89bee3a402c5ca33d.title: Customer Service Representative
eaa89bee3a402c5ca33d.description:
You’re not just answering questions. You’re changing lives, one conversation at a time.
  
  
In this role, you become the steady, reassuring voice people trust when they’re navigating their health journey. You listen deeply. You guide thoughtfully. You help turn uncertainty into clarity and confusion into confidence.
  
  
Every call, chat, or message is a chance to make a real difference. You’ll educate, encourage, and empower people to take meaningful steps toward better nutrition, smarter lifestyle choices, and long-term wellness. You won’t just solve problems—you’ll help people move forward.
  
  
There’s something powerful about knowing your words matter. About seeing someone feel heard, supported, and capable again. That’s the impact you’ll create every day.
  
  
This is your chance to help set a new standard for compassionate, human-centered customer care in the wellness space.
  
  
If you love helping others thrive—and take pride in doing it with heart and excellence—this is your moment.
  
  
ROLE SNAPSHOT
  
  

* Pay: $18.50 per hour
* Location/Schedule: On-site or Remote, Full-Time
* Purpose: Support customers in achieving their health and wellness goals through education, guidance, and exceptional service.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

* Answer product and service questions across phone, chat, email, mail, and video channels.
* Educate customers on healthy lifestyle practices including nutrition, exercise, and stress management.
* Provide encouragement and practical strategies to support sustainable lifestyle change.
* Collaborate with Senior Health Coaches and direct customers for advanced guidance when appropriate.
* Place orders and maintain accurate customer records in CRM systems.
* Resolve complaints efficiently, ensuring full resolution and follow-up.
* Meet sales goals through thoughtful product recommendations and cross-selling.
* Document interactions and communicate issues to supervisors or management as needed.

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2+ years customer service experience.
* 2+ years supporting individuals in healthy lifestyle management (nutrition, exercise, wellness).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and solve problems effectively.
* Proficiency with CRM or customer service software.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Experience using health tracking or telehealth platforms.
* Demonstrated motivational or counseling experience.

WHAT WE OFFER
  
  

* Mission-driven work focused on empowering healthier lives.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.
* Opportunities to grow within a wellness-centered organization.

Honest Challenge
  
This role requires balancing empathy with efficiency. You’ll handle high volumes of interactions while staying patient, focused, and detail-oriented throughout your shift.
  
  
**PLEASE NOTE:** While we appreciate candidates who reach out directly, given the volume, we are unable to respond to each inquiry individually.
  
  
The pay for this position is $18.50 per hour. Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws.
  
  
This position is benefits-eligible. Mercola provides competitive, affordable, and diverse benefit programs that support your total health – from a healthy body to a healthy mind. These benefits support you and your family in all aspects of life:
  
  

* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* Optional Accident, Hospital Indemnity, and Critical Illness
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Employer-paid Life and AD&D Insurance
* Optional Supplemental Life and AD&D Insurance
* Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Health Savings Accounts
* Dayforce Wallet – get paid as you earn
* Employee Discount
* Retirement Planning (401k with matching contribution)
* Pet Insurance
* Wellness Program Offerings
* Paid Time Off, accrued per pay period based on years of service, starting at 10 days annually.
* 9 Paid Holidays per year, including 1 floating holiday.

The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.
  
  
The Company expects to accept applications for this position until November 17, 2026, but encourages interested applicants to apply as soon as possible. We will review this information, and one of our Talent Acquisition professionals will reach out if your background aligns with the position.
  
  
Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity and Inclusion
  
  
Mercola and its affiliates (“Mercola”) are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race (including hairstyle and texture), color, religion or belief (or lack thereof) (including religious grooming and dress practices), sex, nationality, national or ethnic origin, civil status, age, citizenship status, sexual orientation, disability, genetic information, familial status, marital or registered civil partnership status, pregnancy or parental status, gender identity, gender reassignment, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. If you need accommodation, please send an email to hr@mercola.com to let us know the nature of your request.
  
  
Avoid Recruitment Scams
  
  
Mercola has become aware of fraudulent recruiting activities being conducted by individuals falsely claiming to represent our company using email addresses associated with the @mercolacareers.com domain.
  
  
Please be advised that Mercola will never ask job applicants to pay fees, purchase equipment, provide banking information, or send money at any stage of the recruiting or hiring process.
  
  
All legitimate employment opportunities are posted exclusively on our official Careers page, and all recruitment-related email communications from Mercola will come only from authorized company email addresses ending in @mercola.com.
  
  
If you receive a suspicious email, text message, or other communication claiming to be from Mercola, particularly one using the @mercolacareers.com domain, we encourage you not to respond, click any links, or provide any personal or financial information. If you believe you have been targeted by a recruiting scam, please report the incident to your local law enforcement authorities and, if appropriate, to the platform where the communication originated.

**Make an Impact Through Meaningful Work (and Actually Enjoy Where You Work)**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At Disabled Veteran Solutions (DVS), we're not just answering calls-we're helping people access critical government-based programs in security, healthhuman services, and state benefits. Every conversation matters, and the support you provide can genuinely change someone's day.

We're looking for dedicated, professional, and people-first Inbound Customer Service Representatives who want meaningful work, a strong remote culture, and a team that actually has each other's backs.

This is a **fully remote role**, so you can do your best work from the comfort of your own space-no commute, no office distractions, just a focused environment where you can thrive.

------------

* **Training Schedule:** 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM EST

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

You'll be the first point of contact for individuals who rely on essential services. Your role is to bring clarity, calm, and solutions-every single day.

Responsibilities include:

* Answering inbound calls and delivering a positive, solution-focused customer experience
* Assisting with basic technical troubleshooting and creating support tickets when needed
* Scheduling appointments at designated service locations
* Accurately documenting all customer interactions, including inquiries, concerns, and resolutions
* Conducting follow-up calls to ensure issues are resolved and customers stay informed
* Providing consistent, high-quality service in a structured, supportive environment

--------------------------

We want people who are dependable, thoughtful, and comfortable working independently while staying connected to a remote team.

Required qualifications:

* High school diploma or GED required (additional education preferred)
* Prior remote customer service experience, especially in call-based environments
* Strong verbal communication skills and ability to quickly build rapport
* Ability to troubleshoot basic technical issues independently
* Comfort working remotely with minimal supervision
* Ability to read and follow directions completely
* Ability to complete an extensive credentialing and background check process
* In Depth understanding of web navigation, computer applications, multitasking (Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Word)
* Must be able to read, understand and speak English fluently

Preferred:

* Bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates are strongly encouraged to apply

**TechnicalWork Environment Requirements**
------------------------------------------

To set you up for success at home:

* Reliable high-speed internet connection (must be on ethernet connection, no wi-fi)
* Private, distraction-free workspace
* Ability to navigate computer systems efficiently

**Schedule**
------------

* Regular schedule: **Between 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM, Monday–Friday**
* You will be provided a full-time schedule, 8-hour workday within the available window
* Consistent attendance and reliability are essential for success in this role
* Schedules are structured to support both business needs and work-life balance

**Why Join DVS?**
-----------------

Disabled Veteran Solutions is a nationally recognized leader in business process outsourcing and a certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB).

But beyond the credentials, here's what makes DVS different:

* A fully remote role-work where you're most comfortable and productive

* Real opportunities for career advancement

At DVS, you're not just filling a role-you're joining a mission-driven team that takes pride in doing things the right way, together.

**Ready to Join Us?**
---------------------

If you're looking for a remote role where your work matters, your team supports you, and your effort is valued every day-we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and build a career with purpose at DVS.

fb0e11e58fef6bdfb4b0.title: Manager, Commercial Field Support
fb0e11e58fef6bdfb4b0.description:
**Career-defining. Life-changing.**

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**

**Manager, Commercial Field Support**
=====================================

*Reporting into: Senior Director, Customer Experience*

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The **Field Support Representatives (FSRs)** play a critical role in supporting iRhythm’s field sales organization and advancing the service and retention efforts of iRhythm’s business. The team works most directly with Territory Managers, Key Account Managers, and Regional Sales Directors while also supporting customers through key operational needs.

The Manager, Commercial Field Support, who leads the Field Support Representatives, is responsible for day-to-day execution, coaching, and performance of the FSR organization while helping shape its continued evolution. As the organization matures, this leader will be expected to bring forward leadership, innovation, and operational discipline to help transform the team from primarily reactive support toward a more proactive model that supports and manages meaningful portions of iRhythm’s business through strong service, retention, and field partnership.

This leader coaches both FSRs and Data Coordinator team members to consistently deliver exceptional support to field sales partners and customers. Core areas of team responsibility include account onboarding, account operations support, inventory and shipment coordination, user maintenance, management of special instructions, issue resolution, reporting and insights, and triaging escalations. The Manager partners closely with the Senior Manager, FSR and Senior Director Customer Experience, as well as with Sales, Key Account Management, Customer Care, Clinical Operations, Inventory, and other cross-functional teams to improve account support, customer experience, and team performance.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative people leader who enjoys coaching others, solving complex operational challenges, and identifying innovative ways to evolve team capabilities within a fast-paced medical technology environment.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Team Leadership & Development**
---------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of FSRs to achieve individual, team, and organizational goals.
* Partner closely with Senior Manager, FSR and Senior Director, Customer Experience to continue to elevate and evolve how this team serves the Commercial Org + Customers.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular coaching conversations, performance reviews, and development planning.
* Support onboarding, training, mentoring, and career development for new and existing team members.
* Help build future leadership capability by identifying and developing high-potential talent.

**Operational Excellence**
--------------------------

* Ensure consistent execution of standardized workflows, operating procedures, and service expectations.
* Monitor team performance against key operational metrics, service levels, and quality standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, eliminate manual work, and streamline processes.
* Support implementation of new systems, tools, automation, and workflow improvements.
* Escalate systemic issues and recommend solutions that improve team performance and customer experience.

**Commercial Partnership**
--------------------------

* Build strong working relationships with Territory Managers, Regional Sales Directors, Key Account Managers, and Customer Care teams.
* Partner with commercial teams to resolve customer challenges and improve operational performance.
* Ensure FSRs are viewed as trusted partners who help drive customer success rather than simply responding to requests.
* Reinforce role clarity and appropriate ownership across cross-functional teams.

**Service, Retention & Field Support**
--------------------------------------

* Lead a team responsible for supporting the service and retention efforts of iRhythm’s business while balancing customer experience, field sales priorities, and operational efficiency.
* Coach FSRs to move beyond reactive request management by proactively supporting field sales partners, monitoring account needs, identifying customer risks, and helping resolve issues before they impact customer experience or retention.
* Use operational reporting, account insights, regional business trends, and customer support data to guide coaching, prioritization, resource allocation, and day-to-day decision-making.
* Partner with Territory Managers, Key Account Managers, Regional Sales Directors, and cross-functional teams to improve account onboarding, operational execution, customer issue resolution, and service continuity.
* Develop team capability around account onboarding, operational support, managing special instructions, reporting and insights, escalation triage, and proactive support of customer service and retention activities.

**Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------

* Encourage team members to identify root causes and recommend scalable solutions.
* Participate in cross-functional improvement initiatives and organizational projects.
* Share feedback from customers and field partners to improve products, systems, and processes.
* Help drive adoption of best practices across the FSR organization.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* 5–8 years of experience in medical device, healthcare technology, diagnostics, or related healthcare industry.
* 2–5 years of people leadership experience leading customer-facing or commercial support teams OR consistent proven peer leadership experience at IRTC.
* **Ability to travel up to 50% of the time** to effectively contribute to Commercial Leadership meetings, Commercial Business + Training sessions, Host or Attend functional offsites, etc.
* Demonstrated success coaching and developing high-performing teams.
* Strong operational problem-solving and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
* Experience working cross-functionally in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
* Ability to balance day-to-day execution with continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Remote U.S.-based role; preference for candidates residing in **Texas or Illinois** to align with current business and hiring priorities.
* Experience supporting field sales organizations.
* Knowledge of healthcare operations and customer workflows.
* AI Literacy to drive efficiency and innovation to service line
* Experience with CRM platforms, operational reporting, and workflow management tools.
* Experience implementing process improvements or leading operational initiatives.

**Leadership Competencies**
===========================

The successful candidate consistently demonstrates the ability to:

* Lead with integrity, empathy, and accountability.
* Develop and coach high-performing teams.
* Build trusted partnerships across Commercial and Operations.
* Drive consistency through strong execution.
* Identify operational challenges and improve processes.
* Navigate ambiguity with sound judgment.
* Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
* Balance customer needs with business priorities.
* Embrace change, bring forward innovative ideas, and help others successfully navigate the evolution of the FSR organization.

**Location:**

Remote - US

Actual compensation may vary depending on job-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location.

**Estimated Pay Range**

$103,000.00 - $134,000.00

As a part of our core values, we ensure an inclusive workforce. We welcome and celebrate people of all backgrounds, experiences, skills, and perspectives. iRhythm Technologies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. d827a2eb28e9b33f7511.title: Sleep Care Coach
d827a2eb28e9b33f7511.description:
**Sleep Care Coach (100% Remote)**
==================================

**Remote | Full-Time | Monday-Friday | 8:00 AM-5:00 PM CST | $20-$23/hr DOE**

**Help Patients Sleep Better. Live Better. Feel Better.**
---------------------------------------------------------

**Integrated Sleep Care, a Pivotal Health Company**, is growing and looking for compassionate, motivated professionals to join our team as a **Remote Sleep Care Coach**.

In this role, you'll become a trusted resource for patients undergoing CPAP therapy for obstructive sleep apnea. Through education, encouragement, and ongoing support, you'll help patients build healthy habits that improve their sleep, health, and quality of life.

If you're passionate about helping others, enjoy coaching behavior change, and thrive in a structured remote environment, we'd love to hear from you.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

✅ 100% Remote Work Environment

✅ Monday-Friday Schedule (No Weekends)

✅ Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

✅ Generous PTO & Paid Holidays

✅ 401(k) with Company Match

✅ Company-Paid Life Insurance

✅ Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

✅ Company-Provided Computer & Equipment

✅ Professional Growth & Development Opportunities

✅ Work with a Nationally Recognized Leader in Sleep Care Services

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

Every day, you'll help patients overcome challenges that can impact their health, energy levels, and overall well-being. Your support can directly influence a patient's success with CPAP therapy and improve long-term health outcomes.

This is an excellent opportunity for professionals with experience in:

Healthcare Support

Patient Advocacy

Health Coaching

Counseling

Psychology

Wellness Programs

Customer Service

Care Coordination

**What You'll Do**
------------------

As a Sleep Care Coach, you'll serve as a key point of contact for patients throughout their sleep therapy journey.

### **Key Responsibilities**

✔ Provide education and coaching to patients using CPAP therapy

✔ Encourage long-term therapy adherence through motivation, accountability, and support

✔ Conduct outbound follow-up calls to patients and caregivers

✔ Respond to inbound patient and caregiver inquiries

✔ Review daily patient activity within the Sanusom Portal (reporting only, no clinical interpretation)

✔ Help identify and address barriers impacting therapy success

✔ Coordinate with physician offices and DME providers regarding non-clinical patient needs

✔ Schedule and reschedule patient appointments as needed

✔ Document all patient interactions accurately in electronic systems

✔ Participate in team meetings, training, and quality initiatives

✔ Remain available and engaged during scheduled work hours

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

The ideal candidate is:

An excellent communicator

Skilled at building rapport and trust over the phone

❤️ Empathetic, patient-focused, and supportive

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Comfortable using remote technologies and electronic medical records

Successful working independently in a remote environment

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

✔ High School Diploma or GED

✔ Strong communication and interpersonal skills

✔ Ability to motivate, encourage, and support patients

✔ Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities

✔ Comfort using computers, web-based platforms, and remote technology

### **Preferred**

### **Associate's or Bachelor's Degree in:**

* Psychology
* Counseling
* Exercise Science
* Healthcare Administration
* Public Health
* Social Work
* Related healthcare or behavioral health fields

### **Helpful Experience**

* Health Coaching
* Patient Care Coordination
* Patient Advocacy
* Behavioral Health Support
* Medical Office Support
* Healthcare Customer Service
* Case Management Support
* Sleep Medicine
* CPAP Therapy Support
* Wellness Coaching

**Relevant healthcare, coaching, counseling, or patient support experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.**

**Bilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.**

**Ideal Career Backgrounds**
----------------------------

This role may be an excellent fit for candidates currently working as:

* Health Coach
* Patient Care Coordinator
* Patient Advocate
* Care Navigator
* Behavioral Health Technician
* Case Management Assistant
* Wellness Coach
* Healthcare Customer Service Representative
* Medical Administrative Professional
* Sleep Therapy Support Specialist

**About Integrated Sleep Care, a Pivotal Health Company**
---------------------------------------------------------

Integrated Sleep Care partners with healthcare providers and patients to improve outcomes through innovative sleep therapy support, patient engagement, and compassionate care services.

Our mission is simple: **help patients sleep better so they can live healthier, happier lives.**

Join a team that is making a meaningful difference every day.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
--------------------------------

Integrated Sleep Care, a Pivotal Health Company, is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic protected by law.

### **Reasonable Accommodation**

Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation during the hiring process may contact Human Resources for assistance.

### **Employment Eligibility**

This employer participates in **E-Verify**. Federal law requires employers to verify the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires in the United States.

Each FSR operates in a designated field service territory and represents VMS. This requires a high level of professional communication with their team, customers, management, sales, and other technical support.

The Field Service Representative (FSR) is the primary contact for Varian Medical Systems (VMS) customer service and repair needs ensuring that our customers’ equipment operates efficiently at all times. * Understand and recognize the need to escalate incidents when necessary and/or request additional assistance from more tenured representatives.
* Examine difficult customer issues, diagnose, and resolve the issues, and meet established FSR levels.
* Maintain effective territory management and expense control which includes timely completion and submission of field service and expense reports along with management of consignment and other required documentation according to VMS procedures.
* Develop and maintain strong customer relationships using strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

Minimum Required Skills and Knowledge:

* Frequent use and application of technical documentation, standards, principles, concepts, and techniques in the field.
* Uses acquired job skills and company policies to complete assigned tasks.
* Sound knowledge of and professional experience with electronic and electro-mechanical engineering, testing equipment used for verification/checkout and calibration of electronic equipment.
* Sound knowledge of and professional technical experience with micro-computers/PC based systems
* Sound computer usage and debugging skills. Ability to identify and repair routine software and delivery system network problems.
* Identify and resolve simple imaging system defects.
* Performs routine maintenance, including major STBs.
* Proficient at diagnosing and solving moderately complex mechanical problems, including simple vacuum leaks.
* Able to perform vacuum system gun replacements and target replacements. Achieve certification status for C3 products.
* Meets all Vendor Credentialing requirements necessary to gain VMS client site access, unless prohibited by law. These requirements vary by client and may include but are not limited to: Proof of valid identification (photo, driver’s license, SSN) Criminal background checks Drug screens Immunizations (Hep B, MMR, Varicella, Influenza, Tetanus) Annual TB testing Healthcare trainings.

* Able to handle difficult customer situations including troubleshooting while the customer is observing.
* Is assigned as primary support for machine accounts for which certification has been completed.

f66592b8d62c8eb984d0.title: Customer Onboarding & Training Specialist
f66592b8d62c8eb984d0.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

RB Retail & Service Solutions, part of the Fullsteam organization, provides business management software for the pool and spa industry. Since 2003, we have helped retailers, service companies, and construction businesses streamline operations and improve efficiency through innovative software solutions.

  

We are seeking a motivated, customer-focused **Customer Onboarding & Training Specialist** to guide new customers through software implementation, onboarding, and training. This role ensures customers feel confident using our software, understand its functionality, and are prepared to incorporate it into their daily operations.

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

**Customer Onboarding & Implementation**

* Manage the onboarding process from initial welcome through implementation and transition to ongoing support.
* Lead kickoff meetings to understand customer needs, workflows, and business goals.
* Develop customized onboarding and training plans.
* Coordinate software setup, configuration, and implementation with internal teams.
* Track progress, address challenges, and ensure customers are prepared to use the software successfully.
* Conduct follow-ups to evaluate customer satisfaction and adoption.

**Customer Training & Education**

* Deliver engaging software training through virtual meetings, webinars, and individual or group sessions.
* Explain software features, workflows, and best practices using real-world examples.
* Adapt training to different experience levels and learning styles.
* Identify additional training needs and promote customer confidence and independence.

**Training Content Development**

* Create and maintain training materials, including videos, tutorials, user guides, webinars, and step-by-step documentation.
* Develop and update FAQs, knowledge base articles, and self-service resources.
* Create interactive product walkthroughs and in-application training.
* Keep educational materials current with software updates and new features.
* Collaborate with internal teams to identify common customer questions and improve training resources.

**Customer Success & Collaboration**

* Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication and support.
* Set clear expectations for onboarding timelines and customer responsibilities.
* Monitor customer engagement and provide additional guidance when needed.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Support, Account Management, and Product Development to ensure a smooth customer experience.
Communicate customer feedback and recommend improvements to onboarding and training processes.  

  

**Required Skills & Experience:**
---------------------------------

* Experience in software training, customer onboarding, customer success, technical support, or a related customer-facing role.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical audiences.
* Excellent organizational, time-management, and multitasking skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customers and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable leading virtual presentations and training sessions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-first mindset.
* Ability to quickly learn new software and business processes.
* Experience creating professional training materials and documentation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Teams, Zoom, or similar tools.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with internal teams.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with SaaS products or business management software.
* Familiarity with retail, point-of-sale, inventory management, or service scheduling.
* Experience with CRM, customer support, or onboarding platforms such as Zoho or HubSpot.
* Familiarity with learning management systems, Canva, Product Fruits, or similar tools.
* Experience creating instructional videos, webinars, and interactive tutorials.
Previous experience developing structured onboarding or software training programs.  

**Salary range: $85,000 - $95,000 USD**

Fullsteam supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience, and background. Fullsteam is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

The Technical Support Specialist serves as the first point of contact for customer support inquiries, delivering timely, accurate, and customer-focused assistance. This role is responsible for troubleshooting basic to moderately complex issues, documenting cases thoroughly, and ensuring a seamless customer experience.

Specialists play a critical role in driving customer satisfaction through strong communication, responsiveness, and ownership of issues. They collaborate closely with Tier 2 support and internal teams, escalate issues when appropriate, and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement efforts. A proactive mindset, attention to detail, and commitment to service excellence are essential for success.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the first point of contact for customer inquiries via ticketing system, chat, email, and phone, ensuring prompt, professional, and customer-focused responses across all channels.
* Answer and manage inbound support phone calls, providing real-time troubleshooting, clear communication, and a high-quality customer experience while documenting interactions accurately.
* Troubleshoot and resolve basic to moderately complex technical issues, following established processes and documentation.
* Accurately document all customer interactions, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in the ticketing system.
* Identify when issues require escalation and effectively transition cases to Tier 2 with complete context and documentation.
* Guide customers through solutions with clear, step-by-step instructions, ensuring a positive and customer-centric experience.
* Maintain strong product knowledge and stay current on updates, features, and known issues.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment and timely resolution of customer concerns.
* Contribute to knowledge base articles and internal documentation to improve team efficiency and customer self-service.
* Support team performance during high-volume periods while maintaining service level expectations.

* Follow support processes and identify opportunities for improvement, raising suggestions to leadership.

* Basic troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across software applications.
* Ability to follow processes, document accurately, and manage multiple tasks.
* Willingness and ability to quickly learn new systems and technologies, including Novara software.

**Preferred**

* Experience in SaaS or technical support environments.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems and support tools.
* Exposure to basic technical concepts such as APIs, SSO, or file transfers (SFTP).

### **Success Criteria:**

* High customer satisfaction (CSAT) driven by responsiveness, empathy, and clear communication.
* Strong First Response Time (FRT), consistently meeting or exceeding service level expectations.
* Effective issue resolution and proper escalation, ensuring smooth handoffs and minimal customer friction.
* Accurate and complete documentation contributing to team efficiency and knowledge sharing.
* Continuous improvement in product knowledge, troubleshooting skills, and support quality.

3e9bca5fe9218294b986.title: Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator
3e9bca5fe9218294b986.description:
Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator

\*\*Residential Window Cleaning | Remote \*\*

About the Role

Mauka Cleaning Co. is a residential window cleaning and exterior cleaning company serving homeowners on Oahu.

We are looking for a reliable, organized, phone-savvy \*\*Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator\*\* to manage the customer journey from first contact through booking, follow-up, service coordination, and reactivation.

This is not a passive data-entry position. Your work will directly impact our booked revenue, schedule utilization, customer satisfaction, and company growth.

You must be available to work \*\*9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, Hawaii-Aleutian Standard Time.\*\*

Your mission is simple:

\*\*Keep the schedule full, customers informed, technicians supported, and the back office organized.\*\*

---

Key Responsibilities:

1. Inbound Sales, Reactivations and Lead Follow-Up

- Respond quickly to new leads by phone, text, and email.

- Qualify leads and provide basic estimates using company pricing tools and guidelines.

- Move leads through each stage of the sales pipeline.

- Follow up with open estimates and unbooked leads using approved follow-up sequences.

- Reactivate past customers and older leads using approved campaigns and offers.

- Contact flexible customers to fill schedule gaps and pull jobs forward.

- Identify appropriate add-on services and recurring maintenance opportunities.

- Maintain accurate CRM notes and next steps for every lead and customer.

- Ask for the sale confidently and professionally.

-Use Housecall Pro and Slack on the daily

2. Customer Experience and Service Coordination

- Answer customer questions about services, pricing, availability, and scheduling.

- Send booking confirmations, reminders, and service updates.

- Handle reschedules and cancellations professionally.

- Backfill canceled openings using the active sales pipeline.

- Support technicians with access instructions, customer notes, and schedule changes.

- Handle customer complaints calmly and document each issue accurately.

- Coordinate approved touch-ups, go-backs, refunds, and service resolutions.

- Follow up with satisfied customers and request Google reviews.

- Protect the customer experience from booking through completed service.

3. Administrative Operations

- Send internal updates and reminders to the field team.

- Record special instructions, access information, and job notes.

- Track technician bonuses and commissions based on completed jobs and upsells.

- Plan and document yard sign routes for technicians.

- Process approved refunds and document them correctly.

- Set up and track customer payment plans when approved.

- Monitor overdue invoices and conduct polite follow-up calls and messages.

- Keep calendars, customer records, and internal systems accurate and current.

---

\*Success Metrics\*

Your performance will be measured by:

- Speed to lead

- Estimate-to-sale conversion rate

- Reactivation calls and bookings

- Booked revenue and gross profit

- Schedule utilization

- Customer response time

- Cancellation recovery rate

- Review requests and customer satisfaction

- Accuracy of CRM notes and administrative records

We care about results, not just activity.

---

Requirements:

- Strong spoken and written English.

- A natural, confident, and professional phone presence.

- Comfortable making and receiving a high volume of calls and messages. \*\*If the phone ringing makes you want to hide under your desk, this probably is not the role for you.\*\*

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple customers, leads, jobs, and follow-ups without dropping the ball.

- Able to follow scripts, checklists, and documented processes consistently.

- Comfortable asking for the sale and requesting customer reviews.

- Comfortable using email, calendars, spreadsheets, and online communication tools.

- Reliable, self-motivated, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

- Able to work from a quiet, professional environment with no loud background noises, interruptions, or distractions during working hours.

- Must have a reliable, high-speed internet connection capable of supporting phone calls, video meetings, CRM software, and multiple online systems.

- Reliable availability

- Must have a reliable laptop to use on the daily along with a headset/mic to take calls on

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with residential window cleaning or exterior cleaning.

- Experience with customer reactivation or estimate follow-up.

- Experience coordinating field technicians.

- Experience requesting online reviews.

- Experience handling payment follow-up or basic accounts receivable.

---

Who This Role Isn’t For

This role is \*\*not\*\* a good fit if you:

- Dislike talking on the phone or avoid making outbound calls.

- Need constant supervision to stay productive.

- Struggle to stay organized when managing multiple customers, leads, and tasks.

- Prefer doing things your own way instead of following proven scripts and processes.

- Get discouraged by follow-up, rejection, or customers who need multiple touchpoints before booking.

- Are uncomfortable asking for the sale or requesting customer reviews.

- Frequently miss deadlines, forget follow-ups, or leave CRM notes incomplete.

- Are only looking for a quiet data-entry position. This is a customer-facing, revenue-producing role.

- Have frequent background noise, interruptions, or an unreliable internet connection.

- Cannot reliably work the required schedule.

\*\*If your ideal workday involves avoiding the phone, hiding from follow-up, and hoping the schedule fills itself, this probably is not the role for you.\*\*

---

Compensation

-Base pay starting at $16/hr, with growth opportunities.

- Performance bonuses tied to:

- Revenue sold and collected

- Completed upsells

- Service plans sold

- Reactivated customers

- Other agreed-upon performance targets

You will receive training on our systems, scripts, pricing guidelines, and processes.

The right person can grow into a \*Customer Experience & Sales Manager\* by proving they can independently own the customer journey and consistently produce results.

If you are organized, competitive, dependable, and enjoy helping customers while closing business, we want to hear from you.

Pay: From $16.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

fec21c08f494f1efc485.description:
**About Apex Skin:**

We are Apex Skin, and our mission is to provide the highest quality dermatology and dermatologic surgery care to patients across Northeast Ohio with promptness, compassion, and excellence. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional patient experiences, offering same-day appointments, and serving our communities through education and meaningful care. Our team is dedicated to creating a supportive, patient-focused environment where excellence, empathy, and teamwork thrive.

**Position Overview**

Apex Skin is a physician-led and rapidly growing dermatology practice committed to delivering exceptional patient experiences. We are seeking a professional, customer-focused **Call Center Representative** to serve as the first point of contact for our patients. This role is responsible for answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, collecting and updating patient information, verifying insurance eligibility, and supporting patient communication needs while maintaining a high level of accuracy and compassion.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong communication and organizational skills, and is comfortable navigating multiple systems while providing exceptional patient service.

**Compensation**

Hourly Wage: $17-19.00 per hour

**Schedule**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday (8:00 am-4:30 pm)
* **Remote position for North East Ohio residents only**
* Schedule may vary slightly based on business and patient needs

**Essential Functions**

* Answer inbound patient calls promptly, professionally, and courteously
* Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments in accordance with Apex Skin protocols
* Complete patient pre-registration and accurately collect demographic and insurance information
* Verify insurance eligibility using EMR systems and verification platforms such as Optum or Availity
* Maintain accurate patient records while adhering to HIPAA and privacy standards
* Process pre-authorizations and assist with payment collection as needed
* Transmit correspondence and medical documentation securely and appropriately
* Collaborate with clinical and administrative teams to support patient care and scheduling needs
* Participate in required training sessions, team meetings, and operational updates
* Provide temporary support for on-site call center operations when business needs require
* Perform additional administrative duties as assigned
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Basic computer proficiency including Microsoft Office, email platforms, and EMR systems
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and remain calm under pressure
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Must reside in the state of Ohio
* Ability to maintain a quiet, professional, and distraction-free remote work environment
* One (1) year of experience in a medical office, healthcare scheduling, or call center environment preferred
* Familiarity with insurance verification processes and EMR systems preferred
* Prior dermatology or specialty healthcare experience preferred

**Career Growth Opportunities**

Motivated **Call Center Representative** may pursue:

* Apex Skin provides training, mentoring, and development opportunities for individuals who demonstrate skill, reliability, compassion, and clinical accuracy

**Remote Work Requirements**

* Apex Skin will provide a company phone and access to required call center software
* Employee must maintain reliable high-speed internet service (50 Mbps download recommended)
* Designated workspace must remain private, professional, and free from distractions during scheduled work hours
* All company equipment and patient information must be handled in compliance with Apex Skin privacy and security standards

**Physical Requirements & Work Environment**

* Prolonged periods of sitting while using a computer, headset, and phone system
* Frequent speaking, listening, and viewing of computer monitors throughout the workday
* Manual dexterity required for typing and operating standard office equipment
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 15 pounds for equipment or files
* Work is performed in a home office environment with controlled lighting and limited distractions
* Requires strong attention to detail, professionalism, and the ability to maintain productivity in a remote setting
* Required to adhere to HIPAA, OSHA, and Apex Skin privacy and safety standards

**Apex Skin Culture**  
Apex Skin fosters a collaborative, patient-first environment built on compassion, clinical excellence, and teamwork. We believe in a respectful and supportive workplace where employees feel valued, trusted, and empowered to contribute to exceptional patient experiences and meaningful clinical care.

**Employee Health & Safety Requirements:**  
All patient-facing employees are required to provide proof of a TB test within the past 12 months and an annual flu vaccination as part of Apex Skin’s employee health and safety protocols. The Hepatitis B vaccination series is also strongly recommended for clinical staff due to potential occupational exposure risks. Apex Skin complies with federal and Ohio law by providing reasonable accommodations for medical conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs that prevent vaccination. Employees seeking an accommodation should contact Human Resources for more information.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:**  
Apex Skin provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Apex complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

63562ca4bb5fe244e72e.title: Academic Enrollment Advisor (Remote - Full-time)
63562ca4bb5fe244e72e.description:
**Consultative Sales | Education & Student Success**

Novastar Prep | Full-Time | Remote — United States

**Base Salary:** $60,000–$65,000 annually  
**On-Target Earnings (OTE):** $100,000–$130,000 annually  
**Commission:** Performance-based, uncapped earning potential

**Help Families Make Confident Decisions About Their Children's Education**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

At Novastar Prep, we believe that every student has extraordinary potential—and that the right educational support can make a lasting difference in their confidence, academic performance, and future opportunities.

For more than 17 years, Novastar Prep has helped thousands of students achieve their academic goals through personalized, one-on-one tutoring, SAT/ACT preparation, advanced academic support, and college readiness services.

As we continue expanding our national presence, we are seeking an accomplished, results-driven **Academic Enrollment Advisor** who combines strong consultative sales capabilities with exceptional communication skills, sound judgment, and a commitment to helping families make informed educational decisions.

This is not a traditional high-pressure sales position. It is a relationship-driven, performance-oriented role where your ability to listen, identify needs, communicate value, and guide families toward appropriate solutions directly influences student success and your earning potential.

**No cold calling.** You will work primarily with company-generated inquiries, qualified prospects, existing client relationships, and referral opportunities.

If you thrive in a consultative sales environment, enjoy engaging with discerning clients, and take pride in achieving measurable results, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

**The Role**
------------

As an Academic Enrollment Advisor, you will serve as a trusted resource for families navigating important academic decisions.

You will engage with parents to understand their children's academic needs, challenges, and aspirations, then recommend personalized tutoring and test preparation solutions that align with their goals.

You will take ownership of the enrollment process—from initial consultation and needs assessment through recommendation, follow-up, and successful enrollment.

The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable establishing rapport with families, confidently discussing the value of premium educational services, and consistently achieving ambitious sales goals.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Consultative Enrollment & Sales**

* Conduct thoughtful consultations with parents to understand students' academic needs, goals, learning challenges, and educational priorities.
* Recommend appropriate tutoring, SAT/ACT preparation, academic enrichment, AP/IB support, and college readiness services.
* Communicate the value of personalized tutoring clearly and persuasively while addressing questions and objections about pricing, timing, and program effectiveness.
* Convert qualified inquiries into enrollments while ensuring recommendations align with students' needs.
* Consistently achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly revenue, enrollment, and conversion targets.

### **2. Lead Management & Relationship Development**

* Manage a robust pipeline of company-generated leads, incoming inquiries, referrals, and reactivation opportunities.
* Conduct timely follow-up through phone, email, text, and video consultations.
* Develop trusted relationships with prospective and existing families, identifying opportunities to expand or resume academic support.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, including consultation notes, pipeline status, follow-up commitments, and enrollment activity.
* Demonstrate disciplined pipeline management and ownership of individual performance.

### **3. Client Experience & Student Success**

* Partner with Novastar's academic and tutor-support teams to ensure a seamless transition from enrollment to service delivery.
* Set realistic expectations about tutoring services, the learning process, and student progress.
* Support a positive family experience through thoughtful communication, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Identify additional academic needs as students advance through different educational stages.
* Represent Novastar's commitment to individualized learning, student confidence, and long-term academic development.

### **4. Performance Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor individual sales performance, conversion rates, revenue production, and pipeline effectiveness.
* Participate in coaching, skills development, and performance reviews.
* Demonstrate openness to feedback, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
* Contribute ideas to strengthen the enrollment process, customer experience, and overall team effectiveness.
* Collaborate with colleagues while maintaining a high degree of individual accountability.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years of demonstrated success in consultative sales, inside sales, enrollment advising, or another relationship-driven sales environment.
* Proven ability to meet or exceed established revenue or sales quotas.
* Strong discovery, needs-assessment, relationship-building, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication, with the ability to engage professionally and confidently with parents.
* Experience selling services where trust, personalization, and perceived value significantly influence purchasing decisions.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and virtual communication platforms.
* Ability to manage a substantial volume of client interactions and sales opportunities in a remote work environment.
* Self-motivation, accountability, emotional intelligence, and a results-oriented mindset.
* Genuine interest in education, student development, and helping families make informed decisions.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in K–12 tutoring, SAT/ACT preparation, college admissions services, educational consulting, or EdTech.
* Experience selling premium, personalized, or high-consideration services to families or individual consumers.
* Working knowledge of K–12 academic pathways, AP/IB programs, standardized testing, and college readiness.
* Experience managing qualified inbound leads and maintaining strong consultation-to-enrollment conversion rates.
* A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, education, communications, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to coach peers, improve processes, or contribute to team-wide sales effectiveness.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

At Novastar Prep, success is measured by more than sales volume. We value advisors who build trust, make thoughtful recommendations, and establish relationships that create lasting value for students and families.

High-performing advisors demonstrate:

* Consistent achievement of monthly and quarterly enrollment and revenue goals.
* Strong consultation-to-enrollment conversion rates and effective pipeline management.
* Excellent communication, client relationship management, and timely follow-up.
* Thoughtful recommendations that align with student needs and family priorities.
* Strong collaboration, professional accountability, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

We believe exceptional performance deserves meaningful rewards.

Our compensation structure is designed to attract accomplished professionals who want both income stability and the opportunity to increase their earnings through results.

### **Compensation**

* **Annual Base Salary:** $60,000–$65,000, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.
* **On-Target Earnings (OTE):** $100,000–$130,000 annually, including base salary and performance-based compensation at established targets.
* **Uncapped Commission:** Additional earning potential for exceptional sales performance.
* **Performance Incentives:** Opportunities to earn additional compensation based on defined goals and achievements.

*OTE represents estimated annual earnings at target performance and is not guaranteed. Actual variable compensation is governed by the applicable commission and incentive plan.*

### **Benefits & Professional Development**

* Health insurance reimbursement.
* Retirement benefits.
* Full-time, remote work environment.
* Flexible scheduling within established business and client service requirements.
* Ongoing training, professional coaching, and sales development.
* Opportunities for expanded responsibilities and advancement as Novastar grows.
* Collaborative, mission-driven team culture focused on excellence, accountability, and student success.

**Work Environment & Schedule**
-------------------------------

This is a full-time, remote position open to qualified candidates based in the United States.

The role provides professional autonomy and schedule flexibility while requiring consistent availability, reliable communication, and responsiveness to families. Because many parents are available outside traditional working hours, candidates should be comfortable with scheduled consultations and occasional evening availability as needed.

You will spend significant time communicating with prospective and existing families through phone, email, and video consultations. Success requires strong self-management, disciplined follow-through, and professionalism in a remote environment.

**Professional Growth & Career Development**
--------------------------------------------

Novastar Prep is committed to developing and recognizing talented professionals.

As our organization expands, successful advisors may have opportunities to assume additional responsibilities in areas such as:

* Senior Academic Enrollment Advising
* Advisor Training and Mentorship
* Enrollment Process Improvement
* Team Leadership and Sales Management
* Client Relationship Development and Strategic Growth

Advancement is based on demonstrated performance, leadership potential, organizational needs, and available opportunities.

**Why Join Novastar Prep?**
---------------------------

**Make an Impact That Matters**

Help families make meaningful educational decisions that can positively influence a student's confidence, academic progress, and future opportunities.

**Represent an Established, Trusted Brand**

Join an organization with more than 17 years of experience delivering personalized academic support to thousands of students.

**Build a Rewarding Career**

Combine professional development, meaningful client relationships, and competitive performance-based earnings.

**Enjoy Autonomy With Accountability**

Work remotely in an environment that values initiative, sound judgment, consistent performance, and collaboration.

**Be Part of a Mission Beyond Sales**

Our educational philosophy is grounded in three core beliefs:

* Every student learns differently.
* Every student possesses tremendous gifts and potential.
* Every student deserves the investment necessary to become the best version of themselves.

We believe the right advisor helps families recognize what is possible—and connects them with the support to make it happen.

**Ready to Take the Next Step?**
--------------------------------

If you are an experienced consultative sales professional who combines strong business results with a genuine desire to help students and families succeed, we invite you to apply.

Join Novastar Prep and help families invest confidently in their children's futures.

**Apply Online:** https://careers.novastarprep.com

*Novastar Prep is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience, performance, and business requirements, without regard to legally protected characteristics.*

As a new Optum business, we are building on our strengths but also challenging the status quo. We are creating a business that is designed to specifically serve the unique needs of rare disease patient populations and support the emerging therapies, which require enhanced services and new capabilities over traditional specialty pharmacies. Our mission, 'supporting people with compassion while creating access to therapies at the frontier of health care,' and vision, 'that all people, no matter how unique, can access a better tomorrow' are what drive and motivate us, as part of the larger UnitedHealth Group mission 'to make the health system work better for everyone.

The Care Ambassador will be responsible for responsible for acting as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for a portfolio of healthcare providers, customers, and patients. The role is designed to provide solutions regarding product and program-related issues. Additionally, drive patient adherence to therapies and is responsible for onboarding and welcoming the patient to Optum Frontier Therapies. The Care Ambassador develops and builds on long-term effective relationships with healthcare providers, affiliated staff, and support personnel. This role educates the patient, caregivers, and all those involved in a patient's care plan on program services and solutions. Build trust in the program and long-term relationships.

As a Care Ambassador, you will serve patients, providers, pharmacy manufacturers and insurance carriers. You will work with a team of about 40 other Care Ambassadors where you will review daily plans of action for assignments, serve as a first point of contact for patient resolution, handle inbound calls as needed, support and communicate with a diverse patient population, make outbound calls to patient dispenses, triage calls, and attend meetings as needed. You will navigate about 14 programs daily in this position so computer proficiency is a must, as it the ability to handle multiple projects, multitask, prioritize your time, and remain self-motivated. Success in this role is measured by a productivity ranking, timecard accuracy, an average answer speed of under 30 seconds call monitoring quality scores and meeting service level agreements of 85% or more for inbound and outbound calls.

This position is full-time, Monday - Friday. Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our 8-hour shift schedules during our normal business hours of 8:00 am - 9:00 pm EST. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime.

We offer 8 weeks of training (6 week-long virtual classroom training followed by peer shadowing for 2 additional weeks) during normal scheduled shift of Monday - Friday, 9:00 am - 5:30 pm EST.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Serves as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for patient, caregivers, pharma, and providers.
* React with a professional and empathetic demeanor when addressing physician office and patients complaints and concerns.
* Identifies the most appropriate, efficient and effective means to streamline communication for healthcare providers with multiple patients in the program.
* Thinks critically and strategically to identify and resolve roadblocks for customers in a proactive fashion.
* Ensures Service Level Agreements are met by managing workflow and taking ownership of quality customer care.
* Supports achievement of program satisfaction.
* Develops and maintains productive and effective relationships with physicians, nurses, office managers, and other applicable customers.
* Builds trust in and engagement with program services by proactively interacting and promptly following-up on inquiries.
* Develops and implements tailored customer support plans, focusing on customer service solutions that improve patient outcomes.
* Maintains Customer Improvement focus and provides customers with unique, critical perspective on partnering with the program by laying out a vision for collaboration that positively grows relationship.
* Manages inbound and outbound e-mail, phone calls, and faxes for customer service support and follow up.
* Demonstrates an understanding of program operations process, the assigned product, and the patient journey. Understands and supports internal processing functions and personnel.
* Demonstrates an understanding of the disease state(s), competitors, and health care industry trends.
* Collaborates and works closely with management, colleagues, and other departments in the organization.
* Demonstrates competency in using information technology, PCs and a variety of databases.
* Ability to comprehend and manage any problems that may arise. Using problem solving skills to produce an appropriate resolution for physician offices and patients.
* Contributes to the achievement of the goals, objectives, and outcomes of the program by demonstrating knowledge of product, disease state, and program information as it applies to the specific program.
* Completes all appropriate training including, but not limited to New Hire Orientation, In-Services, internal training, client provided training and competency assessments.
* Maintains patient confidentiality and accurate documentation of calls to and from all parties.
* Adheres to all Company policies and standard operating procedures.
* Completes special duties or projects as assigned by the leadership.

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Must be 18 years of age OR older
* 3+ years of case/account management, relationship management, customer support or professional customer service experience
* Call center experience

* Must work EST time zone
* Ability to work full-time, Monday - Friday. Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our 8-hour shift schedules during our normal business hours of 8:00 am - 9:00 pm EST. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime

**Preferred Qualifications:**
