bc64753b378532eecfb3.title: Human Resources Assistant
bc64753b378532eecfb3.description:
**Department:** Human Resources

  

**Position Summary:**

The HR Assistant provides administrative, coordination, and operational support across Human Resources and Talent Acquisition. Working closely with the VP HR Manager and VP of Talent Acquisition, this role ensures the smooth execution of daily HR operations, recruiting, onboarding, employee engagement events, HRIS administration and department projects. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Create and maintain electronic and hard-copy employee and new hire files.
* Monitor candidate background check statuses and assist with tracking.
* Coordinate and schedule candidate interviews across departments.
* Assist with new hire orientation setup, including room reservations, attendee scheduling, and packet preparation.
* Perform regular employee file audits using checklists, follow up on missing documents, and log records in tracking spreadsheets.
* Audit medical/BenePoints records across spreadsheets and the HRIS platform.
* Audit departmental invoices and follow up on audit/open enrollment discrepancies.
* Conduct data entry and produce standard or customized reports within the HRIS.
* Provide calendar management, meeting coordination, and administrative support to the HR Generalist and Talent Acquisition teams.
* Provide back-up support to the Senior Administrative Assistant for the Executive Partner of Human Resources as needed.
* Partner with the HR Coordinator to plan and execute company events, employee engagement programs, and recognition drives.
* Track participation and completion rates for required HR programs and activities.
* Update and maintain designated HR web pages and tracking spreadsheets.
* Handle sensitive employee and applicant information with strict confidentiality.
* Perform general office maintenance, including scanning, filing, shredding, archiving, and organizing HR storage areas.
* Support HR research initiatives and special projects as needed.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

  

**Competencies**:

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies to perform the essential functions of this position.

* Ability to work with and handle confidential information – the individual has a proven track record of handling sensitive employee, candidate, and compensation records with strict discretion and adherence to privacy standards.
* Detail orientated—the individual pays close attention to all the small particulars when working on a task or project
* Great follow up skills—the individual has demonstrated ability to pursue ongoing projects to keep tasks moving along to completion.
* Problem solving—the individual identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner and gathers and analyzes information skillfully
* Interpersonal Skills—the individual maintains confidentiality, remains open to others' ideas, and exhibits willingness to try new things.
* Written Communication—the individual edits work for spelling and grammar, presents numerical data effectively and can read and interpret written information.
* Quality control—the individual demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness and monitors own work to ensure quality.
* Adaptability—the individual adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and can deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
* Dependability—the individual is consistently at work and on time, follows instructions, responds to management direction, and solicits feedback to improve performance.
* Safety and security—the individual actively promotes and personally observes safety and security procedures, and uses equipment and materials properly.

  

*Salary for this position ranges from $28.75 - $33.53 per hour. The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, and education. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.*

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, nationality, age, disability (physical or mental), marital or domestic partnership or Civil Union status, pregnancy, family medical history or genetic information, atypical cellular or blood trait, military service or any other status protected by law.*

c67f127c81f5067e34cc.title: Operations Coordinator, Crisis Communications Practice
c67f127c81f5067e34cc.description:
**Job Summary**

The Operations Coordinator, Crisis Communications Practice, supports the billing, financial tracking and administrative operations of the firm’s growing base of crisis communications clients. This individual will help keep a growing practice organized, ensure accurate and timely client billing and provide dependable support to the crisis practice leader and counselors.

**Billing administration**

* Coordinate the monthly billing process for client invoices, managing deadlines, required reviews and client-specific billing instructions.
* Review timesheets and preliminary invoices for accuracy and completeness, using Harvest and Asana to verify project information and identify discrepancies.
* Follow up with counselors to clarify time entries, resolve billing questions and obtain required invoice approvals.
* Prepare and customize invoices, incorporate approved revisions and distribute final invoices promptly. Final invoice approval remains with the practice leader.
* Maintain accurate billing records and reconcile preliminary billing information with invoices issued, documenting approved adjustments and resolving discrepancies.
* Coordinate billing information and administrative follow-up with the firm’s bookkeepers, who handle payment reconciliation.

**Financial tracking and reporting**

* Maintain practice billing trackers and prepare regular financial summaries for the crisis practice leader.
* Track time and fees against client arrangements and flag over-servicing, billing exceptions and other items requiring review.
* Help the practice leader monitor financial performance by keeping records current, checking data and following up on missing information.

**Practice and counselor support**

* Assist the crisis practice leader with scheduling, meeting preparation, administrative follow-through and organization of practice resources.
* Coordinate counselor travel and meeting logistics as needed.
* Maintain organized client and project records, including billing contacts, signed agreements and administrative documentation.
* Provide limited direct client support for administrative matters, including W-9 requests, invoice copies and follow-up on outstanding invoices or unsigned agreements.
* Handle sensitive client and firm information with professionalism and discretion.
* Identify practical improvements to billing and administrative workflows and help implement agreed changes.
* Coordinate with the firm’s office administrator as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Pay: $45,000.00 - $55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Glassboro, NJ 08028

e876a13c514cf99b71c8.title: School Operations & HR Support Specialist
e876a13c514cf99b71c8.description:
**Job Description:** School Operations & HR Support Specialist

**Reports To :** Head of Human Resources

**Status :** Full-Time, Non-Exempt

**Takes Direction From :** Executive Team, Strategic Leadership Team & Designated Departmental Supervisors

**Calendar :** Administrative Calendar

**Position Summary**

The School Operations & Organizational Support Specialist provides flexible administrative, operational, and organizational support across all A Step Up Academy (ASUA) campuses, programs, and departments. This position is designed to serve as a shared organizational resource, supporting the day-to-day functions, projects, and administrative needs of multiple departments based on organizational priorities.

While administratively assigned to the Human Resources Department, this position is not limited to HR responsibilities. The Specialist may be assigned to support Human Resources, School Services, School Operations, Training and Onboarding, Finance, Procurement, Technology, and other administrative or program-related functions as determined by organizational needs.

The position requires an individual who can transition effectively between departments, learn different systems and processes, and provide reliable support in a variety of settings. Assignments may be ongoing, temporary, project-based, or responsive to immediate operational needs.

The Specialist serves as an additional layer of organizational support, helping departments maintain continuity, address administrative demands, complete assigned projects, and ensure that essential processes are carried out accurately and efficiently.

The successful candidate must demonstrate flexibility, initiative, professionalism, discretion, sound judgment, and a willingness to take on responsibilities that may change from day to day. The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt to the needs of a growing and evolving organization is essential.

**Qualifications**

*Education & Experience*

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Education, Organizational Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of two years of experience in administrative support, operations, education, human resources, customer service, or related organizational functions preferred.
* Experience working in an educational, nonprofit, healthcare, human services, or other highly regulated environment preferred.
* Experience supporting multiple departments, supervisors, or operational functions preferred.
* Familiarity with administrative systems, employee management systems, and digital recordkeeping platforms preferred.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and related administrative technologies.
* Willingness and ability to learn additional organizational systems, processes, and software as assignments require.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

***Organizational & Cross-Departmental Support***

* Provide administrative and operational support to departments and organizational functions as assigned.
* Serve as a flexible resource to address staffing gaps, temporary administrative needs, special projects, and fluctuations in departmental workloads.
* Assist with daily administrative responsibilities, including scheduling, correspondence, document preparation, data entry, recordkeeping, and communication.
* Support department leaders and designated supervisors with assigned projects, operational tasks, and organizational initiatives.
* Transition between departments and assignments while maintaining accuracy, productivity, and professionalism.
* Learn and follow department-specific procedures, systems, expectations, and confidentiality requirements.
* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of organizational processes and administrative workflows.
* Identify operational challenges and communicate opportunities for improved efficiency to the appropriate supervisor.
* Provide support across ASUA campuses and administrative locations based on organizational needs.

***Human Resources & Employee Support***

* Assist with onboarding documentation, employee clearances, personnel records, and new hire readiness.
* Provide administrative support for employee transactions, status changes, record updates, and offboarding processes.
* Assist employees with general administrative questions, forms, systems, and established HR procedures.
* Support HR communication, scheduling, documentation, compliance tracking, and departmental projects.
* Assist with the coordination of employee meetings, training requirements, and assigned follow-up activities.

3a637559eb08f687d6f7.title: Jr. Talent Acquisition Specialist (Contract)
3a637559eb08f687d6f7.description:
**Company Overview**

  

JGM is a national, self-perform industrial contractor and structural steel fabricator, built to take on the fast-track, high-complexity projects other companies turn away. Founded in 2001 and still family-led today, JGM operates AISC- and ASME-certified fabrication shops in Coatesville and Sinking Spring, PA, plus a national Construction Services team performing erection, rigging, hauling, and industrial construction for Fortune 500 clients across power generation, pharmaceutical, mining, steel and metals, infrastructure, and manufacturing.

We don't subcontract our workforce. We build it, direct-hire, from the shop floor to the field to the front office. Safety comes first in every role at JGM, not just on the job site, because taking care of our people is something we'll never compromise on. With real apprenticeship and leadership programs behind every role, JGM offers more than a job: it's a career with a company where family is our foundation and whatever it takes is how we get it done.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Due to several large projects spanning our shop and field teams JGM is looking for a temporary Talent Acquisition Specialist to own the front end of our skilled-trades hiring pipeline — ironworkers, welders, fitters, laborers, and related field and shop roles. This role is the first real conversation a candidate has with JGM: you'll prescreen applicants against a standardized question set, confirm safety and compliance readiness, and package clean, consistent summaries that our experienced recruiters and hiring managers use to make the final hiring decision. Once a candidate is selected, you'll also handle the offer process and get their information into our systems correctly the first time.

***This is a 5 day a week, in office role, in Coatesville PA estimated through mid-March, with lunch provided very other Friday.***

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Candidate Prescreening:** Conduct structured phone/video prescreens for trades applicants using JGM's standardized question set for each role (ironworker, welder, fitter, laborer, etc.), covering certifications, experience, availability, pay expectations, and work eligibility. Must e comfortable contacting 20-30 candidates a day. This is not a "post and pray" recruiting role. The candidate flow is constant but is constantly moving so high-volume calling is critical to success in the role
* **Safety Questionnaire:** Send the safety questionnaire to every qualified candidate early in the process, track completion, and flag any responses that raise safety, compliance, or fit concerns before the candidate advances.
* **Prescreen Summaries:** Write clear, consistent prescreen summaries for each candidate — highlighting certifications, experience, safety questionnaire results, and any red flags — and route them to experienced recruiters and hiring managers so they can make an informed hiring decision quickly.
* **Offer Process:** Prepare and extend verbal and written offers once a hiring decision is made, coordinate start dates and pay/benefits details with the hiring manager and follow up until the offer is accepted or declined.
* **Resume & Data Entry:** Enter candidate resumes, prescreen notes, and offer status into the applicant tracking system (BambooHR) accurately and on the same day they're received, so the pipeline stays current for the whole team.
* **Candidate Experience:** Keep candidates informed and engaged at every step — timely responses, clear next steps, and professionalism — even for candidates who aren't moving forward.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with experienced recruiters and hiring managers to keep the standardized question sets and safety questionnaire current as role requirements evolve.
* **Reporting:** Tracks prescreen volume, pass-through rates, and time-to-summary, and report on pipeline health to the recruiting team.
* **Training:** Manage candidate training assignments and follow up through completion of OSHA 10 and all required Safety Skills training.
* **Pre-employment:** Manage candidate background checks and coordinate required drug screenings.
* Additional administrative projects as needed.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* !+ years in a customer focused role required. High outbound volume phone call experience is strongly preferred
* 1–2+ years of recruiting, HR coordination, or high-volume phone screening experience; experience with skilled trades or industrial/construction hiring a plus.
* Comfortable asking structured, consistent questions and accurately capturing candidate responses.
* Bilingual (Spanish) preferred.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (BambooHR or similar) preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to write a clean, objective summary that a recruiter can act on quickly.
* Proficient in use of Microsoft Suite
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage a high volume of candidates moving through the pipeline at once.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  

***You will learn more in months vs years at other companies, as you will be working with a team that will teach you, encourage you and challenge you to earn as you learn.***

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

The demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* General office environment conditions.

As a Human Resources Payroll Coordinator, you’ll help keep payroll and employee records accurate while supporting essential human resources (HR) processes. You’ll coordinate payroll processing, respond to employee questions, and handle confidential information with care. Your work will connect payroll, benefits administration, personnel administration, and HR systems to support a reliable employee experience.

Job Duties:

* Within 24 hours of admission, ensure that resident’s face sheet is complete and accurately reflecting PHI contacts, independent travel privileges, motorized wheelchair use, alerts and escort communications.
* Research hospital or transfer paperwork as necessary and add missing information to the face sheet electronic record, including but not limited to diagnosis (ICD10) codes, allergies, code status, Living Wills and Power of Attorney, contact information such as physician, hospice, pharmacy, radiology, laboratory provider.
* Ensure that Pre-admission Screening and Resident Review (PASRR) is included with transfer paperwork. May transcribe orders from hospital/transferring facility into electronic record for verification by Nursing.
* Within 72 hours of admission, audit electronic records to ensure all observations are completed, consents forms are signed; medication reconciliation is complete; initial care plans are complete; orders are complete with the diagnosis, correct route, etc.; all psychotropic medications have behaviors with monitors and side effects orders; psychotropic medications have signed and dated consents for each with classification of each; AIMS is completed; additional ICD 10 diagnosis codes are added to medications as needed.
* Add Pre-Hospital Medical Care Directive data to face sheet after assuring order for code status matches signed directive.
* Audit records for each admission and return at 7, 14, & 21 days to assure each interdisciplinary department has completed all observations with accuracy and closed them.
* Audit records at 21 days to ensure completion of full MDS & completion of all necessary care plans; audit records on an ongoing basis to ensure progress notes from clinic; consults visits are received in a timely manner; ensure accurate order entry including category and compliance with regulations, policies and procedures.
* Check for event and observation accuracy and completion.
* Notify appropriate members of inter-disciplinary team regarding incomplete documentation and unverified or unsigned orders; collect documentation from unit box to fax/scan into the EMR and assign to individual resident Electronic Medical Record, including but not limited to labs, x-rays, consult notes, consents, hospital transfer records, etc.

* Provide appointment reminders to residents within 3-7 business days prior to appointments
* For all discharges, assure all signed documentation upon discharge are scanned and uploaded into Electronic Medial Record; complete all discharge tasks.
* Respond to requests for medical records, maintaining compliance with state and federal HIPAA laws; ensure all requests are complete and accurate prior to the release of documents; print all documents required.
* If subpoena for records is received, contact the State of Arizona Office of Attorney General for their review and direction prior to release; fax/mail to requesting party per policy and HIPAA regulations.
* Conduct quarterly/annual audits of observations, events, orders, preventative health and care plans; conduct a variety of ongoing audits, including but not limited to lab and radiology orders/reports, physician & nursing orders for accuracy of category, flow sheet & correct diagnosis, monitors and consents, resident weight and height.
* Updates physician visits in EMR; update face sheet as necessary.
* Schedule resident appointments, diagnostic testing, laboratory testing, dialysis, etc., schedule transportation to/from appointment both outside and to VAMC; contact insurance providers for authorization for appointments and transport.
* Initiate lab and x-ray requisitions based on orders and insurance requirements. Initiate requests and tracking process of consultation orders by gathering required documents, faxing, emailing and communicating with clinicians to obtain specialty appointments.
* Maintain unit calendars with laboratory scheduled, clinic appointments including dialysis and transportation arrangements.
* Run facility activity report daily to capture consult requests, labs and radiology orders. Fill out requisitions for consults, labs and radiology requests as needed. Attend and participate in a variety of meetings and in-service training.
* Learn, implement and monitor AMS methods; actively participate in AMS by attending Huddle board meetings and utlizing AMS concepts and tools for problem solving, work/process improvements and creating standard of work.
* Perform bi-annual in-service training on HIPAA for all staff meetings.

* Medical office practices
* Medical records maintenance and security paper and electronic

Ability to:
  

* Transcribe doctors’ orders

* Maintain confidentiality
* Handle multi-line phone

* Coordinate and schedule meetings
* Use of office equipment
* Learn and implement the concepts and tools of the Arizona Management System (AMS)

**We’re unique. You should be, too.**

We’re changing lives every day. For both our patients and our team members. Are you innovative and entrepreneurial minded? Is your work ethic and ambition off the charts? Do you inspire others with your kindness and joy?

We’re different than most primary care providers. We’re rapidly expanding and we need great people to join our team.

The Care Coordinator is a highly visible customer service and patient-focused role. They work directly with the organization’s patient population and their families to authorize, schedule, and ensure completion of patient visits with specialty care. This includes working with insurance representatives and outside vendors, arranging transportation, communicating with physicians, clinicians and other medical personnel, and any other entities necessary for successful completion of approved referrals.

**ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Serve as primary point of contact for incoming and outgoing patient referrals. Triage referrals, gather necessary information, ensure timely processing and assignment to appropriate providers.
* Facilitates communication, collaboration, and coordination of care. Coordinating appointments, referrals, transitions of care between primary care, specialists, hospitals, and other healthcare settings, ensuring seamless transitions and continuity of care.
* Schedules patients utilizing coordinated provider list (CPL), makes all necessary arrangements related to the appointment, notify patients of appointment information: date, time, and location.
* Uses web-based insurance platforms to generate referral authorizations.
* Effectively communicates the physicians/clinicians needs or outstanding items to patients.
* Follows all referrals through to completed appointment and obtains all documentation related to appointment, uploading into organization’s medical record system for physician review prior to PCP follow-up appointment.
* Ensures any missed external appointments are rescheduled and communicated to the PCP.
* Addresses referral-related phone calls from patients, providers, etc. Completes and addresses phone messages in a timely manner.
* Provides extraordinary customer service to all internal and external customers.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**
------------------------------------

* Knowledge of medical terminology, CPT, HCPCS and ICD coding desired
* An understanding of the company's patient population, including the complexities of Medicare programs
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to effectively prioritize and complete tasks in a timely manner.
* An understanding of the company's patient population, including the complexities of Medicare programs
* Detail-oriented with the ability to multi-task.
* Able to exercise proper phone etiquette.
* Ability to navigate proficiently through computer software systems & use technology.
* Ability to work well with patients, colleagues, physicians and other personnel in a professional manner.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, database, and presentation software.
* Spoken and written fluency in English; bilingual preferred.
* Flexible to work evening, weekends and/or holidays as needed

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE CRITERIA:**
--------------------------------------

* High School diploma or equivalent required
* A minimum of 1 year of referral experience in a healthcare setting required.
* Experience with web-based insurance sites and obtaining referrals/authorizations for multiple payors preferred.
* Experience with Web IVRs and obtaining referrals/authorizations for multiple payers strongly preferred
* Healthcare experience within the Medicare Advantage population preferred.

As a Patient Care Coordinator (PCC), you will be the welcoming face of our clinic, creating exceptional experiences for every patient who walks through our doors. In this role, you will oversee daily clinic operations, build strong patient relationships, understand and address patients' hearing healthcare needs, and help ensure the continued success and growth of the practice.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Greet and screen patients to determine how we can best support them
* Answer questions about services and promotions
* Spot potential leads and keep patient flow running smoothly
* Manage scheduling, daily office tasks, and financial and administrative duties
* Handle insurance verification, inventory, and patient records
* Partner with clinic and home office teams to support operations
* Assist with marketing efforts, events, outreach, and patient retention activities

**Who Thrives in This Role**

* Eager learners whose career is centered around working in a medical practice
* Strong multi-taskers with solid problem-solving skills
* Punctual, reliable professionals
* Individuals who genuinely love helping others in the medical industry while running a thriving practice

**Why It’s Rewarding**

You’re not just managing an office, you’re making a meaningful difference by helping patients feel supported, understood, and cared for throughout their journey to better hearing health.

**Job Type:** Full Time 32 - 40 hours a week, 8:30 am - 4:30 pm, No Weekends

  

**Location:** Philadelphia and Media, PA. Must be able to commute to both clinics

  

**Compensation**: $19.00 - $22.00 an hour. - Higher compensation reflects the candidate's availability and willingness to travel to a 3rd location ( Cherry Hill, NJ ) one day per week.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

7a6efbde9532fb7487d9.title: Patient Care Coordinator (Front Desk & Sales)
7a6efbde9532fb7487d9.description:
**Patient Care Coordinator (Front Desk & Sales) Pelvic Rehabilitation and Wellness Center | Manalapan, NJ$45,000 to $50,000 per year, depending on experienceFull-time, on-site | 40 hours per week | Monday through FridayImmediate openingA background check is required for employment.**

**About us**

Pelvic Rehabilitation and Wellness Center is a private-pay pelvic health practice in Manalapan, NJ. We provide one-on-one pelvic floor physical therapy in a calm, private setting. When appropriate, our care programs also include nutrition counseling, massage therapy, and access to our Restoration Suite.

**About the role**

As our Patient Care Coordinator, you’ll be the first person patients speak with and the first person they see when they arrive. That first interaction sets the standard for their experience with our practice. Many patients call about sensitive concerns. We hold our front desk to a high standard of professionalism and expect you to listen carefully, respond with warmth and discretion, explain options clearly, and follow through on what you promise.

This role combines patient scheduling, front desk operations, and sales. You’ll guide prospective patients from their first inquiry through evaluation and program enrollment while keeping the clinic schedule running smoothly.

Patient scheduling and front desk responsibilities

* Manage patient scheduling in Jane from the initial evaluation through the full course of care. Book evaluations, schedule follow-up visits at the frequency recommended by the therapist, and reserve recurring appointments when appropriate.
* Coordinate schedules across providers, confirm upcoming visits, and handle cancellations and rescheduling. Use the waitlist to fill openings and contact patients who still need to schedule their next visit.
* Welcome patients, manage check-in and checkout, and verify that intake forms and consents are complete before appointments.
* Process payments, track program and membership balances, and provide superbills. Explain how patients can submit superbills to their insurance company.
* Coordinate referrals, records requests, and faxes while protecting patient privacy.
* Keep the front desk, waiting area, and Restoration Suite organized and stocked. Complete end-of-day closing procedures.

Sales, follow-up, and patient enrollment

* Respond promptly to calls, texts, emails, and website inquiries. Explain our services and what to expect at an evaluation, then confidently invite the caller to schedule. Offer a complimentary consultation when appropriate.
* Discuss pricing, payment options, and out-of-network benefits clearly and professionally. Address questions and concerns with patience and confidence.
* Use GoHighLevel daily to follow up with new leads and prospective patients who haven’t booked. Review pending follow-ups, make calls and send messages through GoHighLevel, document the outcome, and schedule the next follow-up as needed.
* After the evaluation, walk patients through the therapist’s recommended program, answer questions about cost and scheduling, and complete enrollment.
* Meet weekly and monthly evaluation booking and program enrollment goals.

Qualifications

* At least one year of experience in patient coordination, front desk operations, or sales. Experience in a private-pay healthcare practice, dental office, medical spa, or boutique fitness setting is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to turn phone inquiries into booked appointments or sales.
* Excellent phone and written communication, including the ability to discuss sensitive topics and pricing with professionalism and discretion.
* Strong scheduling and organizational skills, with the ability to manage incoming calls, patient arrivals, and appointment changes throughout the day.
* Dependable follow-through. You return calls when promised, stay on top of follow-ups in GoHighLevel, and make sure each patient knows their next step.
* Experience with Jane, GoHighLevel, or similar scheduling and CRM systems is strongly preferred. Comfort using AI tools for routine administrative work is a plus.

Compensation and benefits

* $45,000 to $50,000 per year, depending on experience
* 10 days of paid vacation
* Paid time off for all major holidays when the clinic is closed
* Paid sick time in accordance with New Jersey law
* Complimentary access to Restoration Suite services
* Training on Jane and GoHighLevel

How to apply

Please submit your résumé and your earliest available start date.

Pay: $45,000.00 - $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid orientation
* Paid time off
* Paid training

Work Location: In person

aa9bd80b2bb6cd7a0d19.description:
Heartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs. By leveraging real-time data and AI-powered insights, Heartbeat Health empowers providers and patients with personalized treatment plans, reducing hospitalizations and improving long-term heart health outcomes. Heartbeat Health is redefining how cardiovascular care is delivered in the digital age, led by our medical group of cardiologists, advanced practitioners, nurses, and care coordinators.

  

### **About the Job:**

We are seeking a Patient Experience Coordinator to join our virtual clinic team. This is a full-time, remote position requiring availability to work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Central Time (CST/CDT).

This entry-level opportunity is ideal for individuals who are passionate about delivering exceptional patient experiences and eager to grow their careers in the healthcare technology industry. As a Patient Experience Coordinator, you will serve as a key point of contact for patients, helping them navigate their cardiovascular care journey while ensuring a seamless and supportive experience.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Patient Outreach & Engagement:** Proactively connect with patients via phone, text, and email to coordinate virtual appointments, schedule diagnostic testing (such as stress tests and echocardiograms), and support ongoing patient engagement.
* **Patient Support & Experience:** Deliver a high-quality, concierge-level experience by assisting patients with technical questions, navigating virtual care platforms, and ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout their care journey.
* **Operational Support:** Maintain accurate patient information, document interactions, identify opportunities for process improvement, and support efficient daily clinic operations.
* **Collaboration & Growth:** Work closely with clinical and operational teams to improve patient workflows, support new healthcare programs, and contribute to the continued growth of our virtual care services.

### **About You:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Social Work, Communications, Education, Sociology, Psychology, Health Sciences, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** At least 6 months of professional work or internship experience, preferably in a customer-facing or service-oriented environment.
* **Customer Service Focus:** Experience in high-touch, customer-facing roles such as hospitality, retail, food service, or call centers, with the ability to navigate fast-paced environments while maintaining professionalism and empathy.
* **People-Oriented:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for helping others, building relationships, and creating positive experiences.
* **Mission-Driven:** Genuine enthusiasm for supporting patients and making a meaningful impact on their healthcare experience and outcomes.
* **Tech-Savvy & Adaptable:** Comfortable navigating technology, maintaining accurate records, and learning new systems and healthcare platforms in a fast-paced, virtual environment.
* **Organization & Attention to Detail:** Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and provide timely follow-up to ensure a seamless patient experience.
* **Schedule Availability:** Ability to consistently work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Central Time (CST/CDT), regardless of location.

### **About Our Culture:**

* **We are mission-driven:** we're revolutionizing the way cardiovascular care is delivered
* **We are fast-paced & agile:** we move quickly, iterate often, and value experimentation
* **We are remote-first:** ownership, autonomy, and trust are at the core of how we operate
* **We care about diversity**: diversity allows us to build an excellent patient experience
* **We care about each other:** we are stronger together through a culture of mutual respect and active support.
* **We invest in our people:** Eligible employees have access to a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid holidays, sick time, a 401(k), and additional benefits designed to support you and your family.
* **We are an equal opportunity employer:** we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

* **Patient Outreach & Engagement:** Proactively connect with patients via phone, text, and email to coordinate virtual appointments, schedule diagnostic testing (such as stress tests and echocardiograms), and support ongoing patient engagement.

* **Operational Support:** Maintain accurate patient information, document interactions, identify opportunities for process improvement, and support efficient daily clinic operations.
* **Collaboration & Growth:** Work closely with clinical and operational teams to improve patient workflows, support new healthcare programs, and contribute to the continued growth of our virtual care services.

### **About You:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Social Work, Communications, Education, Sociology, Psychology, Health Sciences, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** At least 6 months of professional work or internship experience, preferably in a customer-facing or service-oriented environment.

* **People-Oriented:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for helping others, building relationships, and creating positive experiences.
* **Mission-Driven:** Genuine enthusiasm for supporting patients and making a meaningful impact on their healthcare experience and outcomes.
* **Tech-Savvy & Adaptable:** Comfortable navigating technology, maintaining accurate records, and learning new systems and healthcare platforms in a fast-paced, virtual environment.
* **Organization & Attention to Detail:** Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and provide timely follow-up to ensure a seamless patient experience.
* **Schedule Availability:** Ability to consistently work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT), regardless of location.

### **About Our Culture:**

* **We are mission-driven:** we're revolutionizing the way cardiovascular care is delivered
* **We are fast-paced & agile:** we move quickly, iterate often, and value experimentation
* **We are remote-first:** ownership, autonomy, and trust are at the core of how we operate

**Job Description**

***A Bit About This Role:***  
As a Member Service Guide II, Complaint Resolution at Devoted Health, you will play a vital role in resolving member grievances with accuracy, efficiency, and compassion. You’ll ensure cases are handled in compliance with regulatory requirements and within established timeframes, while also helping build trust with our members. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work across teams to ensure grievances are resolved fairly and thoroughly.

This position is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, empathetic, and committed to both regulatory compliance and delivering an exceptional member experience. You will uncover what members really need, recommend solutions that make things easier for them, help identify opportunities for process improvements, strengthen member relationships, and contribute to Devoted’s mission of caring for every person like family.

***Responsibilities and Impact Will Include:***

* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Devoted Health products, benefits, policies, and procedures
* Support a culture of continuous learning and member advocacy, helping Devoted fulfill its mission
* Conduct thorough investigations by reviewing case details, member records, and relevant policies and procedures to identify the root cause of member needs
* Independently resolve the majority of grievances, analyzing information across systems to determine appropriate solutions
* Recommend clear, practical solutions that address the root cause and minimize member effort, connecting members to Devoted programs and resources when appropriate
* Use sound judgment to escalate more complex situations when additional expertise is required
* Effectively triage work to ensure grievances are accurately categorized and routed
* Communicate with members through both written correspondence and telephone contact, meeting all regulatory requirements while fostering trust
* Adapt tone, pacing, and explanation to member needs, proactively clarify information, and confirm next steps
* Complete accurate documentation and data entry across multiple systems
* Ensure all grievances are resolved within required regulatory and departmental timelines
* Independently manage workload, adjust priorities based on volume and complexity, and flag capacity constraints or competing priorities early
* Collaborate with internal partners and teammates to gather information, resolve cases thoroughly, and share knowledge that helps peers improve
* Contribute to identifying themes and opportunities for improvement in processes or member experience
* Actively seek feedback, apply it consistently, and adjust quickly to changes in workflows, tools, or priorities
* **Flex into other teams’ work for short periods during non-peak volume as business priorities evolve.**

***Required Skills and Experience:***

* Experience with Medicare Advantage appeals and grievances
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Adaptability: Handles changing regulations, priorities, or case volumes with resilience and teamwork
* Excellent customer service and conflict resolution skills, particularly when interacting with members who may be frustrated or vulnerable
* Strong time management and organizational skills, with the ability to meet deadlines consistently
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely explain complex information
* Ability to obtain and maintain access to the CMS Health Plan Management System (HPMS), including completing any required access, security, and training steps.

***Desired Skills and Experience:***

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in healthcare, conflict resolution, or related field
* Working knowledge of insurance products, policies, procedures, and claims processes
* Superior investigative, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Experience escalating cases and collaborating with internal stakeholders when additional support is needed
* Strong computer and documentation skills, with comfort using multiple platforms

***Hours of Operation & Scheduling Expectations:***

* This is a five-day-a-week role. Our hours of operation are 8:00 AM – 2 AM ET, Monday through Friday. Your shift will be 8.5 hours, including a 30-minute lunch, and will fall within this window.
* This role may include weekend coverage on a rotating basis, up to one weekend per month. Schedules are subject to change based on business needs, including weekend on-call support.

***Salary range:*** $22.00 - $25.00 hourly

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

* Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium
* Generous paid time off
* $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend
* Stock options for all employees
* Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles
* Parental leave program
* 401K program
* And more....

* *Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.*

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

### ***Patient Scheduler II – Be the Go-To Support for Patient Care!***

Are you passionate about helping patients and thrive in a fast-paced healthcare environment? Do you love staying organized, solving problems, and making a real impact on the patient experience? Join GetixHealth as a Patient Scheduler and become a key part of our Patient Support Center team!

This is your opportunity to make a difference every day by helping patients get scheduled, verified, and prepared for care. From appointment coordination to insurance verification, your work helps ensure patients receive timely, accurate, and compassionate service.

If you have strong customer service skills, healthcare scheduling experience, and enjoy helping patients navigate the healthcare process, we’d love to hear from you.

-

**Position:** Full- Time

**Potential Start Date:** 11/30/2026

**Location:** Remote (Must pass an internet speed test/ we provide the equipment)

**Reports to**: Patient Support Center Supervisor

**Compensation:** $18- $20 per hour

**Operational Hours:** The operating hours for this position are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM CST. Employees will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week within these hours, including rotating weekends. (*Schedules are subject to change and based on the business need*)

-

#### **POSITION SUMMARY:**

Provide day-to-day support for patient scheduling operations, ensuring timely appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and excellent communication between patients, providers, and medical staff.

You’ll serve as the first point of contact for patients by scheduling appointments, confirming visits, collecting insurance details, and helping patients understand their financial responsibility prior to care. Strong communication skills, multitasking ability, and attention to detail are essential.

  

#### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for patients and external facilities to schedule appointments by phone and electronic correspondence
* Collect, verify, and communicate benefit details of patient insurance policies during scheduling
* Educate patients on the insurance verification process and estimated patient responsibility prior to their visit
* Confirm patient appointments and provide appointment details, location information, and special instructions
* Create and maintain patient records including demographic information and required paperwork
* Contact referring provider offices to obtain necessary records and visit preparation details
* Coordinate with healthcare providers and medical staff to ensure appointments are scheduled efficiently and effectively
* Respond to patient inquiries professionally and in a timely manner via phone and written communication
* Collaborate with internal teams and third-party systems to support coordinated patient care
* Assist insurance verification associates when needed
* Maintain HIPAA compliance and confidentiality at all times
* Other duties as assigned

#### **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* High school diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* 2+ years of customer service, appointment scheduling, or healthcare experience required
* 1+ years of EHR system experience (Epic preferred)
* 1+ years of remote work experience preferred, especially in high-volume inbound and outbound call environments
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent problem-solving and conflict resolution skills
* Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Office, and other computer systems
* Strong customer service mindset with compassion and professionalism
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA regulations

  

#### **SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:**

* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Dependable, punctual, and able to manage time effectively
* Adaptable and open to change in a dynamic healthcare environment
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think critically
* Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills
* Empathetic and patient-focused approach to service
* Professional communication and customer service skills

  

#### **WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Remote position requiring high-speed internet and a secure HIPAA-compliant workspace
* Prolonged sitting and regular computer use required
* Exposure to sensitive and confidential patient information
* Occasional overtime may be required based on workload and business demands

  

#### **WHY JOIN GETIXHEALTH?:**

Founded in 1992, GetixHealth is a trusted leader in healthcare revenue cycle management, with offices across the U.S. and India. We’re more than revenue cycle experts—we’re a mission-driven team dedicated to helping healthcare organizations improve financial outcomes while delivering compassionate care. With over 1,800 employees, we foster a culture that values professionalism, innovation, and—above all—people.

  

#### **BENEFITS & INCENTIVES:**

* **Comprehensive Health Benefits:** Choose from a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans designed to support your overall well-being.
* **Life & Disability Coverage:** Receive company-paid Basic Life and AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage, with the option to purchase additional voluntary Life and AD&D benefits.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Become eligible to participate in the company's 401(k) plan on the first day of the quarter following three months of continuous employment, with a company match to help you invest in your future.
* **Paid Time Off:** Begin accruing PTO on your first day of employment, promoting a healthy work-life balance from the start.
* **Flexible Benefit Options:** Tailor your benefits package with a variety of options to meet your individual and family needs.

  

***GetixHealth is an Equal Opportunity and E-Verify Employer.***

**Note:**This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities or qualifications and may be subject to change based on business needs.

About Green Medical Consulting

Green Medical Consulting, LLC is a growing, nurse-owned healthcare agency providing skilled nursing, Direct Support Professional (DSP) services, companion services, respite care, and other Pennsylvania Office of Developmental Programs (ODP) services to individuals with intellectual disabilities and autism.

We are seeking a highly organized, motivated, and experienced **ODP Operations Coordinator** to assist with daily office operations, referral development, employee recruitment, onboarding, scheduling, and regulatory compliance.

**This is an in-office position. Candidates must have prior experience working with Pennsylvania ODP providers and understand ODP policies, procedures, and service requirements.**

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can work independently, solve problems, communicate professionally, and help our agency expand while maintaining quality services.

Key Responsibilities

**Referral Management & Business Development**

* Establish and maintain professional relationships with Supports Coordinators (SCs) and Supports Coordination Organizations (SCOs).
* Conduct consistent outreach to SCs to request new referrals for nursing, DSP, respite, and other authorized services.
* Follow up on referrals and coordinate the intake process.
* Maintain a referral tracking system and monitor referral outcomes.
* Schedule meet-and-greets with individuals, families, and prospective staff.
* Assist with expanding services throughout Pennsylvania.

**Recruitment & Employee Onboarding**

* Post job openings on Indeed and other recruiting platforms.
* Screen applicants, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate hiring.
* Collect and verify employee credentials, background clearances, employment documents, and required training records.
* Maintain organized and compliant employee personnel files.
* Track employee training, certifications, and expiration dates.
* Coordinate employee orientation and onboarding.

**Scheduling & Daily Operations**

* Create and maintain schedules for LPNs, RNs, DSPs, and other direct care staff.
* Address scheduling conflicts, employee call-outs, and shift coverage needs.
* Communicate schedule changes with staff, individuals, and families.
* Maintain accurate scheduling and employee information in AxisCare.
* Assist with employee timekeeping and payroll preparation.
* Respond to routine operational concerns and escalate urgent matters appropriately.

**ODP Compliance & Documentation**

* Assist with maintaining compliance with Pennsylvania ODP Chapter 6100 regulations.
* Understand Consolidated Waiver, Community Living Waiver, and P/FDS Waiver service requirements.
* Maintain accurate employee and individual documentation.
* Monitor required staff training, background checks, and qualifications.
* Assist with preparation for ODP monitoring, audits, and licensing reviews.
* Support incident reporting and documentation according to agency policies and applicable ODP requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality and protect sensitive information.

Required Qualifications

* **Minimum 2 years of experience working with a Pennsylvania ODP provider in an administrative, coordination, or management role.**
* Strong working knowledge of Pennsylvania ODP regulations, policies, and procedures.
* Experience communicating with Supports Coordinators and SCOs.
* Experience with employee recruitment, onboarding, and scheduling.
* Familiarity with HCSIS, PROMISe, and ODP service authorizations.
* Understanding of employee qualification and training requirements under Chapter 6100.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, email, spreadsheets, and electronic documentation systems.
* Ability to work on-site in Elkins Park, Pennsylvania.

Preferred Qualifications

* 3–5 years of experience in ODP provider operations.
* Previous experience as an ODP Operations Coordinator, Program Manager, Office Manager, or Administrative Manager.
* Experience using AxisCare or similar home care scheduling software.
* Familiarity with EIM incident reporting requirements.
* Experience developing relationships with SCOs and generating new referrals.
* Knowledge of nursing and DSP staffing operations.
* Experience assisting an agency with growth and expansion.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who takes initiative and does not require constant supervision.

The ideal candidate should be able to:

* Independently manage daily office responsibilities.
* Identify and resolve staffing and scheduling challenges.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with SCs.
* Follow through on referrals from initial contact through service coordination.
* Keep employee documentation organized and up to date.
* Prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
* Help improve office efficiency and support agency growth.

Compensation & Schedule

* Part-time, approximately 15–20 hours weekly.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their resume through Indeed.

Please include a brief description of your experience with ODP regulations, SC/SCO referrals, employee onboarding, and scheduling.

On the finance side, you’ll handle day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable. On the events side, you’ll support our sales and marketing team by managing the logistics behind conferences, trade shows, internal meetings, and occasional client visits. This position can be part-time or full-time with a consistent weekly schedule, depending on the right fit. We’re looking for someone who wants to build a long-term home with our team. **What You Bring**

* Experience with meeting or event coordination, customer service, or administrative support is preferred

* Reliable and consistent, with strong follow-through and ownership of your work

4b3f794314d6693feb5f.title: Office Manager / Operations & Client Engagement Manager
4b3f794314d6693feb5f.company: The SciTech & IP Law Firm PLLC
4b3f794314d6693feb5f.description:
**Help build a growing law firm serving the people building what comes next.**

Our clients build things involving science, technology, and intellectual property. Your mission: make sure their first inquiry does not disappear into an inbox, their consultation lands on the right calendar, and the next step is clear.

We are seeking a resourceful, organized, tech-savvy professional to work directly with our founder, manage intake and follow-up, coordinate outside specialists, and bring structure to the everyday work of a growing business.

Think client traffic control: keep inquiries moving, coordinate arrivals, and flag problems early. No runway experience required.

**About the Firm**

The SciTech & IP Law Firm PLLC is a technology-focused boutique at the intersection of science, technology, and law. We advise innovators, entrepreneurs, startups, technology companies, and research-driven ventures on patents, trademarks, technology transactions, and related matters.

Our clients work across software, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, healthcare, robotics, defense, gaming, media, and consumer products.

**The Role**

Your priorities are client intake, first conversations, lead follow-up, scheduling, client communication, vendor coordination, and accurate use of our CRM and intake tools.

You will work alongside our marketing intern, website and SEO specialist, and outsourced providers. The Managing Attorney sets priorities, approves significant changes and spending, and retains oversight. You do not need to know every tool on day one, but you do need to learn quickly, communicate clearly, and follow through.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Serve as a professional first point of contact by phone, email, and approved intake channels.

· Conduct non-legal intake conversations using approved questions and templates; gather accurate information and route legal questions to the attorney.

· Follow up with prospects and referral sources, schedule consultations, send reminders, and coordinate rescheduling.

· Maintain accurate CRM records, lead sources, follow-up tasks, and next steps.

· Coordinate attorney-approved engagement paperwork, onboarding communications, and administrative client updates.

· Keep administrative calendars, task lists, operational timelines, subscriptions, and firm records organized.

· Create practical checklists and document repeatable processes.

· Coordinate vendor requests, meetings, updates, and deliverables; flag delays and decisions requiring approval.

· Work with bookkeeping, payroll/HR, IT, cybersecurity, website/SEO, marketing, and automation providers as engaged. Support IP-vendor logistics as directed by the attorney.

· Coordinate billing information and administrative payment questions with the Managing Attorney and bookkeeper.

· Test intake forms, booking links, and approved workflows; document issues, coordinate specialist support, and confirm fixes.

· Make routine administrative or website-content updates within your training and access permissions.

· Support approved outreach and marketing activities with the marketing intern and specialists.

· Track lead sources, response times, bookings, and follow-up completion; provide concise operational updates.

· Follow firm policies for confidentiality, system access, and approved AI use.

**Required Qualifications**

· Tech-savvy: Comfortable learning and using digital tools, navigating unfamiliar software, troubleshooting routine issues, and explaining problems clearly when specialist support is needed. Coding and advanced IT expertise are not required.

· Comfort with Microsoft 365, shared calendars, online scheduling, CRM or contact-management systems, and shared documents.

· Excellent written and verbal communication and a professional phone presence.

· Relevant experience in administration, operations, intake, client service, customer service, or a comparable role. Internships, campus leadership, and substantive projects may qualify.

· Strong organization, attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and sound judgment about confidentiality, priorities, and escalation.

· Ability to work independently while keeping the Managing Attorney appropriately informed.

· Reliable availability for at least 20 hours per week within the stated schedule.

Required: Comfort in a Startup or Founder-Led Environment

You must be comfortable working in a startup, early-stage company, or founder-led business where processes are still developing and priorities may evolve.

You should be able to turn agreed priorities into practical next steps, bring structure to incomplete processes, ask clarifying questions, and follow through without step-by-step instructions. You must also recognize when to seek approval or specialist support and work within agreed hours, priorities, and role boundaries.

Prior startup experience is preferred, not required. Comfort with this working style is required.

**Preferred Experience**

· WordPress: Experience editing pages, formatting content, uploading images, and updating forms or service listings. Familiarity with Bricks, FluentCRM, Fluent Forms, or FluentBooking is a plus. Custom development, hosting, security, and complex integrations remain with technical specialists.

· Working with a founder or in a startup, small business, law firm, or growing professional services business.

· Client intake, scheduling, onboarding, referral follow-up, vendor coordination, or process improvement.

· Marketing coordination, professional outreach, or basic operational reporting.

· Administrative use of SharePoint, Teams, Teams Phone, Microsoft Bookings, or Stripe.

· Interest in or exposure to intellectual property, science, technology, or life sciences.

A technical degree, coding portfolio, advanced SEO expertise, and specialist accounting experience are not required. Law students and graduates interested in firm operations are welcome; this is not a legal internship.

**Clear Role Boundaries**

You are not expected to be an entire professional services department. Legal advice, substantive legal decisions, docketing, and the backup legal deadline calendar remain with the attorney and designated legal operations staff. Accounting specialists handle trust accounting, reconciliations, payroll, and tax filings. Technical specialists handle cybersecurity, custom development, and complex systems work.

Your role is coordination, dependable communication, and practical execution—not independent authority over specialist work, firm strategy, or spending.

**What Success Looks Like**

Timely responses, consistent follow-up, accurate records, coordinated consultations, tracked vendor commitments, and problems surfaced early with useful context. Fewer loose ends—and more time for the attorney to focus on legal work.

Bring non-urgent updates to an agreed morning check-in on scheduled workdays. Escalate time-sensitive client issues and suspected security incidents promptly.

**Compensation, Schedule & Training**

Starting compensation: $20–$30 per hour during the initial 60-day training period, based on experience.

Compensation growth: After training, compensation reviews will consider documented progress against a clearly defined skills-and-responsibilities checklist established by the firm and shared during onboarding. You will build a record of mastered skills over time.

Progressive hourly rate increases will be evaluated using measurable criteria, demonstrated proficiency, consistent performance, and responsibilities handled independently—not simply time in the role. Increases are subject to firm needs, budget, and approval and are not automatic or guaranteed.

· Fully remote, part-time employee position; minimum 20 hours per week.

· An agreed schedule Monday–Friday within 10:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Central Time, supporting client coverage and team coordination. Additional hours require prior approval.

· Hands-on training from the Managing Attorney.

· Long-term opportunity with potential for expanded responsibilities; full-time conversion is not promised.

The initial 60 days include a 1–2 week assessment of fit. Employment is at will throughout; completing either period does not change that status.

**Why Join Us?**

Work directly with the founder, help build practical systems, and see the impact of your contributions. Gain exposure to innovative businesses while developing your capabilities through direct feedback, specialist collaboration, and a defined skills-development framework.

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed and include:

· Your resume and, if available, LinkedIn profile.

· A brief note describing your relevant experience and interest in this role.

· A short writing sample, such as a professional follow-up email or process guide, with confidential information removed.

· Your pay expectations and availability within the stated schedule.

· A brief response: A prospect submits an incomplete intake form but has not booked a consultation. How would you follow up, document the interaction, and decide what to route to the attorney?

· A brief response: A vendor misses a promised delivery date for an intake-system update. How would you coordinate next steps and keep the Managing Attorney informed?

* If you have startup or founder-led business experience, include an example of improving a process or keeping work moving as priorities changed. Otherwise, explain what makes you comfortable in that environment. Applications must include a writing sample and answers to both questions. No coding portfolio is required.

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience with WordPress, updating listing?

Experience:

* Office: 3 years (Required)

Shift availability:

* Day Shift (Required)

Work Location: Remote

5d6ae666b114d0741b5f.title: Logistics Coordinator
5d6ae666b114d0741b5f.description:
**Job Overview**

Uncapped 50/50 commission split with consistent company- or team-provided leads, mentorship, and administrative/transaction support. We are a small Veteran Owned Freight Brokerage looking to add another teamate dedicated to learning and growing in the freight industry.

**Freight Broker**

Act as the intermediary connecting shippers who need to move freight with reliable carriers. You’ll negotiate rates, source capacity, book loads, and manage shipments from pickup through delivery while building relationships on both sides. Your impact: Matching the right capacity to customer needs keeps freight moving on time, supports competitive pricing and healthy margins, and strengthens a profitable book of business.

**Duties**

* Source and negotiate freight rates with shippers and carriers; prepare quotes and rate confirmations that balance service quality with margin.
* Identify, vet, and book carriers through load boards (DAT, Truckstop, etc.), your carrier network, and TMS; coordinate pickups, deliveries, and in-transit tracking.
* Monitor shipment status, provide proactive updates, and resolve exceptions such as delays, capacity issues, or service failures.
* Manage key documentation including rate confirmations, bills of lading, carrier packets, and proof of delivery; ensure compliance with FMCSA requirements (authority, insurance, safety ratings).
* Build and maintain relationships with shippers and carriers; support account management, new business opportunities, and overall revenue goals.
* Analyze lane rates, market conditions, and load performance using Excel, TMS platforms, and rate tools to improve coverage and profitability.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between shippers and carriers for domestic (and international, as needed) transportation planning and customer service.

**Experience**

* Experience in freight brokerage, transportation sales, carrier relations, dispatch, or logistics operations is relevant. Direct freight broker or agent experience is preferred.
* Strong negotiation, relationship-building, communication, and problem-solving skills; ability to manage multiple loads and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with transportation management systems (TMS), load boards, rate tools, and standard freight documentation.
* Knowledge of freight modes (truckload, LTL, intermodal), pricing, contracts, margins, and basic FMCSA compliance is valuable.
* Analytical skills including Excel; experience with market rate analysis is an asset. Physical warehouse or material-handling experience is not required.

Pay: $15,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
