**You could be a recruiting coordinator anywhere. Why Jerry.ai?**

* Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway: We are tackling a $2T market, have $240M in funding, 60X revenue growth, and we’re profitable.
* Launch your career in recruiting. We’re committed to mentoring and promoting high performers into Recruiter or Sourcer roles as you learn our hiring bar and how the business runs.
* You’ll build, not just execute. You’ll run scheduling and logistics, but you’ll also have the autonomy to improve systems, fix bottlenecks, and make the whole team faster and more effective.

**Why contract-to-perm?**

At Jerry.ai, we move quickly and our hiring bar is high. We treat interview coordination like white-glove operations rather than just admin support. The contract phase (3 months) is a chance for both sides to see if we’re the right match. You’ll get a front-row seat to our "high ownership, high impact" culture. If you thrive on urgency and precision, the path to a permanent role here is clear.

**About the opportunity:**

You will be the operational backbone of our recruiting engine, owning the interview scheduling and logistics to make sure every candidate experiences a seamless, high-touch process end to end.

We’re looking for a high-velocity operator who doesn’t just execute tasks, but anticipates what’s next, removes friction before it appears, and helps the recruiting team move faster, smarter, and more effectively. You’ll act as a true force multiplier for our recruiting engine, your work will directly shape our ability to attract and hire top talent at Jerry.ai.

**How you will make an impact:**

* Provide "white-glove" service to candidates by sending personalized pre-interview info and managing LinkedIn outreach
* Manage the lifecycle of take-home assignments, maintain candidate profiles in Ashby ATS, and ensure all candidate documents are accessible to those who need them
* Manage recruiter calendars with precision, rearranging interviews on the fly to prioritize high-impact candidates and maximize our daily capacity
* Act as the point person for leadership’s urgent recruiting needs, whether it's updating compensation bands, posting new job reqs, or coordinating the training/shadowing of new interviewers

**Who you are:**

* You can’t stand inefficiency: You’re always spotting ways to automate, streamline, and level-up how work gets done, and you enjoy turning messy processes into clean, scalable systems.
* You have an intense sense of urgency: You don't wait for things to happen, you *make* them happen. You move quickly, close loops fast, and thrive in environments where priorities shift and speed matters.
* Your attention to detail is impeccable: You catch the small things that others miss. Your written communication is clear, polished and professional, and you keep processes tight so nothing slips.
* You are a proactive problem solver: You’re calm under pressure, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You can handle high-stakes, time-sensitive requests from leadership without losing focus or pace.

**Ideal profile:**

* Prior experience in a fast-growth startup or a high-volume agency environment is strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree

*While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.*

***Please note:*** ***Jerry.ai*** ***is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.***

*Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.*

*Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at* *recruiting@jerry.ai*

*The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.*

*We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.*

**About Jerry.ai**

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

Compensation Range: $55K - $75K

fa8a8ceca0956cbc94c8.title: da Vinci Specialist
fa8a8ceca0956cbc94c8.description:
* Wilmington, DE, United States
* Remote Available
* Sales
* JOB220547

  

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

* **Please note: Candidates must live within or be willing to relocate to the Wilmington, DE area to perform the duties of this role.**

**Primary Function of Position**  
The DaVinci Specialist (DVS) will provide expert clinical & technical support, build, customize and coordinate education & training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of DaVinci surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Clinical Sales Representative and Clinical Sales Manager, to ensure safe and effective product adoption and quality control while driving positive patient outcomes.

The DaVinci Specialist is a dedicated program execution & clinical education partner for hospitals running a da Vinci robotic surgery program. Based on its expertise, this role focuses on identifies and tailors the nature and extent of staff in-servicing, day-to-day program execution, technology onboarding and operational support, communicating identified needs to hospital OR operations and leadership. The DVS will work alongside the da Vinci Clinical Sales Representative .

**Essential Job Duties**

**Collaboration & Field Partnership (Within a CSM Team)**

* Partner with the local CSR/CSM and cross-functional business partners to create, own, scale and execute best practices and deployment of ecosystem resources.
* Lead account support plans that drive safe program execution and increase customer autonomy over time, including setting objectives, timelines and resources for relevant customers, in consultation with CSR/CSM.
* Identify, solicit and provide field feedback and customer insights to internal teams to improve training, support resources, and customer experience.
* Support adoption of digital solutions by helping customers build comfort and capability through in-servicing and troubleshooting.

**Clinical & Technical Support**

* Identify and provide on-site, non-scrubbed operating room support for procedures utilizing the da Vinci Surgical System and associated technologies.

* Support OR teams with room readiness and procedural workflow, including system setup support, docking workflow support, and intraoperative troubleshooting.
* Serve as a clinical product expert to help ensure optimal, safe system use and adherence to applicable IFUs, hospital policies, and safety protocols.
* Motivate and support adoption of advanced instruments and accessories by ensuring teams understand proper setup, handling, and intended use.

* Partner with and promote consistent readiness and workflow by supporting day-to-day execution of the robotic program, coordinating with OR leadership, nursing, SPD/sterile processing, and biomedical teams.
* Assist with operational support activities such as facilitating appropriate internal handoffs for service needs.
* Ensure the right stakeholders are aligned (OR, SPD, biomed, IT) for successful day-to-day operation and new technology onboarding to help reduce friction.
* Maintain accurate internal documentation of support activities per company process (e.g., case support notes, training records, service/escalation tracking).

**Training & Education (Care Team Enablement)**

* Determine the need for, customize and deliver customer-specific hands-on training and in-services to nurses, surgical technologists, SPD teams, and other care team members on safe and effective use of da Vinci platforms and associated technologies.
* Support onboarding and education for new users through structured training touchpoints (e.g., new staff orientation, refresher training, workflow standardization).
* Lead new site start-ups by identifying and delivering onboarding programs and coordinating training logistics with the CSR/CSM and hospital stakeholders.
* Support new technology installs by coordinating readiness activities and providing post-install education to care teams.
* Act as a resource for ongoing education, product updates, and workflow optimization.

**Escalation & Customer Issue Management**

* Analyze and leverage utilization, turnover, and other relevant case data to recommend operational changes to customers
* Provide first-line support and expertise for common setup and workflow issues during live cases and training sessions.
* Identify, resolve and where necessary escalate issues appropriately to internal partners (e.g., Technical Support, Field Service, Clinical/Medical counterparts).

**Market & Clinical Insights**

* Collect and communicate customer feedback *and experiences* to clinical counterparts and internal business partners. Prioritizing, distilling and reporting relevant customer feedback, in real time.
* Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
* Assist in clinical trial support when required.
* Assist in field action activities when necessary.

### **Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Experience: 2+ years in an operating room-related role
* Clinical experience is preferred.
* Experience as a robotics coordinator, surgical assistant, and/or surgical nurse plus industry experience strongly preferred.
* Understanding of soft tissue anatomy & procedures.
* Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies.
* Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work in high-pressure environments (managing multiple ORs) and coordination of multiple tasks at one time.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures.
* Team oriented with a commercial mindset.
* Willingness to travel up to 40%. Primary travel will be within a CSM team.
* Ability to travel within a Clinical Sales Manager team geography, supporting multiple hospitals.
* Flexibility to support early starts, after-hours cases, and weekend procedures based on customer need and territory utilization.

**Required Education and Training**

* Associates degree. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Degrees in (RN, PA, NP, RT, or other clinical credentials) are welcomed.

**Working Conditions**

* Ability to stand for extended periods and provide in-person case support within an operating room (OR) environment, which includes pushing, pulling, lifting and squatting.

### **Additional Information**

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay + CIP, benefits, and equity. The target pay rate for this position is:

**Base salary region 1:** $115,500

**Base salary region 2:** $105,000

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

5885cbc86f8147e12afa.title: Coronary Principal Clinical Specialist - Columbus, OH
5885cbc86f8147e12afa.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 21 Nov 2026  
  

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the Columbus, OH area and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.  

**Bring your clinical talents to a leader in medical technology and healthcare solutions. Rooted in our long history of mission-driven innovation, our medical technologies open doors. We support your growth with the training, mentorship, and guidance you need to own your future success. Join us for a career in clinical and sales support as we engineer the extraordinary and change lives.**

  

**Position Description:**

Provide technical, educational and sales support to assist the district in meeting assigned Coronary sales and customer service objectives with a heavy emphasis on supporting CathWorks FFRangio. Coronary seeks collaborative candidates who are patient-centric, passionate, and who represent the same wide variety of life experiences as our patients. We look for candidates who will meet our customer expectations by striving without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products, processes and systems by being accountable, having a voice, and taking action. This position will be the customer's first line contact for the Coronary daily operations at assigned accounts.

  

**\*\* This position is a field-based and regional role. Must be able to travel up to 70% of the time within regions\*\***

  

**POSTION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Sales Support for Coronary business units and will assist with the implementation of the sales strategy of the remaining Coronary business units.

* Support the regional Coronary sales strategy as set forth by the National Sales Director; working with sales representatives and managers of all business units to achieve business plans.

The Clinical Specialist Manager (CSM) and National Sales Director may include primary responsibility for sales if no other sales representative is assigned to the business unit.  

  

Technical Support:

* Represents Medtronic during procedures and implants of products to provide troubleshooting and other technical assistance.

Receives technical inquiries by telephone. Research solutions to questions or problems (e.g. product selection issues, technical questions about Medtronic Coronary products when appropriate, etc.)  

  

Educational Support:

* Educates and trains physicians, hospital personnel and office staff on technical matters relating to our products and pacing through conducting and/or coordinating:

* 1. One-on-one training sessions

* 2. In-service education programs

* 3. Seminars and/or outside symposiums

* Assist DM, CSM and in-house training department in educating/training new Clinical Specialists and sales representatives.

Provide training and resources for hospital staff to enable them to conduct training for their personnel (“train the trainer”).  

  

Sales Support:

* During/following cases:

* Complete necessary documentation and phone calls (customer service).

* Update sales representatives concerning cases. Immediately notifies representatives regarding issues or problems requiring follow-up.

* Serves as effective Medtronic representative to physicians and support staff regarding Medtronic products, service, and support.

* Maintain current knowledge regarding Coronary, Medtronic programs, products and services and competitive products.

* Maintains open, effective communication with all district personnel, customers, and other Medtronic employees

Performs other related duties as assigned  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* High School Diploma and a minimum 11 years of work experience in healthcare, field sales or work experience utilizing complex mathematics, mechanical concepts, science, or computing **- OR-** Associate degree and a minimum 9 years of work experience **- OR-** Bachelor’s Degree plus 7 years of experience

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Relevant industry, healthcare, industry, marketing, or medical education experience considered where there is specific focus on awareness and education or medical project management.

* Expertise with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint and system tracking.

* Strong project management skills and experience coordinating and executing marketing programs.

* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

* Excellent work ethic

* Thorough working knowledge of medical terminology, medical procedures, and the medical device industry.

* Excellent customer service skills and problem resolution skills.

Ability to effectively build and maintain positive relationships with peers and colleagues across organizational levels.  

  

**Physical Job Requirements:**

* Continuous verbal and written communication.

* Frequent 2-handed lifting of up to 40 lbs. from floor to chair/table and from one to another surface at approximately the same level

* Sitting, standing and/or walking for up to eight plus hours per day

* Environmental exposures include eye protection, infectious disease and radiation

* Ability to wear 7-9 lbs of lead for extended periods of time while in the O.R.

* Frequently required to use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls

* Ability to effectively use a mobile phone, PC, keyboard and mouse

* Frequent bending/stooping, squatting and balance

* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus in relation to travel and operating a personal computer

* Ability to travel extensively with ease

* Must be able to drive approximately 80% of the time within assigned territory

* Environmental exposure to infectious disease and radiation

* Must have a valid driver's license and active vehicle insurance policy. In addition, your driving record will be reviewed and will be considered as part of your application.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

**Physical Job Requirements**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

**U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship**

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.
‌

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .
‌

**Benefits & Compensation**
===========================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**  
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):$120,000 - $120,000
‌  
In addition to Base Salary, this position is eligible for a Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), which provides the opportunity to earn significant incentive compensation for achieving or exceeding your goals.
  
  
Learn more about total rewards here.

IMPAXX is looking for a CMS Submission Coordinator to join our growing team.

IMPAXX is a Medicare compliance company supporting the Property/Casualty industry, with a focus on workers’ compensation and liability claim settlements involving bodily injury. We provide nationwide settlement and compliance solutions designed to help clients resolve claims more efficiently, maintain compliance, and manage settlement costs. Core services include Medicare Set-Aside arrangements, MSA administration, lien resolution, structured settlements, and Mandatory Insurer Reporting.

The CMS Submission Coordinator serves as a liaison between insurers, third-party administrators, attorneys, and Medicare throughout the CMS submission process. This role is responsible for managing assigned non-complex submissions, reviewing and interpreting Medicare correspondence and requests, communicating requirements to customers, and helping ensure timely and accurate responses. The position requires strong written and verbal communication, customer service, attention to detail, and an understanding of the Medicare submission process and review thresholds. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  

* Serve as the primary contact for assigned non-complex CMS submissions, identifying and escalating complex requests as appropriate.

* Analyze Medicare requests and clearly communicate required information and next steps to customers by email and phone.

* Notify customers of incoming Medicare correspondence within established turnaround times.
* Respond promptly and professionally to customer calls and emails, addressing questions and concerns throughout the submission process.
* Communicate CMS submission processes, review thresholds, and relevant product delivery considerations to customers.
* Engage with Medicare and its contractors to obtain answers to case-specific questions when necessary.
* Coordinate additional assessments with other IMPAXX teams and collaborate across teams to meet customer needs and internal service standards.
* Monitor CMS trends and share relevant information with teammates and customers.
* Review assigned exception reports and prepare a daily Work Condition Report.
* Escalate customer concerns to the Team Leader, CMS Submissions for review and resolution.
* Cross-train with teammates in similar roles to provide backup support as needed.

* Strictly adhere to company confidentiality policies and procedures, safeguarding sensitive information at all times.

**Qualifications**

ddc3306f87043e705bb8.title: Consult Coordinator I
ddc3306f87043e705bb8.description:
Posted Rate is for Consult Coordinator I. Experienced Consult Coordinators may be eligible for higher rates for II and III position levels.

#### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Consult Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for prospective patients from initial inquiry through the surgical consultation, guiding them through the intake and pre-consultation stage of gender-affirming surgery. This role reviews new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions to confirm that required paperwork and documentation are complete; schedules consultations; and coordinates with providers, insurance verification, and financial counseling so that patients arrive at their consultation informed and prepared. Once a patient has completed the consultation and is confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, the Consult Coordinator completes a documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, who manages the patient through surgery scheduling, surgery, and postoperative follow-up. This is a nonclinical position and does not involve clinical assessment, medical advice, or medical decision-making.

#### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective and new patients from initial inquiry through completion of the surgical consultation.
* Respond to new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions received by phone, email, patient portal, or other approved channels within established response timelines.
* Explain the practice’s intake and consultation process, required documentation, general timelines, and what patients can expect before and after their consultation.
* Review intake packets and referral submissions for completeness, confirming receipt of required items such as demographic information, insurance information, identification, intake and consent forms, medical records, and letters of support or referral, as required by practice protocols and payer requirements.
* Identify missing, incomplete, expired, or inconsistent documentation and follow up with patients, referring providers, and outside offices to obtain it within established timelines.
* Route documentation requiring clinical review to the appropriate provider or clinical staff. The Consult Coordinator confirms that documents are present and complete but does not evaluate their clinical content or adequacy.
* Coordinate with insurance verification and financial counseling to confirm that eligibility, benefits, and any consultationrelated referral or authorization requirements are addressed before the consultation.
* Schedule, confirm, and reschedule inperson and telehealth consultations, and send appointment details, preconsultation instructions, and reminders.
* Serve as a liaison between assigned providers and prospective patients during the preconsultation stage for nonclinical questions, scheduling, and documentation needs.
* Conduct regular checkins with patients during the preconsultation period to keep them informed of outstanding requirements and next steps.
* Track each prospective patient’s status from inquiry through consultation, and maintain an accurate, current consult pipeline in the appropriate systems.
* Following the consultation, confirm the provider’s documented outcome and communicate nonclinical next steps to the patient.
* For patients confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, complete a timely, documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, including documentation status, any outstanding items, and relevant patient communication preferences.
* For patients who are not proceeding, or who must complete additional requirements before proceeding, communicate next steps as directed by the provider and document the patient’s status accordingly.
* Communicate outstanding requirements, scheduling changes, and next steps clearly and compassionately.
* Escalate complex patient concerns, documentation barriers, or operational issues to the appropriate department or leader.
* Accurately document patient communication, documentation review, status updates, and completed milestones in the appropriate systems.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and practice policies, including when requesting and receiving records from outside providers.
* Provide respectful, compassionate, and genderaffirming support without providing clinical advice, medical education, or medical decisionmaking.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance sufficient to meet the position’s operational, patientservice, and team obligations, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Comply with applicable laws, regulations, accreditation requirements, privacy and security standards, and organizational policies relevant to the position.
* Other duties as assigned.

The essential functions listed are intended to describe the fundamental duties of the position. A qualified individual must be able to perform these functions with or without reasonable accommodation. The organization will engage in a timely, good-faith interactive process when an accommodation is requested or the need for accommodation is known.

#### **MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered.
* Experience: Experience in patient intake, patient coordination, healthcare administration, medical records, customer service, scheduling, or a similar patientfacing administrative role.
* Licensure/Certification: No specific license or certification required unless assigned by the organization.
* Knowledge/Skills: Strong written and verbal communication; ability to explain processes and documentation requirements clearly; strong attention to detail when reviewing documents for completeness and accuracy; strong organization and followthrough; ability to manage a high volume of inquiries and competing priorities; accurate documentation; comfort using electronic systems, email, phones, and practicemanagement tools; ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Other: Ability to provide respectful, compassionate, and genderaffirming support to patients and to comply with HIPAA, privacy, security, and organizational policies.

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in newpatient intake, referral coordination, or consultation scheduling in a medical office, surgical practice, or specialty care setting.
* Familiarity with insurance eligibility, referral and authorization requirements, financial counseling, or medical records request workflows.
* Familiarity with documentation commonly required for genderaffirming surgery, such as letters of support aligned with WPATH Standards of Care and payer criteria.
* Experience supporting transgender, nonbinary, or genderdiverse patients in a healthcare or communityservice setting.
* Experience using electronic health record, practicemanagement, CRM, or tasktracking systems.
* Bilingual or multilingual communication skills aligned with patient population needs.

#### **WORK SCHEDULE, LOCATION, AND TRAVEL**

* Schedule: MondayFriday, 7:30 a.m.4:30 p.m. Pacific, with flexibility as needed to meet patientservice, scheduling, and operational needs. Overtime must be approved in accordance with organizational policy.
* Location: Remote position. Regular availability during business hours is an essential function because the role supports timely response to new patient inquiries and coordination across departments.
* Travel: None or occasional local travel, if assigned for meetings, training, or operational support.

353bcd287161a3db128a.title: Assistant Construction Project Manager
353bcd287161a3db128a.description:
***FULL-TIME, ON-SITE POSITION — MEDIA, PA***

***Residential construction or skilled-trades experience required. This is not a remote, hybrid, IT, or software project management position.***

**Chimney Cricket** is a full-service chimney, fireplace, and hearth company serving homeowners throughout the greater Philadelphia region. Our work includes chimney restoration and masonry, fireplace installation, venting systems, gas and wood appliances, and other residential construction and home-service projects.

We are looking for an experienced **Project Operations Coordinator** to coordinate residential fireplace and hearth restoration and installation projects from approval through completion.

**This is not an entry-level administrative project coordinator position. We are specifically looking for someone with experience coordinating construction, remodeling, trades, or field-service projects.** The right candidate understands what it takes to move a physical project from a sold scope of work to a completed job—including scheduling crews, reviewing job requirements, coordinating materials and equipment, working with vendors, communicating with customers, and working with field techs to solve problems when conditions change.

The Project Operations Coordinator works closely with our Operations Manager, sales team, technicians, installers, vendors, and customers to make sure every project is properly prepared before a crew arrives and stays on track through completion.

**Construction Project Coordination**

You will manage the operational side of multiple active residential construction and installation projects. This requires understanding project scope, anticipating what crews need to complete the work, and identifying potential problems before they affect the schedule.

* Manage projects from sales approval through completion and closeout
* Review scopes of work, estimates, job documentation, photos, measurements, and project requirements
* Coordinate project readiness, deposits, scheduling, materials, equipment, and crew requirements
* Maintain communication between sales, customers, field crews, vendors, and management
* Track multiple active projects and proactively identify scheduling, material, or job-readiness issues
* Coordinate changes or unexpected field conditions that affect project execution
* Visit active job sites to review progress, quality, project conditions, customer satisfaction, and crew needs
* Help ensure crews arrive with the information, materials, equipment, and preparation necessary to complete the project successfully

**Project Administration & Closeout**

Strong documentation matters, but this position requires more than simply maintaining paperwork. You will use project documentation to understand what is happening in the field and help keep projects moving.

* Review technician paperwork, job notes, photos, and project documentation
* Monitor project labor and technician timesheets
* Ensure required project documentation is complete and accurate
* Track outstanding project items and follow them through resolution
* Coordinate project completion, closeout, and handoff to billing

**Purchasing & Material Coordination**

Construction experience is particularly valuable in this area. Our projects may require appliances, venting components, masonry materials, fabricated products, specialty parts, and other job-specific materials.

* Review project material and equipment requirements
* Order materials, venting, equipment, and specialty components
* Coordinate purchasing with manufacturers, distributors, and local suppliers
* Track purchase orders, lead times, backorders, and delivery dates
* Verify orders for accuracy before projects are staged
* Identify material issues that could affect project schedules
* Maintain organized purchasing and project records

**Safety Program Coordination**

Safety is one of Chimney Cricket's core values. This position also supports the Operations Manager in coordinating and maintaining our company safety program.

* Maintain company safety documentation, incident records, and OSHA logs
* Coordinate safety meetings, training sessions, and toolbox talks
* Track employee safety certifications and training requirements
* Maintain SDS, equipment, and other required safety documentation
* Assist with incident documentation and coordination with outside safety consultants

**Required Qualifications**

* **Minimum 2 years of experience coordinating residential construction, remodeling, installation, or skilled-trade field projects. Experience exclusively in IT, software, or corporate project management does not meet this requirement.**
* Experience coordinating **multiple active field projects** involving crews, schedules, materials, customers, vendors, and changing job-site conditions
* Working understanding of how residential construction or skilled-trade projects move from estimate/sale through planning, procurement, field execution, and completion
* Experience reviewing scopes of work, job documentation, material requirements, and project schedules
* Ability to anticipate project needs and identify missing information, materials, or job-readiness issues before sending a crew
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
* Confident communication with homeowners, field technicians, vendors, salespeople, and management
* Comfortable visiting active residential construction/job sites
* Proficient with business software, project-management systems, and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in one or more of the following industries is strongly preferred:

* Residential construction or remodeling
* HVAC
* Roofing
* Chimney, fireplace, or masonry
* Plumbing
* Electrical
* General contracting
* Specialty trades or home services

Additional preferred experience includes:

* Construction purchasing and material procurement
* Coordinating subcontractors and field crews
* Inventory or warehouse coordination
* Reading construction scopes, plans, specifications, or manufacturer documentation
* OSHA documentation, safety programs, or construction safety compliance

**Who Will Be Successful in This Role**

This position is a good fit for someone who has worked around construction projects long enough to understand that **the plan on paper and what happens in the field aren't always the same thing**.

You should be comfortable looking at a project and asking questions such as: Do we have everything the crew needs? Are the materials correct? Is the site actually ready? Are there access or scheduling issues? Is something missing from the scope? Does the customer understand what is happening? What could prevent us from completing this job as scheduled?

We're looking for someone who doesn't simply track problems after they happen—we want someone who **anticipates them and helps solve them before they affect the project.**

**Our Core Values**

* **RESPECT** – We are prepared, on time, and treat people right.
* **INTEGRITY** – We do what we say and own the outcome.
* **SAFETY** – We protect people, property, and the reputation of our company.
* **EXCELLENCE** – We pursue quality outcomes and continuous improvement.

8da62b51bca6ff392367.description:
Help us make money feel a little less complicated.

At **Money Honey Financial**, we believe great financial service should feel personal, approachable, and empowering.

We're a growing, woman-owned accounting firm helping individuals and business owners navigate taxes, bookkeeping, and financial decisions with confidence. We take our work seriously, but we believe the experience of working with an accountant should feel anything but intimidating.

We're building something special, and we're looking for the right person to grow with us.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Client Experience Coordinator** who loves people, thrives on organization, and takes pride in making things run smoothly.

You'll be the friendly voice, organized mind, and dependable presence that helps keep our clients informed, supported, and confident throughout their experience with Money Honey.

From welcoming new clients to coordinating tax appointments and keeping important documents moving, you'll play a key role in ensuring our clients receive the exceptional service they deserve.

**This isn't a tax preparation position.** Instead, you'll work alongside our accountants and bookkeepers, helping create the seamless experience that allows our entire team to do its best work.

And because we're a growing firm, you'll have opportunities to contribute ideas, improve processes, take ownership of projects, and grow professionally.

What You'll Be Doing

**Create an exceptional client experience**

* Be a welcoming and professional first point of contact for clients by phone, email, and in person.
* Guide new clients through onboarding, including welcome communications, engagement letters, questionnaires, and document collection.
* Help clients navigate our online portals, scheduling systems, and administrative processes.
* Coordinate appointments, respond to inquiries, and ensure clients receive timely updates.
* Build genuine relationships with clients and help them feel valued, informed, and supported.

**Keep our team organized and moving forward**

* Monitor outstanding client requests, missing documents, and upcoming deadlines.
* Proactively follow up with clients to keep tax and bookkeeping projects moving.
* Maintain accurate client records, contact information, and important documentation.
* Coordinate administrative aspects of client offboarding and transitions.
* Help ensure that no client request, important document, or follow-up falls through the cracks.

**Support our tax and bookkeeping operations**

* Coordinate the collection of bank statements, financial records, and account access needed by our bookkeeping team.
* Assist with sending tax organizers, appointment reminders, and seasonal communications.
* Prepare and coordinate administrative tax forms, including IRS authorization forms.
* Assist with IRS and state correspondence, document submissions, and tracking notices.
* Monitor administrative deadlines and keep the team informed of outstanding items.

**Help us create the Money Honey experience**

* Coordinate thoughtful client appreciation initiatives, including holiday gifts and special milestones.
* Identify opportunities to make our client communications and processes even better.
* Collaborate with our team to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.
* Bring fresh ideas, positive energy, and a solutions-oriented mindset to the office.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

We're looking for someone who does more than complete a to-do list. Our ideal candidate takes ownership, anticipates needs, and finds satisfaction in keeping people and processes organized.

You'll thrive here if you:

* Have 2+ years of experience in administrative coordination, client services, or office operations, preferably in a professional services environment.
* Are a natural problem-solver who takes initiative and follows through without constant reminders.
* Can confidently manage multiple client requests, competing priorities, and deadlines.
* Communicate professionally and warmly, even when handling difficult conversations.
* Are comfortable holding clients accountable for providing the information our team needs.
* Have strong attention to detail and take pride in getting things right.
* Enjoy creating systems, improving processes, and finding more efficient ways to work.
* Understand the importance of discretion when handling confidential financial information.

**You don't need to know everything about taxes or accounting to succeed here.** We're happy to train someone who brings the right attitude, strong organizational skills, and a genuine commitment to client service.

Why Join Money Honey Financial?

We're not your traditional accounting firm, and that's intentional.

We're creating a workplace where professionalism meets personality, clients feel like people rather than numbers, and team members have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**Here's what you can look forward to:**

* **Stability:** A permanent, year-round position with a growing firm.
* **Meaningful work:** You'll play an important role in helping entrepreneurs and individuals feel more confident about their finances.
* **A supportive team:** Work alongside a collaborative group that values communication, accountability, and helping one another succeed.
* **Professional development:** Receive hands-on training in our systems, processes, and accounting firm operations.
* **Room to grow:** As our firm expands, we want our team members to have opportunities to expand their skills and responsibilities.
* **A workplace with personality:** We believe you can deliver exceptional professional service while still being approachable, authentic, and human.

**Ready to Grow With Us?**

If you're organized, people-focused, proactive, and excited about joining a growing business where your work truly matters, we'd love to meet you.

**Come help us deliver the Money Honey experience.**

Pay: $19.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Paid time off

Your responsibilities encompass greeting and assisting patients, managing appointments, maintaining accurate records, and providing essential administrative support. Additionally, you are responsible for obtaining authorizations and facilitating insurance-related processes to support the delivery of healthcare services.

Who We Are:

JAG Physical Therapy’s care-first model of rehabilitation may be the change you are looking for! JAG Physical Therapy, a comprehensive outpatient, orthopedic physical therapy company with 100 facilities throughout Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and New York, is seeking compassionate and motivated individuals to join our winning team! JAG has been honored by the area’s top publications as the best in the business based on growth and outcomes and is considered the Gold Standard for physical therapy care by the Metro area’s largest healthcare systems and insurance providers.

What You’ll Love About Us:

* Competitive pay

* Support for ongoing education and training

* Opportunities for advanced growth including team leader, regional manager, and director

* Provided uniforms

* Health, Dental, & Vision Benefits

* HSA Options including dependent care, medical, and commuter benefits

* $10,000.00 Term Life Insurance benefit at NO cost to employees

* up to 3 weeks PTO

* 401(k) with company match

* Yearly review for growth opportunities

* Tuition discounts for employees and their families

* TicketsAtWork and LifeMart company perks

* Our workplace fosters a close-knit and supportive environment where individuals genuinely care for and uplift one another, creating a strong sense of unity and camaraderie

  

What You’ll Need:

* High school diploma or equivalent.

* Completion of a medical assistant certificate program preferred.

* 1+ years of experience working as a medical receptionist/administrative assistant in the health care field.

* Excellent organizational and time management skills

* Strong interpersonal communication skills

* Ability to work independently or as part of a team

* Availability to travel throughout JAG locations for coverage. Following the JAG Travel policy.

  

What You’ll Do:

* Greeting patients and other visitors in the medical office.

* Answer patient questions and provide assistance and directions when necessary.

* Field all phone calls that arrive using our general office number.

* Daily collection of patient financial responsibility

* Knowledge of Workers’ Compensation and Auto claim submissions.

Description:

**ABOUT VISANTE**

We are relentless in solving the most complex challenges in health system pharmacy—designing **pharmacy footprints that meet our clients where they are today and position them to win tomorrow**. Our work delivers measurable financial gains, operational excellence, and an elevated patient experience.

We set ambitious goals, move with urgency, and create extraordinary value. Obsessed with client impact, we thrive in a collaborative, innovative culture where deep expertise turns insight into action. We’re proud of the results we deliver and the trust we earn—fueling sustained growth and exceptional client satisfaction.

**Our mission is to transform healthcare through pharmacy, and our vision is to reimagine pharmacy to improve lives.**

**ABOUT THE POSITION (Fully Remote)**

The Supervisor, Medication Access Specialist - Medical Benefit is a key member of Visante's managed services team and is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of medication access specialists supporting medical benefit services. Reporting to Visante leadership, the supervisor provides direct oversight of team members, including scheduling, recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, and professional development to ensure a high-performing and engaged workforce.

This position serves as a subject matter expert in medical benefit access and reimbursement, benefits investigations, prior authorizations, coverage denials, patient assistance programs, and financial assistance resources. The supervisor provides guidance and support for complex patient access cases, escalated authorization requests, payer policy interpretation, and reimbursement challenges while promoting timely access to therapy.

Collaboration is critical to this role, as the supervisor works closely with clients, pharmacists, providers, clinic personnel, pharmacies, payers, and Visante team members to enhance operational workflows, improve patient access, and support successful treatment initiation. The supervisor monitors key performance indicators, quality outcomes, and operational trends to drive continuous improvement and maintain service excellence.

This role requires strong leadership abilities, expertise in medication reimbursement and medical benefit processes, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to advancing patient care through improved medication access and operational efficiency.

**Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily operations and staffing for assigned teams to ensure adequate resources meet client needs and project demands.
* Adjust staff schedules and address workflow gaps to maintain operational efficiency and service continuity.
* Assist with recruit, hire, evaluate, and retain personnel to support a high-performing and engaged team.
* Proactively address personnel issues and establish clear expectations for performance and workplace behavior.
* Provide coaching, feedback, and professional development to enhance staff success, accountability, and job satisfaction.
* Coordinate training initiatives, competency assessments, and quality review activities to strengthen team capabilities.
* Respond to client inquiries and triage requests promptly to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to patient access, productivity, satisfaction, and workflow efficiency, implementing corrective actions as needed.
* Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, privacy requirements, and organizational policies, including completion of employee competencies.
* Review medication authorizations and determine appropriate actions based on patient, payer, and client needs.
* Conduct benefits investigations, assess coverage and out-of-pocket costs, and identify financial assistance options to reduce patient burden.
* Collaborate with clinics to obtain required documentation, submit prior authorizations, and support appeals for coverage denials.
* Communicate authorization determinations and next steps to patients, including coverage outcomes, financial assistance options, and pharmacy access pathways.
* Ensure accurate and timely documentation within client EMR systems and Visante tracking platforms in accordance with agreed-upon workflows.
* Support client onboarding, training, workflow optimization, and continuous process improvement while collaborating with Visante leadership and team members.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**Education**

**Required:** High school diploma or equivalent

**Preferred:** An Associate Degree

**Experience**

**Required:** 3 years of experience working within healthcare or with pharmacy providers on medication access

**Preferred:** Minimum of 1 year experience supervising or managing a team, including staff scheduling, performance management, and professional development.

**Licensure**

**Required:** State Board of Pharmacy Technician registration obtained within 6 months of hire

**Preferred:** Active CPhT certification through either PTCB or NHA

**Skills and Abilities**

* Demonstration of good judgment, multi-tasking and meeting deadlines with a sense of urgency, and being able to prioritize
* Exhibits good judgment and ability to multi-task, prioritize, and meet deadlines with a sense of urgency in the face of competing demands.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and ability to cultivate strong client relationships.
* Proven analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Clear and concise communication, ensuring transparency within the team.
* Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality.
* Possesses extensive knowledge of medication reimbursement and healthcare prior authorization/coding.
* Proficiency in Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Analyzes and disseminates information effectively, showcasing strong analytical skills.
* Excellent conflict resolution skills, fostering a positive team environment.
* Strong leadership skills, supervising a high-performing team, and fostering a culture of accountability.
* High attention to detail, ensuring thoroughness and efficiency in team deliverables.

**Compensation and Benefits:** ***We offer competitive salary and benefits for this full-time salaried role.***

Visante is, therefore, committed to maintaining an environment free of discrimination, harassment, and violence. This means there can be no deference because of age, religion or creed, gender, gender identity or expression, race, color, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations

**About Sagility**
------------------

Sagility combines industry-leading technology and transformation-driven BPM services with decades of healthcare domain expertise to help clients draw closer to their members. The company optimizes the entire member/patient experience through service offerings for clinical, case management, member engagement, provider solutions, payment integrity, claims cost containment, and analytics. Sagility has more than 25,000 employees across 5 countries.

**Job title:**

Remote Customer Service Representative (Healthcare)

**Job Description:**

**Work From Home | Healthcare Coverage Review Representative**
==============================================================

**Build Your Career in Healthcare, From the Comfort of Home!**
--------------------------------------------------------------

  
  

**Are you passionate about helping others, solving problems, and making a difference in healthcare? Your next career opportunity could be with Sagility!**

  
  

At Sagility, we believe every interaction is an opportunity to make healthcare simpler, more accessible, and more personal. We're looking for motivated, detail-oriented professionals with healthcare and customer service experience to join our growing team of **Coverage Review Representatives**.

In this role, you'll help members, healthcare providers, and medical offices navigate prescription medication coverage, understand benefits, and obtain important information about prior authorizations.

  
  

If you enjoy helping people, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to build your career with a healthcare industry leader, **we want to hear from you!**

  
  

**What Makes This Opportunity Great?**
--------------------------------------

* **100% Remote:** Work from home in an eligible U.S. location.
* **Weekly Pay:** Get paid every week!
* **Competitive Compensation:** Earn $16.00 per hour during training and nesting, increasing to $16.50 per hour once in production.
* **Earn More During Training:** Qualify for performance incentives of up to an additional $2.00 per hour during training and nesting, bringing your potential earnings to **$18.00 per hour!**
* **Paid Training:** Receive two weeks of structured training followed by two weeks of supported, hands-on nesting.
* **Meaningful Work:** Help patients and healthcare providers navigate important medication coverage decisions.
* **Career Development:** Gain valuable experience in healthcare operations, pharmacy benefits, and coverage review.

*Performance incentives are based on meeting established quality, accuracy, attendance, and schedule adherence requirements. Additional details will be provided during training.*

  
  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

As a Coverage Review Representative, you'll serve as a trusted resource for members, healthcare providers, and other healthcare professionals seeking information about prescription medication coverage.

Your daily responsibilities will include:

* Answer inbound calls from members, physicians' offices, and healthcare partners regarding prescription medication benefits and coverage.
* Verify member eligibility and determine medication coverage under applicable healthcare plans.
* Assist callers with understanding medication coverage options and prior authorization requirements.
* Provide updates on prior authorization requests and coordinate with appropriate departments.
* Review medication inquiries, documentation, and requests for additional information.
* Contact healthcare providers to obtain necessary information and support timely resolution.
* Accurately document interactions, update records, and enter information into multiple systems.
* Deliver professional, compassionate, and accurate customer service while meeting established quality and performance expectations.
  

  

**Your attention to detail and commitment to service will help make a meaningful difference in the healthcare experience.**

**What You'll Bring to the Team**
---------------------------------

  
  

We're looking for individuals who are dependable, adaptable, comfortable with technology, and committed to delivering exceptional service.

  
  

**Required Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* At least 6 months of call center experience.
* At least 1 year of experience in healthcare, medical claims, or medical administration.
* At least 1 year of recent continuous employment with a previous employer.
* Working knowledge of medical and healthcare terminology.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent computer navigation, keyboarding, and data entry skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn multiple software applications.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to multitask.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  

  

**Your Work Schedule & Training**
---------------------------------

  
  

**Business Hours:** MondayâFriday, 7:00 AMâ8:00 PM Central Time. Candidates must be available to work an assigned schedule within these hours.

**Training Schedule:** MondayâFriday, 7:30 AMâ4:00 PM Central Time.

**Training Program:**

* 2 weeks of instructor-led training.
* 2 weeks of supported nesting to help you transition into production.

**Important:** Full attendance is required during training, and candidates must commit to no planned time off during their first 90 days of employment.

  
  

**Work From Home Requirements**
-------------------------------

To be successful in this remote position, you'll need a dedicated, secure workspace and reliable technology.

**Internet Requirements:**

* Reliable, hardwired internet connection.
* Internet speeds exceeding 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload.
* Ethernet connection required; Wi-Fi and mobile hotspots are not permitted.

**Equipment You Will Provide:**

* Monitor measuring 19 inches or larger with VGA or HDMI connectivity and the corresponding cable.
* USB wired mouse.
* Ethernet cable long enough to connect directly to your modem or router.
* Optional USB wired keyboard.

**Equipment Sagility Provides:**

* Workstation (laptop, desktop, or USB boot device, as applicable).
* USB webcam for the BHIVE platform.
* 4-port USB hub.
* USB wired headset with microphone.
  

  

**Our Virtual Workplace, BHIVE**

This position uses BHIVE, a virtual workplace platform designed to support remote team collaboration, communication, productivity, and time tracking.

BHIVE requires an active webcam positioned to provide a continuous profile view of your workspace, including your monitors, keyboard, head, shoulders, and hands throughout the workday.

Candidates must be comfortable working in this camera-enabled virtual environment.

  
  

**Ready to Make Your Next Career Move?**
----------------------------------------

**Your healthcare experience matters. Put it to work in a role where you can help others, develop valuable skills, and grow professionally all while working from home!**

  
  

**Don't wait for the perfect opportunity to find you. Take the next step toward your future with Sagility today!**

### **About Sagility**

Sagility is a leading healthcare business process management services provider dedicated to improving the experiences of healthcare members, patients, and providers.

By combining healthcare industry expertise, innovative technology, and compassionate service, we help our clients deliver better healthcare experiences.

At Sagility, our people make the difference. Join a team where your skills, dedication, and commitment to helping others can create a lasting impact.

  
  

**Your next chapter starts here. Apply today!**

  
  

**Sagility is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Vet/Disability.**

  
  

**Location:**

United States of America

* One year or more of work experience in a customer service setting with an excellent attendance and punctuality record.
* Work experience in a health care environment, preferred.
* Knowledge of group health plans, government health plans, automobile and workers compensation plans, preferred.
* Customer-focused interpersonal and communication skills.
* Computer literacy and ability to enter a substantial amount of data while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
* Work independently in a rapidly changing environment.
