a17be161ce5b35ac3c0d.title: Senior Warehouse Operations Manager - Automation
a17be161ce5b35ac3c0d.description:
**About Fullscript**

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.

That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.

We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: *helping people get better.*

**This is your invitation.**

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people. Join us and shape the future of care.

**The Opportunity**
===================

**Location: Ashland, Virgina**

***\*This role is based on-site in Ashland, Virginia.*** ***Relocation assistance is available, if needed, to help offset moving if the successful candidate does not already reside in the commutable area\****

We’re looking for an experienced operations leader to help shape the future of our newly automated distribution center on-site in Ashland, Virginia. As **Senior Warehouse Operations Manager**, you’ll own day-to-day site performance while playing a central role in building out our automation capabilities, from implementing and optimizing robotics to redesigning workflows that help our people and technology work better together. This is a role for a trail-blazer who has experience building out automation and robotics capabilities from the ground up.

In addition, you’ll lead and develop a team of Supervisors and Warehouse Associates, setting clear expectations for excellence and providing the training, protocols and support they need to succeed. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you’ll turn operational insights into improvements in safety, quality, productivity, and order accuracy. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can deliver reliable results today while building the systems, automation processes, and team capabilities we’ll need to thrive as we scale.

**What you'll do:**

* Steer the direction, inform and optimize the new automation workflow and robotics capabilities within the warehouse, to ensure highly effective process and measurable efficiencies.
* Develop, train and mentor the warehouse team members including the Site leadership team, to ensure a cohesive and highly productive work environment that successfully hits KPIs consistently
* Act as a Leader within the department and organization. Primary point of contact for all Warehouse Operations Supervisors.
* Work cohesively with organizational leadership members to drive company and department initiatives forward.
* Monitor and assist Warehouse Operations Supervisors with all daily warehouse operations, including inbound freight, receiving purchase orders, stocking storage locations, vendor interaction, quality control, trouble-shooting inventory issues, and picking/packing/shipping of customer orders.
* Ensure work areas are safe, and that employees are following proper work distribution centre safety procedures and protocols and administering corrective action when regulations/guidelines are not followed.
* Responsible for creating and maintaining daily work schedules (scheduling overtime, ending work shifts early if work volume dictates, etc) to ensure business needs are met.
* Ensure time and attendance data is completed accurately within the company timekeeping system, including employee punch edits when necessary and tracking attendance occurrences (late arrivals, unexcused absences, etc.).
* Respond to emergencies in a managerial and technical capacity.
* Manage all facets of the Warehouse Management System to ensure data integrity and smooth, consistent operational processes.
* Constantly look for new and innovative ways to increase the effectiveness of automation workflows, labor and system resources - ability to design and implement lasting positive change.
* Understand and lead the NSF preparation and audit needs.
* Serve as Sanitation Supervisor, maintaining a safe, clean, secure facility and directing internal sanitation, housekeeping, outside contractor cleaning, and pest control practices.

**What you bring to the table:**

* Post-Secondary Education in either Business, Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management (or relevant fields) preferred.
* 5+ years of experience effectively leading teams of 80 or more in a warehouse environment; including hiring, documentation, termination, training, and acting as an effective change agent.
* Proven experience specifically implementing, steering and building out the process for new automation and robotics capabilities within a distribution center warehouse.
* Proven experience evaluating, implementing, and optimizing warehouse automation technologies - such as conveyor systems, sortation, goods to person, pick-to-light, robotics, or automated storage solutions to improve accuracy, productivity, and scalability.
* Experience managing and developing salaried exempt leaders.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Thorough understanding of warehouse and distribution center procedures and concepts.
* Ability to make difficult decisions, solve problems, prioritize assignments, generate and utilize reports, and manage projects.
* Advanced experience with ERP & WMS systems, as well as Microsoft Office Suite and/or Google Suite.
* Knowledgeable and/or trained in housekeeping, sanitation, and pest control processes.
* Willingness and ability to travel as needed to other site locations, especially as we build our automation capabilities out further across our other Distribution Centre locations across the USA.

**What we can offer you**:

* Competitive pay and eligible to participate in performance based bonus plan
* 401k and matching program
* Generous Flex-Time Off policies
* Flexible benefits package (medical, dental, vision) and workplace wellness program
* Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives
* Discounts on Fullscript catalog of products
* A comfortable workplace with a fun team culture: Enjoy an air-conditioned warehouse, themed weeks, and opportunities to connect and celebrate with your team.

**Compensation range**

The salary range for this role is between **$120,000 and $150,000 (USD)**. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.  
  
Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

**Why Fullscript**

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

**What to Know Before You Apply**

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

**A quick note:** Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.

Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at accommodations@fullscript.com.

All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.

We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

  

**Learn More**

**www.fullscript.com**

**@fullscriptHQ**on instagram

**@fullscript**on YouTube

**FullScript** on LinkedIn

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

6afd40bcae1f567cada8.title: Senior Manager, Customer Operations
6afd40bcae1f567cada8.description:
**Job Description:**

**Summary**

**We are looking to hire two roles; one will be dedicated to managing an East Coast regional team and one will be dedicated to managing a West Coast regional team. This will be determined by employee location.**

  

* Senior leadership role will be accountable for the day-to-day performance and continued development of assigned Technical Customer Support teams; leads Technical Support Analysts and owns key service outcomes across case execution, workload management, team capacity, and adoption of new workflows and products.
* Exercises independent judgment with urgency; uses dashboards, case data, customer feedback, and operational trends to identify emerging risks, recurring issues, and performance gaps, and translates those insights into measurable, timely actions.
* Leads the response to significant customer escalations by establishing clear ownership, aligning technical and business resources, maintaining effective communication, and driving issues to appropriate resolution.
* Partners cross-functionally with Development, Product, Operations, Quality, and IT to accelerate resolution of customer-impacting issues, improve supportability, and reduce repeat problems.
* Drives consistent case-management practices — including prioritization, case hygiene, aging controls, and escalation management — and builds scalable operating mechanisms, quality controls, and knowledge resources that enable consistent, high-quality service delivery.
* Works with Global Support Leadership to translate departmental objectives into tactical and operational plans; prepares and presents accurate performance updates to senior leadership, including trends, risks, corrective actions, and resource considerations.
* Builds a customer-focused, accountable, and inclusive team culture; leads organizational change with clear communication, stakeholder alignment, practical execution plans, and disciplined follow-through.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise Customer Support, Technical Support, or Service Management, including significant experience leading technical support organizations.
* 5+ years of people leadership experience, with demonstrated experience directly leading Technical Support Analysts or other technical support professionals.
* Demonstrated experience managing Support KPIs, customer escalations, case backlogs, and cross-functional resolution efforts in a technical support environment.
* Technical credibility in enterprise SaaS environments; ability to lead technical teams, engage constructively with engineers, and translate complex technical issues into customer and business impact without serving as the primary hands-on technical resource.
* Strong analytical and operational capability, including proficiency interpreting dashboards, case trends, performance data, and customer feedback to drive data-informed decisions and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, including effective communication with customers, cross-functional partners, and senior leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience applying automation, AI-enabled tools, or advanced analytics to improve support operations, service quality, and the customer experience.
* One or more service or project-management certifications, such as ITIL, HDI, or PMI.
* Demonstrated experience with operations excellence, quality management, continuous improvement, and change-management practices within a technical support function.
* Familiarity with digital customer-service delivery across multiple support channels and self-service capabilities.
* Experience preparing and managing operational budgets, reviewing variances, and implementing corrective actions in a support operations context.
* Equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience accepted in lieu of a formal degree.

**COMMENTS:**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.

**Vertex Values: Together We Win**
==================================

We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.

ef0ed4cb9be164f711d5.title: Coordinator, Clinical Operations
ef0ed4cb9be164f711d5.description:
At Cogstate, we're advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate's assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we're supporting a multinational Alzheimer's trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we're not just imagining the future of brain health - we're building it.

That's why we're seeking a Clinical Operations Coordinator, accountable for supporting the operational delivery of a variety of contracted services in a Clinical Trial. These services include Rater Training and Monitoring activities (training deployment, management, and in-study reporting/calibration), Clinician Network Management (ensuring quality and consistency across global clinical interviews), Data Management (opening and resolving data queries), and Scale Management (binder creation, translations, logistics & shipping).

The daily workload for the above functional areas will fluctuate throughout the life cycle of a Clinical Trial. The Clinical Operations Coordinator will be cross trained to support multiple functional areas, flexibly jumping in to assist study teams according to their changing bandwidth needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with study teams across a variety of functional areas to ease bandwidth strain on Coordinator responsibilities detailed below.
* Processing clinician/rater forms and documenting data via status trackers and ePortal/LMS training systems.
* Review and process submitted clinician/rater surveys and deploy applicable LMS training modules.
* Schedule 1:1 training video conferences between site raters and Cogstate Rater Services staff
* Hardware shipment scheduling and documentation management.
* Documenting real time updates to applicable status trackers, coordinating high volume email correspondence, communicating status updates to clinicians/raters, electronic records filing.
* Point of contact for clinician/rater support questions.
* Direct communication with site coordinators at clinical settings, activity and communication tracking and general support throughout study.
* Interact with CRAs for site monitoring activities.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or 1+ years of related experience.
* Previous project management or administrative support experience preferable
* Microsoft Office proficiency.

**What's In It For You**

* In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in Cogstate's short-term incentive (STI) bonus program, with a target bonus opportunity of 5% of annual base salary, subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan.
* Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
* Generous Paid Time-off: Cogstate employees receive 20 days of vacation leave, 10 days of personal leave and 10 paid public holidays.
* 401(k) Matching: As you invest in yourself and your future, Cogstate invests in you too: we match up to3% of your yearly salary in Cogstate's 401k program.
* Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the position.
* Health, Dental & Vision Coverage: We've invested in comprehensive health & dental insurance options with competitive company contributions to help when you need it most. We also offer free vision insurance for all full-time employees.
* Short-Term & Long Term Disability Life Insurance: 100% employer sponsored
* Pre-Tax Benefits: Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
* Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.

**Our Culture**  
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We're courageous and we deliver together. We're passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We're brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you're ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

e91b004ec58cb90f4f1f.title: Inventory Coordinator
e91b004ec58cb90f4f1f.description:
**There’s a Place for You at Crawford Electric Supply.**

  

A career at **Crawford Electric Supply** is more than a job. You’re investing in a brighter, more sustainable future together and joining a team that makes a real difference for our customers. **Crawford Electric Supply** offers electrical products and services to contractors. If it helps bring electricity to an office, home, factory or other building – you can find it here. We operate throughout the southeast region of the United States, and are part of the Sonepar group, the world’s #1 electrical distributor with over 45,000 associates around the globe.

  

Being “Powered by Difference” means we respect and value diverse perspectives. **Crawford Electric Supply** we offer a supportive culture and great benefits, and as part of the larger Sonepar group, we can offer exciting opportunities to grow your career.

  

***It’s time to energize your future! Don’t miss out on this electrifying opportunity – apply today! Stay connected with us – follow our journey, job openings, and latest news on*** ***LinkedIn*** ***and*** ***Facebook******.***

  

**Position:**

Inventory Coordinator

  

**Location:**

Frisco, Texas (THIS IS NOT A REMOTE JOB)

**About Crawford:**

  
  

If you are looking for a company who is committed to building a relationship with you, who encourages having fun at work, who is powered by difference, and who is passionate about your future, it’s time to apply at Crawford Electric Supply. Known in the electrical distribution industry for being a great place to work and build a career, Crawford prides itself on being a business partner rather than just an electrical supplier to its customers. Everyday Crawford associates provide the best customer experience while at the same time offering the widest variety of electrical products on the market. For the past 30 years, Crawford has built a culture of growth, opportunity, innovative thinking, and stability for its employees by truly living up to the company motto of, “Whatever it Takes!” through our mindset competencies below:

  
  

**Adapt:** Effectively embrace new situation and people

**Dare:** Appropriately challenge the status quo

**Learn:** Learn from others, from mistakes, and self-improve

**Responsibilities**

**Role Purpose:**
  
Onsite local field resource responsible for jobsite execution, scanning materials, replenishing stock, maintaining inventory accuracy, and supporting the Material Solutions Team.

The Inventory Coordinator, BASE Power serves as Crawford’s dedicated onsite material-management resource supporting assigned BASE Power operations.

This hands-on, customer-facing role is responsible for keeping critical electrical material available, accurate, organized, and moving so BASE electricians and field teams can perform their work without unnecessary material delays.

The Inventory Coordinator owns day-to-day execution of the assigned location’s Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) and consignment programs, including receiving, stocking, replenishment, inventory accuracy, material requests, returns, and communication with BASE personnel and Crawford support teams.

The expectation is not simply to count inventory. The Inventory Coordinator must understand what the location needs, identify problems before they become disruptions, communicate quickly, and take ownership through resolution.

ABOUT BASE POWER

BASE Power is a key Crawford customer with a growing network of operating locations supported by Crawford’s Material Solutions team. Crawford provides onsite support that includes inventory management, VMI and consignment, replenishment, facility and storeroom setup, and ongoing material-management services. The Inventory Coordinator serves as an important onsite connection between BASE Power and Crawford, helping ensure materials are available, inventory remains accurate, and day-to-day service expectations are met.

WORK HOURS- 6.30am - 2.30pm, M-F

  

**Key Functions & Responsibilities:**

* Materials Availability and Replenishment

  + Maintain reliable availability of electrical material needed for installation, maintenance, and service work.

  + Monitor inventory levels, usage, open replenishment, shortages, and backorders.

  + Replenish inventory and escalate shortages before they affect field operations whenever possible.

  + Review minimum and maximum stocking levels as demand changes and recommend adjustments based on actual usage.

  + Recognize the difference between installation demand and service demand and adjust the inventory strategy accordingly.

  + Follow material issues through until product is physically available, not simply until an order or transfer is placed.

  Inventory Accuracy & Control

  + Maintain accurate on-hand quantities through disciplined receiving, scanning, cycle counting, adjustments, and transaction processing.

  + Perform scheduled inventory counts, investigate discrepancies, and correct inaccurate records promptly.

  + Maintain accurate labels, bin locations, item identification, and storage locations.

  + Identify slow-moving, excess, obsolete, damaged, or incorrectly stocked material and coordinate corrective action.

  + Perform counts and corrections in accordance with established billing and transaction controls.

  Receiving, Stocking & Material Flow

  + Receive incoming Crawford material and verify quantity and condition.

  + Stock material promptly in the assigned location and maintain a clean, safe, easy-to-use inventory area.

  + Coordinate transfers, returns, replacements, and material movement between Crawford and BASE locations.

  + Adjust stocking parameters before returning excess inventory so unwanted material does not automatically reorder.

  + Support facility launches, inventory moves, rack installations, relabeling, reorganizations, and physical inventories as needed.

  BASE Customer Support

  + Develop productive working relationships with BASE electricians, field personnel, drivers, warehouse personnel, and local leadership.

  + Be visible and accessible as the onsite Crawford material resource.

  + Respond promptly to questions, material requests, shortages, and service issues.

  + Communicate material arrivals, shortages, substitutions, and other information affecting field teams.

  + Treat each request as owned until resolved or successfully handed off to the appropriate person.

  Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

  + Identify recurring stockouts, inaccurate quantities, poor item placement, unnecessary inventory, workflow problems, and other operational friction.

  + Recommend improvements to stocking quantities, storage layouts, labeling, processes, and communication methods.

  + Learn the operating patterns of the assigned BASE location and adapt the material program as needs evolve.

  + Escalate larger issues with enough information for the Material Solutions team to make an effective decision.

  Systems, Documentation & Communication

  + Accurately use StoreroomPro, Eclipse, Slack, Teams, email, scanners, mobile devices, and other required Crawford or BASE systems.

  + Keep inventory transactions and operational records current.

  + Document discrepancies, shortages, returns, adjustments, and unresolved issues.

  + Use established communication channels, so requests remain visible to the appropriate support teams.

  + Escalate urgent shortages and customer-impacting issues rather than relying only on automated alerts.

**Qualifications**

  

**Required**

* + High school diploma or equivalent.

  + Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  + Ability to work independently in a customer facility with limited direct supervision.

  + Ability to regularly receive, move, stock, and count material.

  + Ability to learn inventory-management software, scanners, mobile applications, and customer communication platforms.

  + Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  + Ability to prioritize multiple material requests and operational issues.

  + Dependable transportation and ability to travel locally as required.

  + Willingness to travel overnight occasionally for training, coverage, program launches, or business needs.

  + Ability to meet the physical requirements associated with receiving, stocking, material handling, walking, standing, driving, and repetitive lifting.

  Preferred

  + Experience in electrical distribution, electrical construction, warehousing, inventory management, VMI, field service, or material handling.

  + Familiarity with electrical products and terminology.

  + Experience supporting electricians, technicians, contractors, field crews, or industrial customers.

  + Experience with inventory-control or ERP systems.

  + Experience managing a customer-facing inventory or storeroom environment.

**Environment**

  
  

This position is field‑based, with work performed at customer locations, job sites, warehouses, and other assigned locations. Regular local travel between sites is required, with occasional overnight travel. The role involves a combination of driving, walking, standing, and hands‑on material handling, with work conducted in both indoor and outdoor environments depending on location. Regular use of company systems, mobile devices, and applications is required, and minimal desk time is expected, as the role is primarily active and operational in nature.

*Crawford is a subsidiary of Sonepar USA.*

**What We Offer You**

  

We offer great family-friendly benefits to full-time associates:

* Healthcare plans
* Dental & vision
* Paid time off
* Paid parental leave
* 401(k) retirement savings with company match
* Professional and personal development programs

* Opportunity to become a shareholder
* Employer-paid short- and long-term disability
* Employer-paid life insurance for spouse and dependents
* Robust wellness program
* Gym reimbursement
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

We’re proud to be a military-friendly company, and our many employee resource groups (ERGs) help you make connections and feel supported.

  

***Ready to join the fun? Apply today and become part of the Crawford Crew – where we work hard, laugh often, and always have a spark to share!***

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

  

Sonepar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability unrelated to ability, marital status, family responsibilities, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, order of protection status, protected veteran or military status, or an unfavorable discharge from military service, or any other categories protected by federal, state or local law.

  

Sonepar and our family of brands are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, we will take the steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if a reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please call 843-745-2420 or email recruiting@sonepar-us.com.

  

**EEO is the Law**

  

Applicants and employees are protected under Federal law from discrimination. To learn more, Click here.

4297bdbc766e450069f3.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact. With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

**WHO WE ARE**  
IDEX Performance Pneumatics Platform delivers innovative solutions for vacuum, pressure, and flow control across critical industries worldwide.

Gast is a trusted leader in designing and manufacturing high-quality air-moving products, including compressors, vacuum pumps, and accessories. For decades, Gast has powered essential applications in medical, industrial, and environmental sectors with reliability and precision.

Airtech specializes in custom-engineered vacuum and pressure systems, offering advanced solutions for complex applications in life sciences, electronics, and industrial automation. Known for flexibility and technical expertise, Airtech partners with customers to solve unique challenges and deliver tailored systems that meet demanding performance requirements.

Together, Gast and Airtech combine engineering excellence, customer focus, and global reach to enable technologies that keep industries moving and improve everyday life.

**Position Summary**

The Commercial Operations Specialist supports the Pneumatics Platform commercial operating system by owning the data, reporting cadence, standard work, and user enablement required to sustain pricing governance, 80/20 analytics, CRM adoption, and commercial process discipline. This role translates approved commercial decisions into reliable system-ready updates, maintains dashboards and working files, supports recurring reviews and action tracking, and partners cross-functionally to improve price realization, reduce complexity, strengthen data quality, and increase sales productivity.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Pricing Governance & Execution:**

* Maintain pricing files, templates, exception logs, audit trails, and review cadence to support reliable price execution and governance.
* Translate approved pricing decisions into clean, system-ready updates for ERP, CRM, reporting, and mass-update processes.
* Support annual price increase preparation, customer-specific pricing maintenance, SPA documentation, and commercial pricing questions.

**80/20 Analytics & Complexity Reduction:**

* Maintain Quad/Quartile, customer and product segmentation, allocated P&L, and recurring 80/20 working files across the platform.
* Prepare data and analysis for RIEs, prioritization, portfolio simplification, resource allocation, and recurring 80/20 operating reviews.
* Track action items, thresholds, coding updates, and governance inputs needed to sustain standard 80/20 cadence and visibility.

**CRM, Reporting & User Enablement:**

* Govern CRM data quality, account ownership, opportunity hygiene, required fields, definitions, dashboard inputs, and process compliance.
* Provide user support, onboarding, role-based training, and troubleshooting for CRM, Power BI, ERP reporting, and related commercial tools.
* Maintain dashboards, recurring reports, funnel visibility, and commercial data inputs used by sales, finance, operations, and product management.

**Standard Work & Process Sustainability:**

* Document SOPs, ownership rules, governance routines, and controls that support repeatable commercial excellence processes.
* Identify data defects, recurring process gaps, manual workarounds, and root causes that reduce reporting accuracy or execution speed.
* Help move commercial processes through the clean, standardize, automate, optimize, and sustain maturity path.

**Cross-Functional Support:**

* Partner with sales, customer service, finance, operations, IT, product management, and leadership to support pricing, 80/20, CRM, and reporting needs.
* Turn transactional data maintenance into sustainable platform improvement that improves margin visibility, complexity reduction, and commercial execution.

**Skills & Attributes:**

* **Data Discipline:** Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain clean, complete, and credible commercial data.
* **Analytical:** Ability to organize and analyze complex datasets, identify trends and performance gaps, with the ability to develop data workflows, scorecards, dashboards, and scalable reporting solutions
* **Digital, Data & AI Proficiency:** Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, CRM, ERP systems, and related automation tools. Capable of identifying high-value AI use cases and developing, testing, and maintaining AI agents and automated workflows that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, accelerate information retrieval, and support effective commercial decision-making.
* **Process Orientation:** Ability to document standard work, follow controls, improve repeatability, and support sustainable operating rhythms.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to support users, explain data requirements, and escalate issues effectively.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Working understanding of pricing, margin, customer segmentation, product segmentation, CRM, and sales operations processes.

**Behaviors:**

* **Reliable:** Delivers accurate, timely work that others can depend on for decisions and execution.
* **Curious:** Looks for root causes, asks thoughtful questions, and identifies recurring issues that can be standardized or automated.
* **Collaborative:** Works effectively with sales, finance, operations, IT, product management, customer service, and leadership stakeholders.
* **Service-Minded:** Helps users solve problems, adopt tools, and follow standard processes while maintaining strong governance.
* **Ethical:** Upholds high standards for data integrity, pricing controls, confidentiality, and business conduct.

**Education & Experience:**•

* BA or BS degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Finance, Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.•
* Minimum 3 years of experience in commercial operations, pricing support, sales operations, business analytics, data governance, CRM administration, or related business support role.•
* Experience working with Excel, Power BI, CRM, ERP, and reporting tools; manufacturing or B2B industrial experience preferred.•
* Familiarity with pricing processes, customer/product segmentation, 80/20, continuous improvement, Lean Six Sigma, or commercial excellence processes preferred.•
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, manage multiple priorities, and support stakeholders across multiple business units.

**Level of Authority/Autonomy**

* Individual contributor role with responsibility for maintaining governed commercial data, reporting tools, standard work, user support, and recurring operating cadence; escalates decisions, exceptions, and process gaps through Commercial Excellence leadership.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** *The physical demands described here are represented of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*  While performing duties of the job, employee is required to move around and be still; use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

4fafdd133aa95c7546a5.description:
**Why you should join us:**

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We're building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, now we're expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.

We're growing fast, which means our HR operations are getting more complex by the month, more states, more employees, more edge cases. Right now that complexity mostly lands on two people. We need someone who thrives doing the hands on work: real compliance problems to solve, policies to write, escalations that need judgment instead of a script. You'll also have room to bring AI into how we run HR ops to help cut the busywork so you can spend more time on the parts that matter.

**The opportunity:**

This isn't a role where you're processing paperwork and waiting for direction. You'll own the parts of HR operations that actually require judgment: multi-state compliance, policy drafting, and the payroll and benefits questions that come up when the answer isn't in a handbook. You've done this kind of work before, in-house, hands-on, and you're ready to be the person others come to when something's more complicated than usual.

You'll also have a real say in how AI fits into HR ops here, spending less time on the repetitive stuff and more time on the judgment calls that need a person.

**What you'll own:**

* Multi-state compliance: tracking state-by-state law changes, drafting policy updates, and making sure they're actually implemented (not just written) across every employee classification and pay range
* Our annual compliance audit and handbook refresh, yours to lead start to finish, in your first 90 days
* Escalated payroll, benefits, and leave questions that need a more experienced hand
* Reviewing and unblocking the work of our Payroll and HR Administration team members
* Rearchitecting our HR ops processes with an AI-native mindset, not just using AI tools, but rethinking how the function should work
* Growing into ownership of day-to-day HR operations management over time

**Who you are:**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* At least 2 years of real, hands-on HR generalist experience. You've personally drafted the policy, entered the payroll, handled the compliance filing, not just reviewed someone else's work
* Genuine in-house, multi-state compliance experience
* Comfortable in a small, high-intensity team where you touch payroll, benefits, and compliance yourself
* Excited (not resistant) to build with AI.

**Where you’ll work:**

We are headquartered in Palo Alto and ideally would have someone able to come into the office multiple times a week, but we’re still open to remote candidates for the right fit.

*While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.*

***Please note:*** ***Jerry.ai*** ***is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.***

*Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. f8db7503f9108f7ac684.title: Temporary Clinical Operations Administrative Assistant
f8db7503f9108f7ac684.description:
Bluestone delivers great outcomes by bringing exceptional care to patients living with complex, chronic conditions and disabilities. Our unique, robust model of care goes beyond primary care services — our multidisciplinary care teams collaborate with patients, their families and other healthcare providers to deliver care that is preventative, proactive and tailored to their unique needs.

Using an evidence-based approach focused on quality care management and data-driven medical decisions, Bluestone care teams collaborate to manage patients' chronic conditions, address social determinants of health, manage transitions to and from inpatient settings, provide behavioral health support and more. Under our model of care, Bluestone patients experienced 21% fewer ER visits, 36% fewer hospitalizations and 41% fewer hospital readmissions compared to patients with similar conditions and complexities over the same time period.

Our care teams travel directly to patients who reside in Assisted Living, Memory Care and Group Home communities throughout Minnesota, Wisconsin and Florida and are supported by clinical operations and administrative colleagues who work remotely or at our corporate offices in Stillwater, Minnesota, and Tampa, Florida.

Our success is only possible through the hard work of our employees who bring our core values of Dedication, Excellence, Collaboration and Caring to life every day. ***Bluestone has been named to the Star Tribune's Top Workplace list for the 14th year in a row! Bluestone also achieved Top Workplace USA 2021-2026!***In 2022, Bluestone Accountable Care Organization (ACO) was the best performing ACO in the country as measured by the overall savings per Medicare beneficiary.

**Position Overview****:**

Bluestone Physician Services is seeking four (4) detail-oriented and organized **Temporary Clinical Operations Administrative Assistants** to support our Clinical Operations and Clinical Liaison teams. This temporary assignment is expected to last 2 to 6 months, with three (3) full-time positions (40 hours per week) and one (1) part-time position (20 hours per week) available.

In this role, you will provide vital administrative and patient support to ensure seamless daily clinical workflows. The ideal candidate will bring demonstrated administrative experience within a healthcare environment, along with working knowledge of medical terminology, healthcare systems, and Electronic Medical Records (EMR).

**Number of Temporary Positions:** 4

**Durations of Temporary Assignment:** 2-6 months, depending upon business needs

**Schedule:** Weekdays Monday thru Friday, regular business hours, no nights, weekends or holidays

**Salary:** $20 per hour.

**Responsibilities may include****:**

* **Care & Referral Coordination**: Assist with processing outpatient specialty care and diagnostic imaging referrals, scheduling patient appointments, and connecting patients with necessary resources.
* **Medical Records & Document Management**: Maintain accurate patient data in our Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system. Sort digital fax inboxes, route provider-to-provider documents, prevent duplicates, and upload patient certifications.
* **Communication & Phone Support**: Handle incoming non-clinical calls from patients, families, and external healthcare partners, maintaining clear and responsive communication across the care team.

**Qualifications****:**

**Education/Certification/Experience**

* **Experience**: Previous administrative or office experience required; prior experience in a healthcare setting or with Electronic Medical Records (EMR) is a plus.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

* Knowledge of medical terminology and understanding of patient care notes.
* Proficient in navigating electronic medical record systems and working with patient care
* Ability to assist providers and facilitate an efficient, organized administration flow.
* Ability to problem solve and work well under pressure.
* Detail oriented and accurate.
* Collaborates effectively within team settings with clinical and non-clinical staff.
* Ability to deal with change and ambiguity.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable navigating electronic medical record systems and working with patient care notes.

* Company sponsored laptop and computer accessories
* Regular business hours

0da1c682f834fabcfd70.title: Director of Operations
0da1c682f834fabcfd70.description:
Description:

**Location:** Remote (U.S.-based), with periodic travel to Monterey County, California, for on-site working sessions.

**Position Summary**

**Professional Tribe LLC ("ProTribe")** is the family office for a multi-entity enterprise spanning investments, trusts, real estate, and operating companies in agriculture. The Director of Operations is the enterprise's internal operations and administration lead — the person who makes sure every tax payment, filing, legal record, lease, and bank transaction happens on time, is documented, and is done right.

The role brings in-house a function currently performed by an outsourced CFO/controller firm: the compliance and payment calendar across 40+ legal entities, legal and insurance records, treasury scheduling and bill-pay workflow, real estate support, and trusted executive support to the Principal.

This is a back-office control seat, not an investment seat. The right candidate is intellectually curious, learns the why behind every process, writes things down, and handles external service providers — CPAs, corporate bankers, estate planners — competently and with discretion.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Estate Planning, Legal Entity & Insurance Administration**

* Own and maintain the Estate Planning Map — the master picture of the family's trusts and entities: who owns what, how funds flow between them, and who the trustees and beneficiaries are. Keep it current as entities are formed, restructured, or dissolved, so the Principal, estate planners, and CPAs all work from one accurate version.
* Maintain the estate planning file behind the map: trust instruments and amendments, ownership records, and beneficiary records.
* Coordinate with estate planners and CPAs on restructurings: gather documents, track action items and signatures, and carry each change through to updated records and an updated map.
* Maintain corporate records across 40+ entities: operating agreements, minute books, amendments, EINs, and good-standing status.
* Manage state filings, registered-agent relationships, annual reports, and entity formations and dissolutions, coordinating with outside counsel as needed.
* Administer the enterprise insurance program: policy renewals, certificates of insurance, coverage reviews, claims coordination, and broker relationships.
* Organize and maintain contract files; track key terms, renewal dates, and obligations across entities.
* Maintain diligence-ready documentation to support audits, financings, and transactions.

**Accounting, Tax & Compliance Administration**

* Oversee the monthly close prepared by our outside accounting firm, and review and deliver the monthly P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statements to the Principal.
* Own the enterprise tax payment function: property tax payments (35+ assessments across five counties), federal and state estimated and extension payments, and trustee payments — tracked, funded, executed, and confirmed on time, every time.
* Own and maintain the centralized compliance and operational calendar across all entities: filing deadlines, license renewals, registrations, reconciliation cadences, and reporting dates.
* Coordinate annual tax return processes with external CPAs, including information requests, extension tracking, and payment execution; support the Investment Associate on collecting and delivering investment K-1s to the CPAs as needed.
* Administer vendor tax compliance: W-9 collection and 1099 preparation and filing coordination.
* Map property tax assessments to owning entities; manage county-level filings and corrections.
* Coordinate with the Operating Company Controller to maintain depreciation and fixed-asset schedules and to work with CPAs on return support across family office and operating entities.

**Real Estate & Operating Company Support**

* Support the Director of Real Estate on lease administration, tenant communications, property-level payables, insurance, and property tax for the real estate LLCs.
* Serve as the family office's operational interface to the enterprise's operating companies in agriculture: intercompany billing, shared compliance items, and coordination with their accounting teams.
* Support obligations that span family office and operating entities, including property tax assessment transfers, expense allocations, and cross-entity reimbursements.

Executive Support to the Principal

* Provide direct executive support to the Principal: calendar, correspondence, meeting preparation, travel, and disciplined follow-through on action items.
* Prepare and organize materials for family, advisor, and operating company meetings; capture decisions and track them to completion.
* Handle personal administrative matters for the Principal and family with absolute discretion.
* Act as a traffic controller for the Principal's desk: triage inbound requests, route items to the right owner (Chief Investment Officer, Investment Associate, Director of Real Estate, external advisors), and make sure nothing drops.

**Treasury, Banking & Payment Oversight**

* Own the enterprise payment schedule: ensure every recurring and one-off obligation — bills, taxes, intercompany settlements, capital calls — is scheduled, approved, executed, documented, and filed on time. The Investment Associate is the primary executor of wires and transfers; this role sits one level up, making sure nothing is missed.
* Oversee the bill-pay and accounts payable workflow across family office entities: invoice intake, approval routing, payment scheduling, and recordkeeping; serve as operational backup on execution.
* Maintain documented verification and callback protocols for wires and transfers.
* Support lines of credit administration: draws, paydowns, and coordination of covenant reporting with operating company finance teams.
* Prepare and reconcile intercompany settlements on their documented cadence; be the operational backup for capital call payments in coordination with the Investment Associate.
* Work alongside the Investment Team to monitor operating cash positions to ensure obligations are funded; flag shortfalls and anomalies early.

**Process, Documentation & Systems**

* Support the Investment Associate on Masttro, the family office operating platform: keep entity and ownership records and the document vault current as entities are formed, restructured, or dissolved, and flag data issues to the Investment Associate. Platform administration, reporting data integrity, and custodian/provider connectivity remain with the Investment Associate.
* Document and maintain standard operating procedures for every recurring process this role owns; the goal is a function that runs on written SOPs, not institutional memory.
* Jointly administer the team operational calendar and task-management systems with the Investment Associate; keep the entity document library organized, current, and diligence-ready.
* Work in QuickBooks across entity files as needed: journal entry support, bank reconciliations, and close-support items in coordination with external accountants.
* Identify and propose process improvements — this is an institutionalization mandate, not a caretaker role.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field; paralegal certification, CPA track, or legal operations background a plus.
* 4–8 years of experience in accounting, back-office operations, legal or entity administration, or fiduciary administration — ideally in a family office, trust company, law firm, fund administrator, RIA, or multi-entity private business.
* Experience at an RIA, multi-family office, or single-family office strongly preferred, including working directly with custodians on account administration and money movement.
* Hands-on intercompany accounting experience across multiple entities: intercompany billing, settlements, reconciliations, and cost allocations.
* Demonstrated experience managing compliance calendars, tax payments, or entity records across multiple legal entities.
* Proficiency in QuickBooks and Excel; comfort learning new systems (task management, document portals, banking platforms); experience with AI tools such as Claude is a plus.
* Working literacy in trust and partnership structures (K-1s, grantor vs. non-grantor basics) strongly preferred.
* Polished written and verbal communication; able to represent the office credibly with CPAs, bankers, attorneys, and executives without supervision.
* Intellectually curious: wants to understand how the enterprise fits together, asks why, and reads the documents.
* High integrity and absolute discretion with sensitive family, financial, and legal information.
* Self-directed and reliable in a remote setting, with exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

**Physical Activities**

While performing the functions of this job, the employee is regularly required to reach with hands and arms; frequently required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and occasionally required to stand, walk, talk, or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to twenty-five (25) pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and color vision.

This position description does not promise or imply that the functions listed in the Position Summary are the only duties to be performed or that the position may not change or be eliminated. Employees interested in learning more about the essential duties and responsibilities of this position should complete the Position Interest Form and submit it to the Human Resources Department.

f3b24db08d49c6133266.description:
**Are You a Wastewater Expert Who Knows How to Build a Business?**

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial, results-driven **General Manager – Wastewater Operations** to lead, grow, and transform our **Eastern United States Region.**

This is not a traditional operations management position. This is an opportunity for a proven wastewater leader and business-minded entrepreneur to take ownership of a region, build high-performing teams, strengthen customer partnerships, drive profitable growth, and establish a standard of operational excellence.

At Solution Group, we deliver specialized wastewater treatment solutions, chemical program management, and operational expertise to some of the most demanding industrial environments in the country, including dairy processing, rendering, and food and beverage manufacturing.

Our customers depend on us to solve complex wastewater challenges, maintain regulatory compliance, improve treatment performance, and reduce operating costs. We need a leader who understands these challenges firsthand and has the technical credibility, business acumen, and leadership presence to take our regional operations to the next level.

**We are looking for a leader who thinks like an owner, operates like an expert, and leads like an entrepreneur.**

**THE OPPORTUNITY: OWN IT. GROW IT. LEAD IT.**

As General Manager, you will have full accountability for the performance and growth of your assigned region. You will lead a multi-site wastewater operation with accountability for financial performance, customer relationships, business development, operational execution, safety, and talent development.

You will have the autonomy and accountability to make an impact, identify opportunities, challenge the status quo, and build a stronger, more profitable business.

Your mission is to create a high-performing regional organization that consistently delivers exceptional wastewater treatment results, outstanding customer experiences, strong financial performance, and a culture of accountability.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**1. Business Growth & Entrepreneurial Leadership**

* Take ownership of regional growth, identifying new customers, developing market opportunities, and expanding our presence within existing accounts.
* Build executive-level customer relationships that create trust, strengthen retention, and generate new business.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional services, technologies, and revenue streams across existing customer locations.
* Partner with Business Development, Key Account Managers, and Technical Services to win new business and successfully launch new customer operations.
* Explore strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and opportunities to expand our regional footprint.
* Develop and execute a regional growth strategy with measurable revenue and profitability targets.

**2. Full P&L Ownership & Financial Performance**

* Own the financial performance of the region, including revenue, EBITDA, labor, chemicals, materials, maintenance, and capital expenditures.
* Drive profitable growth through disciplined financial management, cost optimization, and operational accountability.
* Establish clear financial expectations and performance metrics throughout the organization.
* Develop accurate forecasts, budgets, and action plans to improve business performance.
* Communicate financial results, opportunities, challenges, and corrective actions to executive leadership.

**3. Wastewater Expertise & Operational Excellence**

* Provide strategic and technical leadership across a portfolio of industrial wastewater treatment operations.
* Leverage your deep wastewater knowledge to improve treatment performance, process stability, compliance, and operating efficiency.
* Establish consistent operating standards, SOPs, preventive maintenance programs, and performance metrics across all locations.
* Drive standardization and best-practice implementation while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
* Lead troubleshooting and problem-solving efforts on complex wastewater treatment challenges.
* Champion continuous improvement, root cause analysis, process optimization, and operational discipline.

**4. Customer Leadership & Retention**

* Own the overall customer experience and build long-term, trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong customer retention rate through proactive engagement, exceptional service delivery, and measurable results.
* Lead strategic customer business reviews and identify opportunities to deliver additional value.
* Partner with Key Account Managers to ensure customer expectations are consistently met and exceeded.
* Position Solution Group as a strategic wastewater partner, not simply a service provider.

**5. Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline**

* Establish a culture where safety, environmental compliance, and operational excellence are non-negotiable.
* Partner with HSE leadership to drive safety performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure all locations maintain strong environmental compliance, documentation, training, and preventative safety practices.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and consistent execution of operational standards.
* Lead with visibility, accountability, and a commitment to ensuring every employee goes home safely.

**6. Build, Develop & Inspire High-Performing Teams**

* Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional operational leaders and wastewater professionals.
* Lead and coach Key Account Managers, Regional Managers, and Site Managers.
* Establish clear expectations, performance goals, and accountability throughout the region.
* Develop succession plans and create opportunities for employees to grow into greater leadership responsibilities.
* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and results.
* Lead by example and inspire teams to take pride in their work, their customers, and their performance.

**7. Enterprise Leadership & Collaboration**

* Work closely with other General Managers and corporate leadership to share best practices and drive company-wide success.
* Collaborate with Technical Services, Business Development, Sales, HR, Finance, and HSE to strengthen capabilities and execute strategic initiatives.
* Contribute to the long-term growth, scalability, and success of Solution Group.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a strong, confident, entrepreneurial leader who brings together deep technical wastewater expertise, proven operational leadership, and a genuine passion for building a business.

**You are someone who:**

* Knows wastewater treatment. You understand industrial wastewater processes, treatment systems, troubleshooting, chemistry, compliance, and the operational challenges our customers face.
* Thinks like a business owner. You understand P&L performance, revenue growth, cost control, and what it takes to build a profitable operation.
* Is commercially driven. You naturally identify opportunities, build relationships, grow accounts, and turn customer challenges into business opportunities.
* Leads with confidence. You know how to build trust, set expectations, develop people, and hold teams accountable.
* Is operationally disciplined. You believe in KPIs, standardization, preventative maintenance, continuous improvement, and measurable results.
* Is entrepreneurial. You are energized by growth, change, new opportunities, and the ability to make a meaningful impact.
* Is a problem solver. You are comfortable navigating complex operational challenges and making decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Is collaborative. You understand that regional success contributes to company-wide success.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in industrial wastewater treatment, environmental services, industrial services, utilities, or related operational environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in industrial wastewater treatment operations, including treatment processes, troubleshooting, environmental compliance, and emerging technologies.
* Proven experience leading multi-site or regional operations with direct leadership responsibility for multiple levels of management.
* Previous full P&L ownership with demonstrated success improving profitability and financial performance.
* A track record of growing revenue, expanding customer relationships, and developing new business opportunities.
* Experience building and implementing operational standards, KPIs, SOPs, audit programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and accountability.
* Experience with Lean, TPM, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, customer relationship, and change management skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel 50% or more throughout the Eastern US Region.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Business, Operations, or a related discipline.
* State-issued wastewater operator license (Class A, B, C, or D, as applicable).
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certifications.
* Experience with mergers, acquisitions, and business integration.

**WHY SOLUTION GROUP?**

At Solution Group, you won't simply inherit a job description and maintain the status quo. You will have the opportunity to influence the direction of a growing business, develop exceptional teams, strengthen customer partnerships, and make a measurable impact on our future.

We offer:

* **Executive-Level Compensation:** $140,000–$200,000 base salary, plus eligibility for an annual performance bonus.
* **Meaningful Leadership:** Full regional ownership and the opportunity to directly influence business performance and strategy.
* **Entrepreneurial Opportunity:** The ability to identify opportunities, drive growth, and help shape the future of the organization.
* **Strong Team Environment:** Work alongside experienced wastewater professionals and collaborative corporate leadership.
* **Competitive Benefits:** Health, dental, vision, 401k, Paid Time Off.
* **Professional Development:** Continued technical training and opportunities for career advancement.
* **Travel Reimbursement:** Mileage reimbursement for business travel.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

**We are looking for a wastewater expert who is ready to lead a business, not just manage operations.**

If you have the technical depth to understand complex wastewater challenges, the business acumen to drive profitable growth, and the leadership ability to build exceptional teams, we want to hear from you.

**Come build something great with Solution Group.**

*Solution Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status under applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

dba4cd4304edbc405ada.title: Project Manager Operations Consultant/ Circuit Analyst
dba4cd4304edbc405ada.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The US Federal Solutions & Services Team is dedicated to being the premier, compliant provider of high-quality communications solutions, products, and services to the U.S. Federal Government. Driven by a skilled and diverse workforce, this group focuses on building strong customer relationships, driving business growth, and delivering complete customer satisfaction. Within the US Federal Solutions & Services Team, the Secret Service Sustainment Unit manages the global implementation, integration, and servicing of complex mission critical systems. As a Project Manager Operations Consultant/ Circuit Analyst, you will support a broad range of mission-critical communication projects across pre-sale and post-sale phases worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Project Manager Operations Consultant/ Circuit Analyst position is responsible for providing technical and administrative support within the Radio Team and in cooperation with the EIS circuit team of a sensitive Federal customer. The role further includes coordinating operations to include order/initiate provisioning, execute decommissioning, and tracking status of the appropriate voice circuits, data circuits, and POTS lines on time and in accordance with customer procedures. This position reports to the on-site Sr. Mgr. Field Service Team.

  

* Serve as the primary operational liaison between cross-functional internal teams, external stakeholders, enterprise solution providers, and site vendors (including EIS, OCI, and AT&T) to ensure seamless project alignment and communication.
* Direct, coordinate, and schedule site surveys, Technical Transition Units (TTUs), and infrastructure construction activities across project locations to maintain strict project timelines.
* Provide comprehensive root-cause analyses and operational overviews during site outages, collaborating directly with AT&T and OCI Field Technicians for rapid issue resolution.
* Proactively align preventive maintenance schedules with AT&T and OCI teams to safeguard mission-critical circuits and minimize operational disruptions.
* Manage the full lifecycle of circuit-related hardware, coordinating delivery, deployment, stage-gate tracking, and reverse logistics in partnership with USSS points of contact (POCs), site leads, and vendor representatives.
* Deliver high-level administrative oversight for newly onboarded circuit sites, facilitating rigorous documentation reviews and securing required approvals from OCI executive leadership.
* Prepare and present weekly executive status dashboards for OCI leadership regarding the RAD initiative, offering detailed breakdowns of outstanding deliverables, TTUs, and site construction timelines.
* Lead coordination for National Special Security Event (NSSE) circuit requests alongside Field Technicians, serving as OCI's principal point of contact for EIS and AT&T during high-priority operations.
* Maintain and continuously audit the global circuit inventory database, collaborating with the CIO, onsite network engineering teams, and EIS to reconcile data gaps and ensure full record integrity.
* Administer and manage telecom circuits for the communications program by processing, auditing, analyzing, organizing, and correcting telecommunications billing; validating discounts; ensuring accurate department billing; monitoring the disconnection of unused lines and circuits; and reporting to the on-site Senior Manager of the Field Service Team.
* Coordinate operations to order, initiate provisioning for, execute decommissioning of, and track the status of voice circuits, data circuits, and POTS lines in a timely manner and in accordance with USSS procedures.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive circuit tracking spreadsheet covering installed, on-order, awaiting disconnect, or decommissioning stages, capturing key metadata (site identifiers, name, coordinates, address, lessor info, circuit type, circuit ID, A/Z ends, and provider POCs).
* Consult with Sales, Program Managers, the Senior Field Service Team Manager, and additional internal teams to establish strategy, project direction, and execution plans.
* Prepare technical briefings, white papers, financial analyses, business cases, independent research, and technical recommendations for leadership.
* Perform strategic planning and develop near-term, mid-term, and long-term implementation roadmaps.
* Utilize the ServiceNow ticketing platform to efficiently manage, track, and route incoming work requests and operational issues.
* Process contract transition workflows from legacy agreements (e.g., Networx) to the new Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions (EIS) contract.
* Oversee the migration from legacy circuits to modern EIS circuits under federal government oversight and management.
* Assist with daily financial transactions, support budget maintenance for the program office, prepare purchase requisitions, and track financial data calls.
* Assist the program office with the end-to-end development and preparation of procurement packages.
* Track organization-wide metrics on project management performance and value delivery, continuously assessing the execution environment to drive operational improvements.
Build strong collaborative relationships with colleagues, government customers, and third-party service professionals.  

  

**Candidate Requirements:**

* Must be able to obtain background clearance as required by government customers.
* Must reside near Washington DC or be willing to relocate to service Public Safety customers located in the DMV area.
* Must be willing and capable of meeting the requirements to obtain a DHS Public Trust Clearance.
* Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.
* Must have a current, valid driver’s license and no traffic violations.
Must be willing to travel 25% of the time as needed.  

  

#LI-CC1
