20244d14b6b4bf31fe3b.title: Resupply Customer Service Manager
20244d14b6b4bf31fe3b.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking an operational and analytically driven Resupply Customer Service Manager to lead, develop, and oversee our live agent calling staff while driving client success. In this role, you will be responsible for driving front-line performance, ensuring maximum operational efficiency, and maintaining high quality standards across all Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and CPAP resupply calling campaigns. You will actively manage daily staffing metrics, oversee predictive dialer strategies, manage new client implementations, and conduct business analysis on campaign data to hit sales conversion targets while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Performance**

* Manage, mentor, and motivate a team of live agents to achieve daily and weekly resupply conversion goals.
* Drive a high-energy, performance-focused culture that balances sales success with empathetic patient care.
* Partner directly with the QA Manager and Training Leads to identify performance gaps, refine call tactics, and ensure dynamic script compliance.

**Dialer & Logistics Management**

* Oversee daily dialer operations utilizing systems such as CallShaper.
* Analyze predictive dialer metrics, manage list penetration, and balance pacing to optimize agent active time against inbound and outbound call volume fluctuations.
* Monitor daily agent availability and adjust staffing allocations based on lead volume and inbound call trends per campaign to ensure full list clearance.

**Client Implementation & Business Analysis**

* Act as the operational point of contact for onboarding new DME clients, partnering with IT and implementation teams to map customer data and test workflow integration within the dialer and billing platforms.
* Conduct routine data analysis on lead list quality, contact rates, and conversion outcomes by client to identify trends or bottlenecks impacting dialer efficiency.
* Prepare and present regular operational insights and performance dashboards to clients and internal executives, detailing list penetration, conversion trends, and revenue cycle impacts.
* Collaborate with continuous improvement leaders to evaluate dialer rules and system workflows, transitioning operations from reactive troubleshooting to proactive management.

**Compliance & Process Improvement**

* Enforce strict team adherence to HIPAA, documentation standards, and data security guidelines.
* Identify root causes of downstream billing or revenue cycle management issues stemming from agent intake errors, implementing proactive operational changes to improve first-pass claim acceptance.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Campaign Conversion Targets:** Ensure the live calling team maintains a collective average baseline of 4 closed resupply orders per agent, per hour.
* **Dialer Optimization Metrics:** Maintain optimal agent utilization rates by monitoring and reducing excessive wrap-up time, minimizing unapproved idle time, and managing overall Average Handle Time (AHT).
* **List Clearance Rate:** Successfully manage daily lead lists and agent capacity to meet established daily or weekly campaign clearance targets per client.
* **Team Quality & Compliance Score:** Maintain a net team QA evaluation score of 90% or higher across script adherence, data entry precision, and compliance metrics.
* **Implementation Timelines:** Meet established go-live deadlines for new client campaigns with minimal post-launch technical or data disruption.
* **Data Integrity & First-Pass Accuracy:** Reduce downstream billing and claim errors related to newly implemented client data mappings through proactive staff oversight.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

* **Experience:** 3+ years of experience in call center management or team leadership, with at least 2 years of experience conducting data analysis, campaign reporting, or operational business analysis. Experience within DME, CPAP resupply, or healthcare revenue cycle management is highly preferred.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong working knowledge of cloud-based predictive dialers (e.g., CallShaper) and DME billing/analytics platforms (e.g., Brightree, SNAP, S3). Advanced comfort using Excel for data tracking, staffing calculations, and reporting.
* **Analytical Skills:** Proven ability to translate operational metrics (pickup rates, drop rates, talk time vs. active time) into actionable coaching, dialer adjustments, and data mapping strategies.
* **Communication:** Exceptional leadership, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to interface effectively with front-line agents, executive leadership, and clients.

**Confidentiality:** This position has regular access to Protected Health Information (PHI) and other confidential patient and client data, and requires strict adherence to HIPAA and ACU‑Serve’s privacy and data security policies.

ACU-Serve is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace that is free of discrimination of all types and promotes diversity, inclusion, and respect. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, gender, religion, creed, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization. ACU-Serve makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

16cace80efdfd73f4c4a.title: Director of Field Services and Technical Support- Automation
16cace80efdfd73f4c4a.description:
**Working at Knobelsdorff (KE)**

Along with building state-of-the-art projects, we build meaningful careers, lasting opportunities, and teams of dedicated individuals who truly own their work. As a leading turnkey specialty contractor specializing in Automation, Electric, Energy, and Power Services, our team tackles challenging, cutting-edge projects that provide opportunities to build new skills, confidence, and gain valuable hands-on experience in a variety of different industries. We tackle industrial electrical installations, advanced automation systems, and renewable energy solutions.

Since our founding as a family-owned company in 1988, we've grown while staying true to our core value. Starting your career with KE means joining a culture that values your contributions, moves quickly, takes calculated risks, and celebrates team members who step up and own their work.

If you're ready to join a team where your voice matters, your growth is supported, and your impact is celebrated, KE is the place for you.

**Job Purpose**

This role supports KE Automation's Customer Service and Field Services teams by leading field service operations, technical support, and workforce development. You'll be responsible for building strong teams, coordinating service capacity, improving field operations, and ensuring reliable customer support from project commissioning through ongoing service agreements. Success in this role means developing capable leaders and teams, delivering dependable service, maintaining safe field operations, and supporting sustainable business growth while upholding KE's commitment to Safety, People, Passion, and Performance. If you're someone who takes pride in developing people, building strong operations, and delivering exceptional customer experiences, this position is built for you.

**What You'll Do**

You'll be part of a team that gets things done, works with purpose, and takes pride in the results. Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

* Lead and develop field services and technical support managers and team leaders through coaching, performance management, and succession planning.
* Develop workforce and service capacity plans that align staffing, skills, and resources with project demands and customer support commitments.
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, training, and professional development to build a skilled, dependable, and deployment-ready workforce.
* Coordinate workforce priorities with project leadership and operations teams to support project commitments, service needs, and customer expectations.
* Partner with KE Safety and field leadership to promote safe work practices, ensure proper training and site readiness, and address safety concerns.
* Establish consistent field operations processes for workforce assignments, travel, accommodations, expenses, communication, and timekeeping.
* Oversee the transition from project commissioning to hypercare, warranty, and ongoing contracted support, ensuring clear responsibilities and customer handoff.
* Develop and improve service intake, dispatch, incident response, escalation, and customer communication processes.
* Ensure service coverage plans align with available workforce capacity, technical expertise, and customer service commitments.
* Manage field services and support budgets, including labor, overtime, travel, tools, and subcontracted resources.
* Lead significant customer service escalations and operational recovery efforts, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and timely resolution.
* Identify opportunities to improve service delivery, workforce efficiency, customer satisfaction, and operational performance.
* Partner with Business Development and company leadership to evaluate new service opportunities, workforce needs, and operational costs to support business growth.

**What You Bring**

You're someone who shows up ready to lead, develop others, and build operations that deliver consistent results. Successful candidates typically bring:

* 10+ years of experience in operations, field services, technical support, or distributed workforce management.
* 5+ years of experience in people leadership, including managing managers or team leaders and overseeing a distributed or multi-site workforce.
* Bachelor's degree in operations, business, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant education and experience.
* Demonstrated experience building and managing workforce plans, including recruitment, onboarding, employee development, performance management, and succession planning.
* Experience overseeing service operations, customer escalations, workforce coordination, and transitions from project delivery to ongoing support.
* Strong financial and commercial understanding, including workforce budgets, labor costs, overtime, travel expenses, and resource planning.
* Experience promoting safe work practices and partnering with safety teams to ensure field readiness and compliance.
* Ability to lead and develop technical teams while collaborating with engineering leaders and respecting established technical decision-making responsibilities.
* Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive accountability.
* Ability to build strong customer relationships and communicate effectively with employees, project leaders, customers, and senior leadership.

**Pay Range**

We believe in paying for the value you bring to the team, and we aim to be competitive in every market we hire in.

**Pay Range: $176,084–$192,979 annually.**

**Total Rewards Statement**

As a full-time employee at KE, you'll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and future.

* 100% employer-paid health and dental coverage for employees
* HSA contributions to support your medical expenses
* Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage
* 401(k) with competitive company match
* Paid weekly with competitive wages
* PTO, six paid holidays, and education reimbursement
* Exclusive employee discounts through Working Advantage

We believe your work should be rewarded with more than just a paycheck. At KE, we invest in your total wellbeing.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided for individuals with disabilities.

Typical requirements may include:

* Perform computer-based work for extended periods, including reviewing operational reports, workforce schedules, budgets, and technical documentation.
* Participate in meetings and site reviews that may involve periods of sitting, standing, and walking.
* Navigate manufacturing facilities and customer project sites, including stairs and uneven surfaces, as required for operational oversight.
* Occasionally carry a laptop, project documents, and other materials needed for meetings or site visits.
* Use required personal protective equipment when visiting manufacturing or project-site locations.
* Travel to customer and project locations as needed based on business requirements.

**Accessibility:** If you need accommodations as part of the employment process, please contact KE Human Resources at HR@KEway.com.

**Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO)**

KE is an EEO to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws: EEO is the Law (English/Spanish).

**KE E-Verify**

KE participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States. For more information about E-Verify, please review the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters.

If you need accommodation during the hiring process, let us know and we'll work with you.

279c0bd7ebb9a2db7de8.title: Sustainability Field Services Manager - Medical Surgical (West)
279c0bd7ebb9a2db7de8.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 24 Nov 2026  
  

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Medical Surgical Portfolio strives to enable earlier diagnosis, better treatment, faster complication-free recovery, and enhanced patient outcomes through less invasive surgical solutions. Spanning Endoscopy, Surgical, and Acute Care & Monitoring, the portfolio brings together technologies that support clinicians and patients across a broad range of care settings.
  
  
We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.  

As the Sustainability Field Services Manager, you will lead a team of Sustainability Specialists responsible for delivering a consistent, high-quality post-sale customer experience for sustainability collections programs across the Medical Surgical Portfolio. You will guide customer kickoff and implementation, support ongoing account management and relationship building, and help customers realize the operational and sustainability value of participating in these programs. This is a customer-facing leadership role within the Commercial organization; it is focused on post-sale execution and account stewardship.

  

This position leads a team of Sustainability Specialists and should be based in the greater Dallas/Fort Worth, TX area.

  

This role covers the Western part of the US and involves significant travel including frequent overnights.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Sustainability Specialists, including hiring, onboarding, goal setting, performance management, and ongoing capability development.
* Oversee post-sale customer kickoff and implementation for sustainability collections programs, ensuring clear roles, timelines, workflows, training, and success measures are established with each customer.
* Ensure specialists provide proactive, ongoing account management and relationship building, serving as trusted customer contacts and coordinating timely follow-through on needs and commitments.
* Establish consistent service standards, playbooks, and operating rhythms for customer onboarding, program adoption, issue escalation, and account reviews across the portfolio.
* Monitor implementation progress, participation, collection activity, service levels, and customer feedback; use available data to identify risks, resolve barriers, and improve program performance.
* Partner with Commercial colleagues, including sales, strategic account teams, and clinical partners, to support a smooth transition from sale to implementation and maintain clear ownership throughout the customer lifecycle.
* Coordinate with internal operations, sustainability, marketing, finance, and external program partners, as appropriate, to resolve operational issues and deliver a reliable customer experience.
* Communicate customer insights, implementation trends, service risks, and opportunities to improve program design and execution to relevant business stakeholders.
* Manage team capacity, priorities, and resources to meet customer commitments and support consistent service delivery across a geographically distributed portfolio.
Represent the customer and sustainability services perspective in cross-functional planning, while maintaining the distinction between post-sale program management and sales ownership.  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree required and at least 5 years or an advanced degree and at least 3 years of relevant customer facing, field service, account management, implementation or commercial experience.

**Preferred Qualifications** :

  

* Master’s degree (MBA, MA, MS) is highly desirable.
* 10+ years of overall work experience.
* Experience leading customer success, field service, implementation, or account management teams.
* Experience supporting medical devices, capital equipment, disposable products, or healthcare services in a field environment.
* Experience implementing customer programs, service workflows, or sustainability / product collection initiatives
* Experience using customer, operational, or program-performance data to manage service delivery and identify improvement opportunities.
* Recruiting, hiring, coaching, and talent development experience.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret documents such as purchase agreements, financial reports, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Experience preparing reports, presentations, and business correspondence, and effectively presenting information to customers and internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of the hospital and healthcare environment, globally and/or within specific markets.
* Well-developed organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills.
* High computer proficiency, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

**Physical Job Requirements**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

**U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship**

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

**Company Description**

Lead the team behind an essential part of military healthcare: helping patients navigate appointments, specialty referrals, and access to care.

At International SOS Government Medical Services, you'll support healthcare programs that improve patient care and operational readiness across the U.S. and internationally. Founded in 1984, International SOS operates in more than 90 countries, delivering healthcare, medical assistance, emergency response, and workforce support services worldwide.

 **Job Description**

As a Patient Appointing Services (PAS) Supervisor, you'll oversee a healthcare contact center team supporting appointment scheduling, referral coordination, and administrative services for military healthcare beneficiaries.

You'll combine hands-on team leadership with performance management, quality monitoring, and operational improvement. Working closely with program leadership, you'll coach employees, evaluate service metrics, and help maintain consistent standards across patient access operations.

**Work Arrangement:** Remote. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of Houston, TX.

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, within operational service hours of 8:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. Central Time, excluding federal holidays. Assigned supervisory hours may vary. Overtime may be required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead daily operations: Oversee agent activities, distribute workloads, and manage assigned functions supporting patient scheduling, referrals, and healthcare administration.
* Manage team performance: Monitor call handling times, customer satisfaction, script adherence, and other performance indicators. Conduct evaluations, document employee performance, and provide coaching and feedback.
* Maintain quality and compliance: Monitor adherence to established procedures, service standards, organizational policies, and applicable healthcare regulations, including HIPAA.
* Improve operational workflows: Identify opportunities to strengthen processes, service quality, and team effectiveness while supporting departmental initiatives.
* Oversee reporting and administration: Compile monthly performance reports, review employee timekeeping records, and maintain documentation aligned with program requirements.
* Coordinate across teams: Collaborate with project management, organizational leadership, and external partners to address operational needs and support consistent service delivery.
* Support employee development: Provide training and mentoring, address personnel concerns, and foster an engaging, supportive work environment.

  
**Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* High school diploma or GED equivalent.
* At least 3 years of management experience, including 2 years managing professional and administrative personnel.
* Experience working closely with senior personnel, government employees, and other contractors.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective teams, resolve personnel issues, and manage employee performance.
* Familiarity with performance management, quality control, accounting, and finance standards and practices.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Teams, Excel, and Outlook, with the ability to learn and navigate additional systems and technologies.
* Strong customer service, communication, critical thinking, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.

**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of military healthcare processes and healthcare administration.
* Experience managing a fast-paced, high-volume call center.
* Experience with CXone, MHS GENESIS, or other call center software.

0d318bf0bed8ce4e0e72.title: Senior Manager Care Transitions Operations, High Risk Care - Amazon One Medical
0d318bf0bed8ce4e0e72.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Nov 18, 2026  
  
As Amazon One Medical Value-Based Care continues to grow, we're looking for a Healthcare Specialist III, Care Transitions Operations to lead a centralized team focused on ensuring smooth care transitions for AOM patients following ER visits, acute, and post-acute stays.  
  
Reporting to the Value Based Care Operations Leader, you'll be responsible for delivering on Amazon One Medical's promise of high quality of care, access, and patient-centered experiences at an affordable cost. You'll manage the centralized Transitions Management team, design efficient workflows, prevent readmissions, and drive operations performance using mechanisms.  
  
This role is for a strong people leader and innovative problem-solver who thrives on building engaged, cohesive teams. You're self-aware, a continual learner, and focused on the big picture. You've mastered the balance of customer service, administrative excellence, and motivating teams through times of change. You're looking for your next opportunity to deliver results, drive engagement, and lead people at an organization that is transforming healthcare.  
  
Although this role is coded as virtual, it is field-based (hubbed) by design. The selected candidate must work on-site from a manager-approved Amazon One Medical clinic location or from Seattle, WA.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the day-to-day operations of inbound, outbound, and administrative (back office) functions within the remote centralized transitions management team.
* Design and implement standard work, partner with leadership to determine operational strategies by evaluating team results and objectives, and drive continuous improvement across operations.
* Ensure all patients receive appropriate outreach and care coordination support during and after ER visits, acute, and post-acute care admissions.
* Build an engaged team by leveraging CICARE (a framework for effective communication with patients and each other), Active Daily Management, and Lean principles to meet patient care transition and team experience goals.
* Develop and refine transition outreach programs for additional patient populations.

  
A day in the life  
As a Healthcare Specialist III, Care Transitions Operations, you'll oversee the daily operations of our centralized transitions management team—managing both inbound and outbound patient outreach and administrative functions. You'll spend time analyzing team performance data to identify opportunities for streamlining workflows and reducing readmission rates for seniors & value-based reimbursement commercial patients transitioning from emergency room visits, acute care, and post-acute settings. You'll collaborate with clinical leadership to ensure patients receive timely and appropriate care coordination support during critical transition periods. Throughout your day, you'll coach team members using our CICARE communication framework Amazon LPs, mentor emerging leaders, and work cross-functionally with other departments to refine operational strategies that balance efficiency with compassionate patient care.  
  
About the team  
We are a dedicated group focused on transforming how AOM patients experience care transitions—a critical moment in their healthcare journey. Our team operates a centralized remote hub that coordinates outreach and support for patients moving between different levels of care. We're committed to preventing unnecessary readmissions while ensuring every patient feels supported and informed. Our vision is to create seamless, coordinated care experiences that keep seniors healthy and independent. You'll work alongside clinical staff, operations specialists, and leadership who share a commitment to continuous improvement and patient-centered care. We're building a culture where team members feel valued, supported, and empowered to solve complex operational challenges. Joining us means being part of an organization actively reshaping healthcare delivery for high risk patients.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Can show strong verbal and written communication skills
* 5+ years of relevant experience managing high-performing teams, with at least 2 years managing customer or patient-facing support teams in a high-volume, high-productivity support center.
* Proven ability to foster strong, collaborative team dynamics that ensure a supportive and engaged team culture.
* Experience developing talent through mentorship and coaching, consistent feedback, goal setting, and accountability.
* Proven track record of leading successful change management and process improvement efforts.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience navigating complex national markets and matrix healthcare organizations.
* Advanced understanding of regional-based healthcare, continuum of services, and business drivers of healthcare.
* Experience in healthcare, particularly in collaboration with clinicians.
* Excellent understanding of technology, software, and tools, along with experience with RingCentral/Nice-InContact, G Suite, and Electronic Health Record systems.

This role calls for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, autonomously troubleshoots problems, demonstrates initiative, and can multi-task at a high level. ### **Apply if you're excited to:**

* Handle full ticket lifecycle: investigate and resolve tickets, communicate the action items and resolution to end-users in simple terms, and ensure customer satisfaction
* Utilize a support ticketing system to accurately intake and effectively manage a queue of inquiries/technical issues

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with genuine care and empathy displayed through all interactions

* Proven problem solver with creative ideas and an ability to communicate complex issues in a concise manner
* Passionate about building relationships with different personalities and energized by turning neutral or unhappy customers into happy ones!

As a Remote Technical Support Specialist, you’ll help users resolve technology issues through clear, responsive support. You’ll troubleshoot computers, software, mobile devices, and network access, document each interaction, and guide clients through practical next steps. Your impact: By resolving issues and keeping support tickets organized, you help users return to their work with less disruption.

**Temple University's Fox School of Business is searching for a part-time Housing Coordinator of the STAR Housing Stability Initiative!**

**Hourly Rate:** $30/hr.  
*A variety of important factors are reviewed by HR when considering salary, including job duties, the applicant’s education and experience, all relevant internal equity considerations, department budget, and funding source.*

**Position Summary**  
Temple University's Fox School of Business partners with the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania's Problem-Solving Courts to provide housing-stability support for individuals returning to the Philadelphia community following federal incarceration. The Housing Coordinator, STAR Housing Stability Initiative, leads the day-to-day implementation of the Housing Counseling Program and serves as a principal subject-matter resource regarding housing access, real estate practices, and government housing policies and programs.

Reporting to the Associate Dean, the Housing Coordinator conducts comprehensive assessments of complex participant needs, provides individualized housing counseling, researches and recommends potential solutions, and coordinates access to housing and financial-stability resources. The position works collaboratively with the Associate Dean, court representatives, housing providers, government agencies, and community partners to refine program procedures, address participant barriers, and support consistent service delivery. Major program decisions are made collectively with University and court leadership.

The position is funded through 2028 by a donation from the Eastern District of Pennsylvania's Board of Judges, with the possibility of continued funding.

**Required Education and Experience**  

* Bachelor's degree in real estate, law, public policy, social services, counseling, business, or a related field
* At least five years of progressively responsible experience in housing counseling, real estate, reentry services, social services, or a related area
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**Preferred Education and Experience**  

* Juris Doctor or relevant master's degree

**Required Skills and Abilities**  

* Demonstrated knowledge of housing and real estate practices, government housing policies and programs, and resources available to justice-involved individuals
* Ability to assess complex circumstances, research viable options, and translate technical or regulatory information into clear, practical guidance
* Strong counseling, relationship-management, analytical, organizational, documentation, and communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with court officials, government agencies, community organizations, housing providers, and individuals from varied backgrounds
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, manage multiple participant matters, and work collaboratively in a developing program environment

*This position is assigned a hybrid work arrangement (on-campus and remote) – the duration of this hybrid work arrangement is at the discretion of Temple University and the Department.*

**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**

At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

**A Culture of Excellence**

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture-Backed Company of the Year

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**

As the Senior Director of Customer Success, you will lead our Named Customer Success Manager (CSM) team, focusing on high-value clients within the healthcare technology sector. You will continuously evolve our customer engagement strategy and operating model, optimizing connection frequency, strengthening proactive risk management, and elevating Annual Business Review (ABR) content to clearly demonstrate client ROI. You will own Net Retention Rate (NRR) and Gross Retention Rate (GRR) targets, driving commercial discipline across the portfolio. Additionally, you will modernize operations using AI tools, Gainsight platform transformations, and Voice of Customer (VoC) data to scale CSM capacity for high-value growth opportunities. In this role, you will directly manage specialty-specific CSM Managers, fostering a high-performing, high-EQ culture that balances rigorous performance standards with collaborative change management.

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Engagement & Operations:** Continuously evolve the customer engagement strategy and operating model to optimize contact frequency, enhance proactive risk management, and elevate Annual Business Review (ABR) content to showcase undeniable ROI.

* **High-EQ People Leadership:** Directly manage, mentor, and develop specialty-specific CSM Managers, utilizing collaborative operational design and proactive coaching to drive top-tier performance without causing burnout.

* **Commercial & Portfolio Ownership:** Take full ownership of NRR and GRR targets, translating customer adoption signals, Net Promoter Scores (NPS), and Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) into actionable strategies for renewal, retention, and wallet-share expansion.

* **Technology & Workflow Modernization:** Spearhead Customer Success platform transformations (e.g., Gainsight), integrate AI and VoC data into scalable workflows, and deploy Support Coordinators to offload tactical tasks, freeing up strategic CSM capacity.

* **Cross-Functional Alignment & Executive Presence:** Partner closely with General Managers, Sales, Product, and Services leadership to align cross-functional goals. Act as the executive sponsor for strategic accounts and build trusted advisor relationships at the C-level.

* **Voice of the Customer (VoC) & Strategic Initiatives:** Champion internal customer feedback to influence product roadmaps, optimize client health metrics, and direct the planning of multi-specialty Customer Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.

* Bachelor's Degree required.

NVC welcomes both experienced and new graduate veterinary professionals to join our compassionate team!

### **Client Service Representative | Nonantum Veterinary Clinic | Landenberg, PA**

**Compensation:** $18–$21/hour, commensurate with licensure and experience

**Position Summary:**

The Client Service Representative (CSR) plays a vital role in creating a positive first and lasting impression for our clients and their pets. The CSR is responsible for delivering exceptional service both in person and over the phone, handling client interactions with professionalism, empathy, and care. This position supports the smooth operation of the hospital by managing client communications, maintaining accurate records, and assisting the veterinary team in providing outstanding patient care.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Greet clients and patients warmly, providing professional, empathetic, and attentive service while answering in-person inquiries promptly.

* Complete patient check-in and check-out efficiently while serving as a liaison with hospital staff and communicating real-time patient status and flow changes.

4a5c9bccd6f6018971bd.title: Product Operations and Implementation Manager
4a5c9bccd6f6018971bd.description:
**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for a hands-on, technically minded Product Operations & Implementation Manager to help drive the successful adoption, operation, and continued improvement of our technology platform. You will become a subject matter expert on our product, serve as the connective link between clients, sales, product, and tech, and help translate what customers need into workable solutions.

This role's top priority will be ensuring client pre-sale scoping is executed, verifying our implementation and product readiness, and executing the client setup, configuration, training, onboarding, and implementation end-to-end successfully. Just as important, the foundation and standard procedures for our implementations are still to be defined, and must be setup for scale and efficiency by this role.

This is a highly hybrid role that brings together project management, client and account management, product operations, and technical implementation. The ideal candidate has experience across several of these areas and enjoys moving between client-facing responsibilities, coordinating projects, understanding technical requirements, and improving products and processes for scale.

**Work Arrangements**
=====================

Type: Full time, remote position. To be considered candidates must be located in one of the following states within the USA: CA, CO, CT, IL, MI, TN, VA, OH, FL. Candidates located elsewhere will not be considered and should not apply.

Candidates interested in part time or contractor opportunities may also be considered.

Working hours: Flexibility to work with both EMEA and California based colleagues is essential for success in this role. The right candidate will be ambitious, fast paced, self motivated, and capable of managing their own schedule with flexibility as needed to get the job done.

**What You'll Do**

**Client implementation and project coordination**

* Coordinate and execute end-to-end client implementations, from initial scoping and solution design, to readiness check and verification, testing, client setup, rollout and handoff to ongoing support.
* Work with Sales, Product and Technology to scope customized solutions and turn requirements into actionable technical plans.
* Own client-specific platform configuration, including metadata imports, integrations, APIs, taxonomy, and folder structures.
* Conduct product testing and verification against client expectations and pre-sales scoping, ensuring that client expectations and what is being sold is realistic, and achievable.
* Maintain project plans, track dependencies, and escalate risks or delays early. See to it that client projects and implementations assigned are completed successfully, smoothly, and timely.
* Standardize the proper procedure for client offboardings, and execute any client offboardings as needed.
* Develop repeatable implementation processes and templates that allow us to onboard new clients efficiently and consistently.

**Platform operations, knowledge, and performance**

* Develop a deep understanding of our platform, its capabilities, configurations, and technical workflows, positioning yourself as the product expert within the delivery and operations team, reducing the need to bring developers or product managers into client facing meetings.
* Build stronger product knowledge and skills within the delivery and operations team, cross training and upskilling colleagues to be just as capable at client onboarding and demonstrations as you.
* With the Technology team, build dashboards and reporting on usage, service performance, trends and account overages.
* Analyze costs, licensing and utilization, and fix recurring issues to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Participate in light prototyping as needed to better illustrate client feedback on product needs.
* Turn client workflows and pain points into requirements, PRDs and roadmap recommendations with the Product Manager and engineering team.
* Help train, test, and refine AI-powered agents within our platform by defining the needs, partnering with engineering, helping to prepare knowledge content, validating responses, identifying gaps and more.

**Client enablement, training and documentation**

* Drive user and client adoption through owning all onboarding, demos and training within the platform.
* Create a consistent, efficient, and repeatable onboarding experience, including checklists, training materials, configuration guides, and handoff processes.
* Build and maintain internal documentation, implementation team playbooks, and operational workflows. Partner with product and engineering to also ensure the support team has all documentation and playbooks needed.
* Help migrate our product knowledge base into new support system Freshdesk, close gaps by creating missing documentation and materials needed, and train and refine AI support tools.
* Implement product tours within our platform for regular and recurring topics / questions.

**Client success and account management**

* Manage a portfolio of smaller technical accounts without a dedicated Account Manager.
* Host regular check-ins on performance, client satisfaction, platform usage and renewals, bringing expansion opportunities to the table with Sales.
* Serve as the client point of contact or internal subject matter expert for all technical account questions (non technical support related)

**What You Need**

* Approximately 5 years of experience in a mix across product operations, technical project management, technical implementation, platform operations, customer success, client management, and account management.
* Bachelors degree in relevant field
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn complex technologies, platforms and workflows.
* Direct experience in the creative, broadcast, streaming, or production industries are strongly preferred.
* Experience owning and executing custom client solution designs and implementations, client onboarding, technical projects, or platform rollouts.
* Comfortable working with technical concepts such as APIs, integrations, metadata, system configurations, and troubleshooting.
* Experience creating process documentation, training materials, knowledge bases, and standard operating procedures.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate across teams, and keep projects moving forward.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret usage and operational data and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment where processes and technologies are still being developed and improved.

### **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

At Orb Group, you’ll get an exciting challenge at an entrepreneurial and global company. With us, you get to work with market-leading brands and exciting customers who will challenge you, and you, them.

Our employee benefits include:

* 12 paid holidays per year
* 401k Retirement Plan (employer contributions vested immediately)
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Pet Insurance
* Flexible Vacation (Exempt Positions) or revise if for hourly
* Up to 14 days of paid sick leave
* Up to 16 weeks paid parental leave

**Compensation:** Salary Exempt position. $90,000 to $120,000 USD annual salary, with flexibility dependent on experience.

**Who We Are**

Meet Orb Group. We are an independent global specialist in production and content marketing from inception to delivery, powered by technology and fueled by creativity. We have multiple global offices and 100+ colleagues worldwide, but we work as one team. We’ve partnered with some of the world’s biggest and most innovative and recognizable brands, including Ikea, Dyson, Absolut, Netflix, CBS, Polestar, Lego and PBS. Just to name a few.

Orb Group provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

39d2f7ce544d205a0670.title: Early Intervention Therapy Services Administrator: Operations & Compliance
39d2f7ce544d205a0670.description:
**Job Summary**

***Credentialing****: Must be credentialed with Early Intervention/ ElwynAdministrative/ Operational staff before starting — see note below.*

**About the Role**

Small Talk Therapeutic Services provides Early Intervention (EI) therapy services, working closely with our early intervention contracts (Infants & Toddlers and Elwyn) and Small Talk providers to support children and families. We're looking for a part-time Administrator to take ownership of the operational side of that work — compiling reports, managing systems access, keeping training and documentation on track, and helping our team run smoothly as we grow. You'll own these processes start to finish, spot problems before they become problems, and bring the Clinical Manager solutions, not just updates.

This role is primarily remote (about 90%), with occasional in-office days in Philadelphia for monthly team trainings.

**Tools & Systems You'll Use**

* **HCSIS** — Pennsylvania's state database for Early Intervention and disability services: provider enrollment, service authorizations, and participant records.
* **PEIDS** — the Philadelphia Early Intervention Data System — used to enter service start dates and other service-delivery records for children in Philadelphia's EI program.
* **Sprout** — the referral-tracking system used to receive, process, and return Early Intervention referrals between school districts (LEAs), intermediary units like Elwyn, and providers like us.
* **Relias** — the online training platform where required courses, competency trainings, and certifications get assigned and completed; Elwyn enrolls staff into either a Clinical or an Administrative/Operational learning path based on their role.
* **Pennsylvania Key Provider (PD) Registry** — the state's workforce registry for early childhood/EI professionals; tracks training completion, credentials, and career-pathway progress.
* **Jefferson TLC** — the training/credentialing platform staff use to complete required courses and certifications; you'll track completion through it.
* **SimplePractice** — our EHR (electronic health record) and practice-management platform: scheduling, billing, clinical notes, and the client portal.
* **Thrizer** — a payments platform that automates out-of-network insurance reimbursement, so clients pay only their estimated share while Thrizer handles the claim submission.
* **GoHighLevel** — our CRM (client relationship management) and automation platform: contact records, pipelines, scheduling, and automated emails/texts.
* **Google Workspace** — Google's business tools (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms, Calendar, Sites) for everyday documents, scheduling, and internal pages.
* **Power BI** — Microsoft's reporting/dashboard tool; turns raw data into the visual reports used for agency scorecards and metrics.
* **Loom** — a quick screen-recording tool for short how-to or walkthrough videos, instead of a long written explanation or a live meeting.
* **Claude** — Anthropic's AI assistant; you'll get your own seat to help draft, summarize, and speed up day-to-day admin and compliance work.
* You'll get a Small Talk Gmail account and the accounts/seats above set up for you.

**What You'll Do**

* **Onboarding & offboarding:** start onboarding for every new hire and make sure each step gets finished, following Small Talk’s SOPs. Also run offboarding when staff leave.
* **Medicaid (MA) applications:** prepare and submit them for Early Intervention.
* **Agency reporting & metrics** — Pull performance reports and monitor scorecard measures like session start dates, training completion, and compliance requirements, flagging anything that needs attention. Reporting to the clinical manager with metrics that require further attention.
* **Caseload administration** — Assign HCSIS access, request access through Elwyn's Zendesk system, and send referral emails to staff and LEAs so new hires have what they need to get started.
* **Referral returns** — Complete referral return forms, submit them to the LEA for approval, and return approved referrals in Sprout. Elevate to clinical manager when referrals are initiated for non-approved reasons.
* **Training & documentation compliance** — Run quarterly training check-ins and monthly credentialing/documentation compliance checks for Early Intervention and Elwyn.
* **ECO data monitoring** — Track ECO reports and follow up with staff to make sure Early Intervention and Elwyn data is accurate and on time.
* **Daily email** - Initiate/respond to daily emails. Elevate to appropriate contact if a specialized response is needed.
* Compile monthly hours for W2 salaried employees and flag/elevate providers who are not meeting hours. Elevate to the Clinical Manager when necessary, notify if all providers meet hours.
* **Other admin projects** — As the role evolves, additional projects will come up in our weekly check-ins.

**Elwyn Credentialing Requirement**

Because this role touches Early Intervention service delivery, it requires every staff member — including administrative/operational roles like this one — to be credentialed before they can start any work. As an Administrative/Operational hire, you won't need Elwyn's full clinical Learning Path; you'll complete their shorter administrative training track (including Sprout training) instead. The credentialing checklist Elwyn requires generally includes:

* A PA Child Abuse Clearance, PA Criminal History Clearance, and FBI Clearance (each must be current within 24 months and renewed every 5 years)
* An Act 24 Arrest/Conviction Report
* Proof of your highest degree or relevant education

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 30 days:** Credentialed, trained on HCSIS, PEIDS, Sprout and Relias, and running the daily inbox without reminders.
* **First 60 days:** Delivering the monthly compliance check and provider hours report on time, with issues already flagged.
* **First 90 days:** Running a tracker for every recurring deadline (clearances, trainings, ECO, referral returns), and you've proposed at least one process improvement.

**What We're Looking For**

More than any specific background, we're looking for someone who is:

* **Naturally inclined to streamline** — when something feels clunky or manual, you notice, and you have ideas for making it better.
* **Organized** — you have a real system for keeping track of recurring deadlines and follow-ups, and things don't fall through the cracks.
* **A clear communicator** — with staff, external agencies, and more than one point of contact on our side.
* **A loop-closer** - You follow up until it’s done, not just until you’ve sent the email.
* **Independent** — comfortable figuring things out when you don't have every step spelled out, and knowing when to flag something instead of guessing.
* **Willingness to learn our systems as they evolve**. While we are supportive, we are looking for a candidate that is a problem-solver and can learn new programs/systems quickly and independently.
* Experience with Early Intervention systems (HCSIS, Sprout) or healthcare/compliance administration is a plus but not required.

Compensation Note:

We're targeting $22-$28/hour to start, with placement within that range pending experience.

Pay: $22.00 - $28.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Philadelphia, PA 19129

b48730f09710af41ca72.title: Director, Logistics
b48730f09710af41ca72.description:
Finding the right place to grow your career isn't (over) easy, so we're here to help by sharing a few reasons why the grass is greener at Vital Farms. We think you'll appreciate our focus on Conscious Capitalism, which drives business decisions that benefit all our stakeholders (leading to even better business results). You might be drawn to our innovative approach and refusal to settle for the "way things have always been done." Or you could find it exciting to grow your skills while working for an industry-leading brand. Whether you're into our values, our brand, or our egg-cellent puns, we hope you'll join our Crew and help us change the world 108 square feet at a time!

At Vital Farms, we're proud of the diverse communities we serve and the stakeholders who help bring our purpose to life. We're committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative environment where every crew member feels valued. We see this as one of our greatest strengths - and your role is key to helping us build on it.

**Your Role:**

This position reports to the Vice President, Supply Chain.

You know that great logistics is more than moving product from one place to another. It is how we protect quality, deliver for our customers, support our farmers and crew, and grow responsibly. You bring a strong mix of strategy and operational leadership, and you are just as comfortable setting the direction for the network as you are working through a transportation disruption, a provider performance issue, or a difficult cost and service trade-off.

At Vital Farms, you will lead our end-to-end logistics network across inbound farm transportation, outbound customer transportation, warehousing, cold storage, and distribution. You will build the systems, partner relationships, operating rhythms, and team capabilities needed to deliver reliable service, preserve cold-chain integrity, manage cost, and scale with the business.

**What You'll Do:**

You will own the logistics strategy and lead the team and external partners responsible for moving and storing finished goods safely, reliably, and efficiently across the Vital Farms network.

**Lead the logistics strategy and network**

* Set and execute a logistics strategy that supports Vital Farms' growth, customer commitments, stakeholder model, and evolving supply chain operating model.
* Own short- and long-range capacity planning across transportation, cold storage, warehousing, and distribution; identify constraints early and build practical contingency plans.
* Evaluate network design, lane strategy, storage footprint, and operating models to improve service, resilience, scalability, and total delivered cost.
* Translate logistics performance, risks, trade-offs, and required decisions into clear recommendations for Supply Chain and company leadership.

**Own inbound and outbound transportation performance**

* Oversee inbound transportation from farms and suppliers and outbound transportation to customers and distribution points.
* Lead governance for dedicated fleet and managed transportation partners, including routing, appointment scheduling, load building and optimization, tendering, carrier performance, freight claims, and special requests.
* Use on-time pickup, on-time delivery, customer scorecards, freight performance, and exception data to set expectations, drive accountability, and improve service.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for transportation disruptions, balancing immediate recovery with root-cause correction and prevention.

**Lead warehousing, distribution, and 3PL partnerships**

* Maintain overall accountability for receiving, storage, inventory handling, order fulfillment, and shipping of finished goods across the network.
* Manage and strengthen relationships with third-party transportation, distribution, and warehousing providers through clear governance, contracts, performance reviews, KPIs, and corrective action plans.
* Partner with site, Quality, and distribution leaders to maintain food safety, cold-chain integrity, inventory accuracy, pallet and load quality, and consistent shipment standards.
* Support new facility and distribution-capability readiness, including operating requirements, systems integration, launch planning, and transition into sustainable operations.

**Build financial and operational discipline**

* Develop and own logistics budgets and forecasts, including transportation, warehousing, distribution, accessorial, claims, and related operating costs.
* Identify cost drivers and loss areas, build fact-based recommendations, and deliver sustainable savings without compromising food safety, quality, crew safety, or customer service.
* Establish a practical KPI and operating-review cadence that creates one shared view of service, inventory flow, capacity, cost, risks, and actions.
* Partner with Finance and Supply Chain peers on forecasts, accruals, variance reviews, customer pickup economics, and business cases for logistics investments.

**Advance systems, data, and continuous improvement**

* Improve the integration and effective use of D365, transportation management systems, warehouse management systems, 3PL platforms, automation, and reporting tools.
* Connect operational data across internal and partner systems so teams can identify issues quickly and translate insights into action.
* Lead continuous improvement across transportation and distribution, including standard work, exception management, claims, inventory handoffs, customer feedback loops, and escalation paths.
* Partner with IT, Operations Development, and external providers to improve system reliability, visibility, controls, and readiness for future growth.

**Lead the team and cross-functional partnerships**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Logistics team with clear roles, priorities, decision rights, and accountability for results.
* Build strong working relationships across Farm Support, Operations, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, IT, and commercial teams.
* Create a culture of urgency, ownership, constructive challenge, learning, and recognition while modeling Vital Farms' values.
* Build team capability and succession depth across transportation operations, analytics, systems, partner management, and network leadership.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* You have 10+ years of progressive experience in logistics, transportation, warehousing, or distribution, preferably in food, beverage, CPG, or another temperature-sensitive environment.
* You have led a complex, multi-node logistics network and managed third-party transportation and warehousing providers.
* You understand transportation markets, carrier and fleet operations, warehousing and distribution, cold-chain requirements, and relevant regulatory considerations.
* You can manage budgets, analyze cost and service trade-offs, and deliver measurable operational and financial improvements.
* You have experience with ERP and supply chain execution technology, such as D365 or a comparable ERP, TMS, WMS, warehouse automation, and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* You use data and sound judgment to turn operational details and ambiguity into clear decisions and action plans.
* You communicate clearly, influence across functions, negotiate effectively, and lead through external partners as well as direct teams.
* You are a proven people leader who coaches, develops talent, and creates clear accountability.
* You are available to travel approximately 20-30% based on business needs, provider reviews, facility support, and network initiatives.
* Bonus points if you have launched or scaled logistics capabilities, facilities, automation, or major system integrations.
* You're no hero – You know the power of teamwork and celebrate the work of others before your own.
* You give a sh\*t – You believe in acting like an owner and making Vital Farms a place to be proud of.
* You raise the standards – You know growth can be hard, but you strive to improve yourself and others each day.
* You can walk in someone else's boots – You seek to understand other's viewpoints and think that you get to better answers by sitting on the same side of the table.
* You don't walk on eggshells – You're not afraid to leave the bullsh\*t behind and have honest conversations.
* We recognize that talent comes in many forms. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may have strengths we haven't yet considered!

**What We Bring to the Table:**

* A fast-paced, energetic, remote environment with passionate people who are leading a movement to bring ethically produced food to the table.
* Competitive pay and benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Paid Parental Leave, just to name a few).
* Generous retirement contributions: 401(k) + 3% Contribution from Day 1.
* Free eggs, along with friends and family discounts.
* Fun team SWAG that will make you the talk of the town.
* Professional development opportunities and an amazing team dedicated to your growth.

At Vital Farms, compensation decisions are dependent upon a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to, skill level, experience, education, training, market demands, and business needs. A reasonable estimate of the current starting annual base salary for this position is **$170,000 - $190,000**. Please keep in mind that hiring at the maximum end of the range would not be typical in order to allow for potential continued future salary growth.

**Who We Are:**

Vital Farms, a Certified B Corporation, offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide. Started on a single farm in Austin, Texas, in 2007, Vital Farms became a national consumer brand that works with 600 family farms and is the leading U.S. brand of pasture-raised eggs by retail dollar sales. Here at The Tri-M Group, LLC we are an **employee owned company** placing our employees first, knowing that highly trained, skilled, and compensated workforce can better serve our customers, our families and our communities. **Summary Description**

Supervises and directs overall administration, organization and implementation of assigned electrical projects in a manner that optimizes customer satisfaction and project profitability. This includes design, layout, scheduling, material requisition, labor assignments and billing. Duties also include assigned employee career development and performance appraisals.

**Company Description**

Lochner and Egis are entering an exciting new chapter as one organization.

We have combined decades of trusted U.S. engineering expertise with the global reach, technical excellence, and career opportunities of a leading international engineering, consulting, and infrastructure firm. While our name has changed, our commitment to our people, clients, and communities is stronger than ever.

At Egis, every project is an opportunity to create lasting impact. We collaborate with public and private clients to design and deliver innovative transportation, aviation, rail, transit, water, structural, environmental, and infrastructure solutions that connect communities and improve everyday life. Join a team where innovation is encouraged, collaboration is valued, and your work helps build a more sustainable future.

 **Job Description**

Egis is looking for a licensed engineer in PA with either highway, traffic or bridge project management experience.

**The Impact You'll Make**

* Project management experience with roadway/structure-focused projects for PennDOT, Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission, local governments, and other clients
* Manage and maintain project and QA/QC documentation
* Assist project managers with assignments as needed including schedule and budget updates and proposal preparation.
* Direct, review and/or perform engineering calculations from preliminary to final design.
* Direct and coordinate plan development, specifications, reports, and cost estimates.
* Prepare plans, specifications, cost estimates, conduct studies, and support all aspects of an engineering projects while collaborating with staff, consultants, and clients.
* May perform site and roadway/structure inspections and other responsibilities associated with this position as required.
* Responsible for client development and fostering relationships with existing and new clients.
* Participate with a team of talented professionals in various disciplines, sub-consultants, and reviewers to ensure efficient and productive utilization of staff in providing high-quality service for our clients.
* Responsible for management of project budgets, goal setting, determining scope of work, estimating fees, and preparing proposals and contracts on projects.
* Responsible for project progression, accurate client billing, and project profitability.
* Provide mentorship and development opportunities to engineering support staff and aspiring professionals.
* Adaptability to partner with Egis offices throughout the firm through work-sharing to deliver projects across the country on-time and within budget.

  
**Qualifications**

**The Expertise You'll Bring**

* Minimum of B.S. in Civil Engineering
* Registered Professional Engineer in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania is required.
* 12+ years of roadway/structure design with project management experience.
* Experience analyzing project progress in conformance with project budgets, quality, scope, client reporting, and sub-consultant coordination.
* Experience in business development, client management, and marketing to Pennsylvania transportation clients.
* Ability to work with our talented marketing team to lead project pursuits, including the development of project proposals (written, presentations, interviews etc.).
* Advanced level of technical writing and communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills with the ability to build strong relationships.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why You'll Thrive at Egis**

At Egis, you'll do more than build your career—you'll help shape the future of infrastructure. As we continue to expand across the United States, we're looking for curious, collaborative professionals who are passionate about solving complex challenges and delivering projects that improve communities and create lasting impact.

Whether you're launching your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading experts, collaborate across disciplines and borders, and contribute to projects that transform the way people live, move, and connect. Here, you'll be empowered to take on meaningful work, develop new skills, and grow your career with the support of a global engineering leader.

***What Sets Egis Apart***

* **Meaningful Projects** – Contribute to complex infrastructure projects that strengthen communities and improve quality of life.
* **Global Expertise, Local Impact** – Collaborate with technical specialists across North America and around the world while delivering solutions that make a difference locally.
* **Career Growth** – Expand your skills through mentorship, professional development, technical training, and leadership opportunities.
* **A Culture of Collaboration** – Thrive in an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and teamwork drives success.
* **Opportunity to Grow with Us** – Join a rapidly expanding organization where your ideas, contributions, and career can grow alongside the business.

***Total Rewards That Support You***

We believe great work starts with supporting our people. That's why Egis offers a comprehensive Total Rewards program designed to promote your health, well-being, financial security, and professional growth, including:

* Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off and flexible holiday program
* Flexible work arrangements, including hybrid and remote opportunities where business needs allow
* Life insurance and disability coverage, including maternity leave
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for healthcare and dependent care expenses
* Paid family leave
* Wellness programs supporting physical and mental well-being
* Education assistance, professional development, and continuing learning opportunities
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Employee discount programs

***Compensation & Pay Transparency***

At Egis, we believe transparency helps candidates make informed career decisions. As part of our commitment to an open and equitable hiring process, we've included the anticipated base salary range for this position below.

**Anticipated Base Salary Range:** **$117,000.00- $180,000.00 annually**

We're committed to making competitive offers that recognize the unique experience, expertise, and value each candidate brings to our team.

In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for incentive compensation, where applicable, and a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes health benefits, retirement savings, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and other employee programs.

***Equal Employer***

Egis is proudly committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse and inclusive workforce. Egis provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

All positions at Egis require an applicant who has accepted an employment offer to undergo pre-employment screening. Background checks include SSN/SIN validation, motor vehicle verification, education verification, employment verification, a criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, and drug tests. All employment offers are contingent upon successful results of the pre-employment screening.

**DDP Roofing Services, Inc. | Glen Mills, PA**

**Job Type:** Full-Time, Exempt **Work Location:** On-Site — Glen Mills, PA

**About DDP Roofing Services**
------------------------------

We are a premier roofing company providing installation, repairs, and maintenance services to corporate partners across the East Coast. Our culture is built on customer service, respect, integrity, teamwork, and a passion for excellence.

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Sales Operations Coordinator to join our team at our Glen Mills, PA office.

**About the Position**
----------------------

The Sales Operations Coordinator plays an important role in supporting the daily operations of our Sales department. This position works closely with Sales leadership, Sales Representatives, and other internal departments to ensure information is accurate, processes are followed, and important activities are completed on time.

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who takes initiative, works independently, and enjoys keeping multiple processes moving forward. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who recognizes when something needs attention, communicates effectively across departments, and consistently follows through on outstanding tasks. Strong organizational skills, accountability, and a collaborative approach are essential to success in this role.

Work Schedule: This is a full-time, on-site position based at our Glen Mills, PA office.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Sales Administration & CRM Management**

* Maintain accurate customer information, sales activity records, and project documentation within Salesforce.
* Coordinate weekly sales activity reviews, track action items, and follow up on outstanding requirements.
* Monitor sales-related information to identify missing documentation, incomplete records, and items requiring attention.
* Support Sales leadership with scheduling, reporting, and administrative follow-up.

**Project Documentation & Departmental Communication**

* Review project write-ups to ensure required information is complete and accurate before submission.
* Work with Sales Representatives to resolve missing information and support smooth transitions to Estimating and Production.
* Maintain standardized documentation checklists and established procedures.
* Review project closeout packages and ensure required documentation is properly maintained in Salesforce.

**Preventive Maintenance & Customer Support**

* Track Preventive Maintenance opportunities and coordinate follow-up with Sales, Service, and Accounting.
* Monitor outstanding activities through completion, including scheduling, invoicing, and customer reporting.
* Assist with customer follow-up, reference requests, online reviews, and project photographs.
* Support ongoing customer communication and service opportunities.

**Compliance & Administrative Support**

* Maintain Certificates of Insurance and customer prequalification documentation.
* Manage assigned records and updates within Avetta, ISNetworld, and other compliance platforms.
* Coordinate with internal departments to obtain required information and maintain accurate records.
* Serve as a liaison between Sales leadership and Human Resources for new Sales employee hiring and onboarding coordination.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Previous experience in sales support, sales administration, project administration, or a similar position.
* Experience in commercial roofing, construction, or a related service industry preferred.
* Experience working with CRM systems; Salesforce experience required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word.
* Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.
* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with employees across multiple departments.
* Proactive approach to identifying problems, following up on outstanding items, and ensuring tasks are completed.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* Primarily sedentary office work, including extended periods of sitting and working at a computer.
* Frequent use of a keyboard, mouse, telephone, and standard office equipment.
* Occasional standing, walking, bending, reaching, and lifting or carrying office materials up to 15 pounds.
* Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, and electronically.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* Competitive salary based on experience.
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Life and disability insurance.
* Generous paid time off (PTO) policy.
* Bonus pay opportunities.

**Why Join DDP Roofing Services?**
----------------------------------

At DDP Roofing Services, you'll be part of a growing organization where your contributions make a meaningful difference. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with multiple departments, take ownership of important responsibilities, and help improve the processes that support our continued growth.

DDP Roofing Services, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants without regard to any legally protected status.
