eb8465e12861f8472b1d.title: Project Manager IV- Implementation Lead
eb8465e12861f8472b1d.description:
**Employment for this position is contingent upon approval of contract funding.**

**Position Overview**

The ERP Project Manager leads cross-functional and cross-organizational teams in the planning, execution, and delivery of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) initiatives, including software implementations, upgrades, and modernization efforts. Working with minimal management oversight, this role provides project management leadership throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring solutions meet business objectives, technical requirements, and organizational standards

  

**Major Activities (Typical Duties/Responsibilities)**

The IT Project Manager is responsible for supporting strategic initiatives at the Hanford site, including defining tasks and timelines, coordinating across departments, managing budgets, and ensuring timely delivery. The IT Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, and completion of projects, ensuring consistency with organizational strategy, contractual commitments, and goals.

Specific duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

**Vendor and Implementor Oversight**

* Monitor external implementors for compliance with contractual scope, deliverables, schedules, implementation methodologies, and statements of work.
* Validate completion of project plans, RAID logs, cutover planning, requirements tracking, testing support, training, and knowledge-transfer activities.
* Oversee discovery, design, configuration, testing, and knowledge-transfer activities.
* Verify deliverables align with approved scope, methodology, contractual commitments, and organizational standards.
* Identify and escalate vendor performance issues, delivery concerns, scope discrepancies, and contractual risks to program, product, contracting, and other appropriate leadership.
* Enforce vendor accountability without changing contract scope or formally approving deliverables.

**Internal Team and Resource Coordination**

* Coordinate Technical, DMI, BMS, and IDMS teams to align activities with project scope, schedule, and objectives.
* Facilitate alignment on requirements, design decisions, configuration validation, testing, readiness, and implementation activities.
* Ensure internal stakeholders understand deliverables, dependencies, deadlines, and resource commitments.
* Monitor workloads, forecast resource requirements, identify capacity constraints, and maintain a resource-loaded schedule.
* Escalate staffing, prioritization, and resource risks as needed.

**Project Planning, Scheduling, and Controls**

* Develop and maintain integrated project schedules, scope matrices, RAID logs, action logs, and resource plans.
* Conduct schedule quality reviews, validate task logic and dependencies, and ensure schedules reflect realistic resource availability and deliverable readiness.
* Produce rolling two-to-six-week forecasts.
* Assess critical-path impacts and coordinate corrective actions.
* Anticipate and manage risks, dependencies, resource needs, key decisions, and schedule impacts.

**Governance, Risk, and Decision Management**

* Establish and facilitate decision-making forums involving leadership, subject-matter experts, delivery partners, and stakeholders.
* Identify, track, mitigate, and escalate project risks and issues across vendor and internal teams.
* Monitor decision timelines and escalate matters that impede project progress.
* Coordinate project status reporting, Steering Committee updates, milestone-readiness reviews, and program-level reporting.
* Translate technical and business process issues into clear executive decision requests.
* Prepare structured inputs for enterprise and program governance forums.
* Support lessons learned, project documentation, knowledge transfer, handoff activities, and formal project closure.

**Communication and Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as the primary communication point among implementors, business stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership.
* Maintain transparent communication regarding project status, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, milestones, and outcomes.
* Facilitate internal and external meetings, document decisions, and track resulting action items.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, communications, and reporting.
* Support change-management activities to align vendor deliverables with organizational adoption requirements.
* Maintain alignment with product, program, initiative, and executive leadership.
* Contractual Alignment and Quality Assurance
* Ensure implementors deliver required methodologies, deliverables, and responsibilities defined in statements of work, contracts, and RFP responses.
* Monitor dependencies that may affect milestones, deliverables, or contractual obligations.
* Define and document acceptance criteria and coordinate deliverable review and validation cycles.
* Coordinate internal inspection, validation, and acceptance activities without independently approving or rejecting deliverables.
* Escalate contractual, scope, quality, or compliance concerns to the appropriate authorities.

  

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

* You are recognized as a subject matter expert (SME) in job area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience.
* You have proven strong organizational and leadership skills to manage large high-profile projects or processes under tight deadlines with very limited or no oversight from manager.
* You are highly self-motivated and self-directed.
* You have the vision and mindset to identify, handle, and resolve problems quickly before they become recurring issues.
* You are able to build a rapport with stakeholders and senior leadership by actively listening to and understanding their needs and concerns to ensure you can address them effectively.
* You are familiar with all aspects of software quality assurance principles. This could include but not limited to ASME Nuclear Quality Assurance (NQA-1) standards.
* You are able to communicate effectively and work well in teams while continuously learning from peers.
* You are able to provide clear, concise, and effective verbal and written communications regularly to ensure that all project stakeholders are informed of project status.
* You are able to facilitate all project meetings and create/update/distribute project documentation.
* You are able to provide effective leadership to development teams, fellow project managers, and project stakeholders.
* You lead with confidence and encourage consensus and collaboration while ensuring key objectives are met.

  

**Physical Abilities**

* Sufficient fine motor skills for the use of computers, calculators with an ability to withstand repetitive keyboarding for extended periods of time.
* Visual and communications ability adequate to perform the essential functions of the job.
* Ability to kneel, bend and twist at the waist on an occasional basis.
* Ability to reach below shoulder height with regular frequency (desk position) and at or above shoulder height on occasion.
* Ability to push, pull, carry and lift objects weighing up to 10 pounds on a regular basis, and greater weights on an occasional basis.
* Ability to travel by vehicle or aircraft, and ability to safely operate a motor vehicle.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree and 8 or more years of management experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Must pass pre-employment background check.
* Must pass pre-employment drug screening.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy access authorization (HSPD-12 PIV credential); this requires a successful federal background investigation. Declarations of illegal drug use, including marijuana and cannabis derivatives (regardless of state law), within the last year may affect eligibility.
* Applicants are required to have REAL ID ACT compliant documentation at time of hire and nothing on record that would prohibit you from gaining access to Department of Energy sites.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience in the project management and implementation of Peoplesoft (ERP) software and OpenText product suite.
* Experience with Software/IT life cycles (SDLC). SDLC knowledge should include both Waterfall and Agile methodologies.
* Minimum of 3 years working in an Agile development environment.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure DevOps and/or other Agile methodology organization tools such as Jira, Asana, or Trello.

  

**Pay Range:** **$124,441.00 - $180,842.00**

**Benefits:** OSC Technical Solutions offers excellent benefits for eligible employees. Benefits include paid holidays, paid time off, 401k with employer match, dental, vision, health insurance plans through the Federal Employee Health Benefits (FEHB) program, as well as life and disability benefits.

OSC Technical Solutions does not discriminate, and the company provides equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, age, marital status, pregnancy or parenthood, handicap or disability, genetics, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. OSC Technical Solutions adheres to all federal, state and local laws regarding equal employment opportunity and will not discriminate against you in violation of these laws. OSC Technical Solutions reserves the right to apply CIRI Shareholder preference to qualified Shareholders in employment and advancement opportunities.

  

OSC Technical Solutions participates in E-Verify. We will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), with information from each new employee's Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

**Reasonable Accommodation:**

OSC Technical Solutions will provide reasonable accommodations, according to applicable state and federal laws, to all qualified individuals with physical or mental disabilities. In compliance with the ADA Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position with OSC Global, LLC or any of its subsidiaries, please email recruiting@ciri.com.

**Important Employment Notice: Federal Contract & RCW 49.44.240:**

Due to our status as a federal contractor operating within the State of Washington, all applicants and employees must adhere to federal law, which classifies cannabis as a Schedule I controlled substance.

While Washington State’s RCW 49.44.240 (which generally prohibits employers from discriminating against an applicant based on their lawful use of cannabis off-site and during working hours) is state law, it does not supersede federal requirements.

*Zero-Tolerance Policy and Disqualification*

* Prohibition: The use, possession, or distribution of cannabis is strictly prohibited for all employees, regardless of state law.
* Testing: Applicants will be subject to pre-employment drug screening that includes testing for cannabis.
* Disqualification: A positive test result for cannabis will result in immediate disqualification from consideration for employment, as mandated by our federal contract obligations.

  

All applicants must be able to comply with all federal regulations, including those concerning controlled substances, as a condition of employment.

In compliance with Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Hanford Field Office (HFO) direction, employees issued initial badges on or after September 1st, 2025, are required to obtain and maintain a HSPD-12 Personal Identity Verification (PIV) Credential. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete and pass a federal background check investigation. This investigation encompasses multiple areas of eligibility and includes a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last year. This includes marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

7ed410f476fc8bc43391.title: Senior Recruiting Coordinator
7ed410f476fc8bc43391.description:
**Build a Safer World.**
------------------------

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

We’re looking for a Senior Recruiting Coordinator to deliver an exceptional candidate and interviewer experience and help lead the day-to-day work of our global coordination team. You’ll own complex interview scheduling, bring deep Ashby expertise, use metrics to improve performance, and mentor fellow coordinators. You’ll also manage the day-to-day work of the AI agents we’re building to support recruiting coordination.

Partnering closely with Talent Operations, you’ll improve how our people, systems, and AI agents work together. This is a hands-on role for someone who communicates proactively, brings solutions, and moves with urgency, with opportunities to grow into people management over time.

**The impact you will have:**
-----------------------------

* Own complex interview scheduling across teams and time zones, delivering a responsive, well-organized experience for candidates and interviewers.
* Serve as the team’s Ashby expert, resolving scheduling issues, coaching coordinators, and partnering with Talent Operations to improve workflows.
* Own day-to-day coordination operations and support Talent Operations projects, keeping Ashby records, interview plans, and scheduling data accurate and up to date.
* Drive coordination performance through accurate reporting on interview volume, time to schedule, SLA adherence, reschedules, and candidate and interviewer feedback.
* Develop fellow coordinators through onboarding, training, and practical coaching, helping the team manage priorities, workloads, and coverage.
* Manage AI agents that support recruiting coordination, reviewing their work, resolving exceptions, and improving their accuracy and reliability with Talent Operations.
* Partner closely with recruiters and the Talent team, aligning on priorities, communicating risks early, and bringing clear recommendations that keep interviews moving.

**What we’re looking for:**
---------------------------

* 4+ years of recruiting coordination experience, with demonstrated success managing complex, high-volume scheduling in a fast-moving environment.
* Advanced Ashby expertise is required, including interview plans, interviewer pools, scheduling links, calendar integrations, and independent troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting Talent Operations or coordination operations, including ATS data quality, workflow maintenance, and process documentation.
* Strong command of Ashby reporting and coordination metrics, with a track record of translating data into better scheduling outcomes.
* Experience mentoring coordinators, leading training, and helping teammates use Ashby confidently and effectively.
* Clear, proactive communication and the ability to build trusted partnerships with candidates, interviewers, recruiters, and Talent Operations.
* Sound judgment and a strong sense of urgency: you investigate problems, recommend solutions, and follow through without repeated direction.
* Applied AI fluency, including writing instructions, evaluating outputs, and identifying when human judgment is needed. Experience managing AI agents is a strong plus.

**About the Team:**
-------------------

* Our talent team is fully remote, embracing async communication and collaboration through Slack channels, thorough documentation, and proactive updates to keep work moving forward smoothly across time zones.
* We hold weekly RC team syncs to review priorities and solve coordination challenges. Coordinators also participate in hiring syncs for the roles they support, staying close to candidate progress, hiring decisions, and upcoming needs.
* Driven by a dedication to our craft, we continuously refine our best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for both internal stakeholders and candidates, supported by precise, reliable reporting.

**Team Operating Rhythms:**
---------------------------

* Based in the Pacific Time Zone, working 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. PT.
* As a globally distributed team, we operate across various time zones, yet most of us overlap for collaboration and meetings between 7 a.m.–12 p.m. PT.
* An active scheduling workload alongside coordination operations, Ashby data maintenance, mentoring, reporting, and AI agent oversight.
* Advance coverage planning for holidays and absences, with clear owners and next steps.

**Learn about TRM Speed in this position:**
-------------------------------------------

* When an interviewer cancels, you promptly identify alternatives, recommend a solution, and confirm the revised plan with the candidate and interview team.
* When scheduling misses turnaround targets, you use Ashby data to diagnose the issue, recommend a change, and track whether performance improves.
* When an AI agent sends incomplete instructions, you correct the affected communications and partner with Talent Operations to test a fix.

**Application Instructions**
----------------------------

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

**Interviewing with TRM**
-------------------------

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

* **Recruiter Intro:** Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
* **Hiring Manager:** Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
* **First Round:** 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
* **Final Round:** Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
* **References:** Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
* **Offer:** Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
* **Welcome to TRM:** We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

**AI Fluency at TRM**
---------------------

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

* Accelerate repeatable workflows
* Structure and solve problems
* Improve output quality
* Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

**Life at TRM**
---------------

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

* Priorities and targets to change quickly
* Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
* A high level of personal ownership and accountability
* Close collaboration across teams and functions
* Frequent, high-touch communication
* Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
* A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

**Leadership Principles**
-------------------------

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

* Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
* Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
* Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

**Join our Mission**
--------------------

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

**Privacy Policy and Additional Information**
---------------------------------------------

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

### **Recruitment agencies**

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

92c6d8720c3d958b6be5.title: Project Manager - DOT
92c6d8720c3d958b6be5.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Project Manager

**REPORTS TO****:** Regional General Manager

**FLSA STATUS****:** Exempt

  

**SUMMARY**

The Project Manager is responsible for their assigned office’s overall operations to ensure goals and objectives are achieved, while improving efficiencies and encouraging professional growth of the employees under their management.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Associate’s degree in a related field or equivalent combination of skills and experience
* Minimum of two (2) years of management experience or leading teams
* A valid driver’s license, good driving record, and the ability to drive company vehicles
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DOT medical card
* Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, by ground or air, including overnight travel
* State level herbicide applicator license in states worked
* Proficient in calibration of equipment
* Expert knowledge of routing
* General understanding of business accounting and P&L statements
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, written, and organizational skills
* Strong decision making and problem solving
* In-depth knowledge of the industry
* Team player with a growth mindset
* Proficient in using various forms of technology to complete tasks effectively and efficiently
* Knowledge of operating systems such as GDS, UKG, Samsara, Chrome River, and Fyle, and Microsoft Office Suite products

  

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Must have the ability to sit, kneel, bend, stand, or walk for 8-10 hours a day
* Must have the ability to routinely lift, push, pull, or move equipment of 50 pounds or more
* Must have the ability to withstand exposure to various weather conditions while completing work assignments (rain, heat, humidity, sun, etc.)
* Must have the ability to move around water and walk, stand, and move through diverse types of terrain, including uneven ground and sloped embankments
* Must have the ability to work within confined spaces
* Must be willing to be in close proximity to wildlife such as snakes, stinging insects, spiders, and other species
* Must be able to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) as necessary

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Exemplify our five core values (Safety, Others, Integrity, Initiative, and Passion)
* Oversee and manage the daily operations, scheduling and routing of crews within assigned territory
* Develop strategic plans and create efficiencies that optimize productivity

* Build calendar for work group 30 days in advance
* Conduct technical training and coaching of crews within territory
* Review application reports and submit for invoicing in a timely manner
* Manage and oversee weekly meeting agendas for operations to include, but are not limited to, safety and production
* Manage and track licenses, medical cards, and other certifications for team members
* Review and approve timesheets for team members
* Review and approve expenses for team members
* Manage subcontractors and required documentation including, but not limited to, subcontractor agreements and certificates of insurance (COI’s)
* Conduct quality control inspections of customer sites and subcontractor work
* Provide excellent customer service, ensure customer satisfaction, and maintain customer retention
* Make follow-up calls to customers regarding quality and invoicing
* Manage and maintain the health and maintenance of the fleet and equipment
* Manage maintenance of the office and facilities
* Manage fuel costs, chemical usage, uniforms, and inventory
* Review tailgate briefing meetings
* Review Samsara videos and provide coaching when necessary
* Perform assessments for team members
* Implement kickoff meetings and a tracking system for large projects
* Attend company meetings as requested
* Assist the Regional General Manager in determining staffing needs and assisting with the hiring and selection process
* Establish and maintain a positive work environment that encourages collaboration and communication
* Perform administrative, human resources, payroll, and expense responsibilities to support territory operations, and work with other departments, as needed
* Maintain a safety culture and compliance and stay up to date on OHSA, DOT, and other applicable rules and regulations
* Assist with incident investigations and implement corrective actions, when needed
* Understand and enforce all company policies, including, but not limited to, safety, human resources, and accounting policies
* Respond to employee concerns in a timely manner and escalate when necessary
* Provide effective performance feedback through recognition, rewards, performance reviews, and disciplinary action
* Build and maintain a strong team through effective training, coaching, and team building
* Encourage career development planning and opportunities to team members
* Build future leaders through mentoring and succession planning
* Perform other duties as assigned

Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, marital status, disability status, genetics, political affiliation, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

Equal Opportunity Employer

249df01837d8fd8ed681.title: VP of Client Success, Program Director - Healthcare
249df01837d8fd8ed681.description:
**Job Description: About EXL Health**

We leverage Human Ingenuity and domain expertise to help clients improve outcomes, optimize revenue, and maximize profitability across the healthcare ecosystem. Technology, data, and analytics are at the heart of our solutions. We collaborate closely with clients to transform how care is delivered, managed, and paid.

EXL Health combines deep domain expertise with analytic insights and technology-enabled services to transform how care is delivered, managed, and paid. Leveraging Human Ingenuity, we collaborate with our clients to solve complex problems and enhance their performance with nimble, scalable solutions. With data on more than 260 million lives, we work with hundreds of organizations across the healthcare ecosystem.

We help payers improve member care quality and network performance, manage population risk, and optimize revenue while decreasing administrative waste and reducing health claim expenditures. We help Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs) manage member drug benefits and reduce drug spending while maintaining quality. We help provider organizations proactively manage risk, improve outcomes, and optimize network performance. We provide Life Sciences companies with enriched data, insights through advanced analytics and data visualization tools to get the right treatment to the right patient at the right time.

The VP of Client Success, Program Director - Healthcare will play a pivotal role in leading complex programs for US healthcare clients across the healthcare ecosystem, including payer, provider, PBM, life sciences, and government program clients.

The role will focus on payer and provider care management, case management, population health, quality improvement, and analytics-enabled platform solutions. The role is responsible for aligning program objectives with client business priorities, regulatory expectations, operational performance goals, and EXL Health’s broader growth strategy.

This leader will oversee cross-functional delivery, ensure successful implementation and adoption of healthcare technology and analytics solutions, and drive measurable outcomes such as improved member and patient experience, care coordination, quality performance, operational efficiency, and cost optimization.

  

Responsibilities: This role requires a strategic healthcare leader with a strong program management discipline, executive communication skills, and a comprehensive understanding of US healthcare operations, data, analytics, and platform delivery.

Primary responsibilities include:

* Serve as the primary delivery voice for EXL Health teams, coordinating cross-functional activities for US healthcare payers, provider, PBM, life sciences, and government program clients in a cohesive, outcome-driven manner.

* Bridge clinical, operational, regulatory, data, analytics, and digital platform priorities across contracted care management, case management, utilization management, and population health solutions.

* Enable EXL Health delivery teams to effectively deliver, communicate, escalate, and prioritize services and solutions aligned to client objectives, service-level commitments, and healthcare program outcomes.

* Act as a liaison between the client, business programs, and executive leadership, providing updates addressing concerns, and shaping recommendations that connect client business problems to EXL Health strategy, roadmap priorities, and partnership opportunities.

* Translate ambiguous or evolving client requests into structured workplans, tactical next steps, executive-ready decision points, and cross-functional action plans.

* Think critically about how client business problems, market pressures, regulatory priorities, and operational constraints should inform EXL Health strategy, delivery model, and growth opportunities

* Hold delivery teams accountable for measurable healthcare outcomes, including

* implementation milestones, adoption, operational performance, quality measures, compliance readiness, and client satisfaction.

* Achieving annual growth targets aligned with client objectives and targets.

* Develop and maintain an in-depth understanding of EXL Health’s US healthcare portfolio and client base, including payers, providers, PBMs, life sciences organizations, and government healthcare programs, as well as care management, case management, utilization management, quality, risk adjustment, member and patient engagement, data, analytics, and AI-enabled platform solutions.

* Collaborate with executive leadership to identify and prioritize initiatives that improve healthcare outcomes, support value-based care objectives, reduce administrative burden, and strengthen client growth opportunities.

* Work closely with clinical operations, product, technology, data science, analytics, finance, compliance, security, marketing, sales, and client success teams to ensure seamless healthcare program integration and execution.

* Develop and manage program budgets, ensuring efficient resource allocation and cost-effectiveness

* Monitor financial performance against established budgets and implement corrective actions as needed

* Maintain a deep understanding of overall program strategy, delivery status, platform roadmap, regulatory dependencies, data integration needs, reporting requirements, and client commitments.

* Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure the successful implementation of programs

* Monitor external factors that may impact program success, including CMS guidance, payer market trends, interoperability expectations, quality and Stars-related priorities, privacy and security requirements, and evolving client needs, and adapt strategies accordingly.

* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for each program, including operational, financial, clinical, quality, adoption, compliance, and client satisfaction metrics, and regularly assess performance against these measures.

* Prepare and present comprehensive executive reports and client updates that clearly communicate delivery progress, business value, healthcare outcomes, risks, decisions needed, and opportunities for improvement.

* Lead, mentor and oversee a team of program/project managers, coordinators, and other relevant staff

* Cultivate strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, vendors, and partners

* Co-create collateral, presentations, business reviews, and other materials that effectively communicate the value proposition of EXL Health’s care management, case management, analytics, and platform solutions for US healthcare clients.

* Participate in client meetings with account representatives to provide healthcare domain expertise, platform delivery context, analytics-driven insights, and practical interpretation of client needs that build credibility and trust with payer, provider, PBM, life sciences, and government healthcare stakeholders.

* Educate internal teams and customers on solution capabilities, implementation approach, workflow impact, reporting outputs, adoption strategy, and measurable business value.

* Actively partner with customers, vendors/partners, and internal departments—including sales, marketing, client success, solutioning, services, training, support, clinical operations, technology, data, analytics, privacy, and security teams—to translate healthcare problem statements into scalable solutions.

* Measure adoption and utilization of features, products, and services to determine business value for customers and EXL Health, and actively drive increased adoption, workflow optimization, and outcome realization.

  

* Qualifications: 15+ years of experience in program management within US healthcare payer, provider, care management, case management, data and analytics, and/or platform technology organizations, with direct experience overseeing healthcare case management and analytics platforms.

* 15+ years of experience delivering complex healthcare platform solutions, including implementation, integration, adoption, operations, and ongoing client value realization.

* Strong understanding of US healthcare payer, provider, PBM, life sciences, and government program client needs, including Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial lines of business, care coordination, utilization management, quality programs, member and patient engagement, and value-based care.

* Experience managing programs for a diverse US healthcare client base, including health plans, provider organizations, PBMs, healthcare services organizations, and technology-enabled healthcare operations.

* Experience working with healthcare data domains such as claims, eligibility, member, provider, clinical, authorizations, encounters, quality, and financial data, with familiarity in analytics, reporting, interoperability, and data governance expectations.

* Working knowledge of healthcare compliance, privacy, and security expectations relevant to US healthcare clients, including HIPAA, data protection, audit readiness, and secure platform delivery practices.

* Excellent executive communication, client-facing presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage healthcare business, clinical, technology, compliance, and analytics leaders.

* Ability to translate complex healthcare, clinical, operational, technical, and analytical information into clear, actionable terms for executive and operational audiences.

* Experience in working with global, multi-cultural and diverse teams across different time zones

* Experience in sales enablement or a similar role is a plus

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, management, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

* Travel of 25%, more if required pending business objectives.
* + US Citizenship status is required for this role.
  + Must be able to obtain DOD Security Clearance

**Preferred Skills:**

* Detail-oriented with a commitment to delivering high-quality support

* Exceptional client translator who can convert business needs, workflow pain points, and executive input into clear tactical actions for delivery teams.

* Industry-oriented thinker with deep appreciation for payer care management operations, workflow adoption, and how client realities shape solution success.

* Ability to balance healthcare domain expertise, regulatory awareness, client priorities, and practical delivery considerations.

* Team player with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

* Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

* Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering high-quality work

* Easily adapts to a dynamic and fast-paced work environment

* Strong business acumen with the strategic ability to connect healthcare platform delivery to client outcomes, revenue growth, operational efficiency, and long-term partnership value.

The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $180,000 - $250,000 per year.

For more information on benefits and what we offer please visit us at https://www.exlservice.com/us-careers-and-benefits

The posted range is the hiring range for this role — a subset of the broader range available to employees over time — and reflects base salary across our national hiring scale.

Final offers are based on several factors, including the candidate's skills and experience, internal pay equity, work location, market conditions for the role, and the specific scope and responsibilities of the position.

The top of the range is reserved for candidates who notably exceed the requirements; the lower end applies to those with less experience or fewer preferred qualifications. For positions based in higher-cost zones (e.g., California, New York, New Jersey), actual compensation may exceed the posted range; your recruiter will share specifics during the process.

e3d0af2bc33e0548cfb6.description:

**Primary Functions:**

* Manage divisional templates to ensure ease of patient access, provider effectiveness and efficient clinic flow.

* Provide daily administrative support to assigned members of the clinical team; including the Division Chief. Assist in the coordination and support of enterprise/departmental/divisional projects and initiative which further the clinical, educational and research missions of the Department of Pediatrics and its Divisions.

**Essential Functions:**

  + In collaboration with departmental/divisional leadership and divisional providers, develop, build, modify and maintain EPIC templates for assigned providers and specialty programs at all service sites.
  + View and manage provider schedules. Complete steps within EPIC to set single day edits, unavailable times, hold times and clinic cancellations as required.
  + Utilizing EPIC and Qlik reporting tools, assess template effectiveness through the lens of patient access for all appointment types, provider productivity and care center efficiency. Process template revisions as appropriate.

  + Daily, detailed management of administrative and clinical schedule of activities.
  + Coordination of meetings with internal and external participants
  + Ensure alignment between Outlook and Epic schedules.
  + Timely completion of hospital reappointment applications
  + Maintain an accurate accounting of continuing medical education (CME) activity
  + Update and maintain the curriculum vitae (CV) for providers on an ongoing basis.
  + Participate in the development and distribution of monthly divisional on-call schedules. Ensure internal and external partners have accurate on-call information. Enter into Web Exchange.
  + Manage the biweekly and monthly Kronos (timekeeping) and Paid Time off (PTO) process for assigned Department/Division personnel. Maintain time and leave records.

  + Complete associate reimbursement forms, payment requests forms, license renewals, etc. Maintain an accounting of identified expenses. Prepare CME travel request forms; coordinate travel request forms as directed.
  + Physical onsite presence as required by Division.

* Proactively identify problems and opportunities related to divisional operations. Address or refer problems and ideas appropriately.

* The most significant duties and requirements of this job at this time have been included in this position description. Other duties may be assigned as needed. Nemours reserves the right to modify job responsibilities as needed and without notice to meet its business needs.

**Job Requirements:**

High School Diploma required. Associate or bachelor's degree preferred, but will consider equivalent

years’ experience and enrollment in degreed program.

1-3 years of job-related experience required.

**THE JOB**  
Are you a relationship builder who thrives on creative thinking and strategic problem-solving? Do you enjoy the excitement of sales but prefer focusing on advising clients, shaping ideas, and bringing standout merchandise projects to life? As a Creative Project Manager, you will be the entrusted expert on our products and services. You will seize the opportunity to consult with clients on high impact projects that elevate their brand. You’ll push creative boundaries, presenting fresh, innovative merchandise solutions that set both your clients and Kotis apart from the competition. This is a fully remote position.  
  
**WHY YOU'LL LOVE US**

* Remote done right. We’re passionate about face time and your location will never be a barrier to meaningful interactions. Since 2015, we've had fully remote teams and have created a thriving culture around remote team collaboration and camaraderie. We’ll give you all the tech and support to make it easy. We have zero plans to have employees return to an office.
* A culture of flexibility. We want you to love your job and we believe that includes the ability to invest in your passions outside of the workplace.
* Grow your career. We have clearly defined career paths that help support both professional development and pay equity. This includes sales training, interpersonal skills development, and regular pay reviews.
* Office Stipend. $500 yearly office stipend to make your home office magazine worthy.
* Virtual events. Beyond our department meetings, our employees can participate in other virtual events. Departments compete against each other playing Pictionary or Scattegories, answer fun and unique questions in watercoolers, or even participate in chocolate tastings. We hold virtual mindfulness groups where anyone can join.
* PTO. We offer generous Paid Time Off in addition to our culture of flexibility, so you’ll be well rested and relaxed to bring your best self to work.
* Swag. We make amazing swag, and often that comes with sampling our swag to ensure we’ll thrill our clients.

  
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Takes full ownership driving day-to-day operations; planning and overseeing all aspects of your client’s brand strategy, from overseeing project management product pitching and developing timeline, to ensuring a successful project outcome.
* Responsible for fostering and maintaining strong client relationships through effective communication, active listening, a proactive mindset and strategic consultation.
* Prioritize high impact‑ activities, including account strategy, growth and projection planning and sending proactive ideas.
* Keep current on trends to push the creative envelope to showcase ideas that haven’t been done to set your client and Kotis apart from competitors.
* Oversee your own dedicated support assistant who handles non client facing admin tasks, allowing you to focus on driving projects forward, proactive planning, and being a strong creative resource for clients
* Proactively close inbound projects (while earning a monthly bonus) and retain customer revenue while identifying upsell and growth opportunities.
* Work in tandem with your Platform Success Manager to land business and make Kotis the “one stop shop” for all your client’s merchandise.
* Prioritizes a constant stream of high volume, urgent inquiries with a calm demeanor and addresses client concerns and questions promptly.

  
**REQUIREMENTS**

* 5+ years Project Management, Account Management, or Sales experience required.
* Strong PC skills and experience working with Microsoft Office suite required.

0a82059e5a3d990ac784.title: Patient Success Specialist
0a82059e5a3d990ac784.description:
**Patient Success Specialist**
==============================

### **Are You Someone Who Takes Initiative and Gets Things Done?**

**Full-Time | In-Person | Optimal Health**

Some people wait to be told what needs to be done. Others recognize what needs attention, take ownership, and make it happen.

We're looking for the second person.

Optimal Health is a growing chiropractic and physical therapy practice seeking an outgoing, organized, and motivated individual to play an important role in our patient experience.

We're looking for someone who is:

* Naturally personable and great with people.
* Extremely organized and detail-oriented.
* Confident communicating over the phone.
* Comfortable with sales and helping people make decisions.
* Motivated by goals, accountability, and results.
* Proactive, dependable, and willing to take ownership.
* Interested in learning and growing into additional responsibilities.

If you're looking for a job where you sit behind a desk, answer a few phones, and wait for the day to end, this probably isn't for you.

But if you enjoy staying busy, connecting with people, and making things happen, keep reading.

**The Role: Owning the Patient Experience**
-------------------------------------------

Our doctors and physical therapists develop excellent treatment plans, but those plans only work when patients understand their recommendations, stay scheduled, and follow through with their care.

Your job is to help make that happen.

You'll serve as an important connection between our patients, providers, clinical team, and front office. You'll stay on top of patients who need calls, appointments, follow-ups, or additional support.

You'll recognize when someone cancels, stops attending, has questions, or hasn't followed through. Rather than waiting for someone else to address the situation, you'll take the initiative to find a solution.

**What You'll Be Responsible For:**

**Focus Area**

**Key Responsibilities**

  

Patient Relationships

Building rapport and creating a welcoming experience in person and over the phone.

  

Communication

Making daily outbound calls, answering questions, and following up with patients.

  

Patient Engagement

Helping new patients navigate their first visits and understand their treatment plans.

  

Retention & Follow-Up

Reconnecting with patients who cancel, miss appointments, or stop attending.

  

Scheduling & Coordination

Keeping patients appropriately scheduled and coordinating chiropractic and PT care.

  

Problem Solving

Helping patients navigate scheduling, financial, and logistical concerns.

  

Team Communication

Reinforcing provider recommendations and recognizing when questions need to go back to a doctor.

  

Organization

Tracking conversations, follow-ups, and outstanding responsibilities so nothing gets overlooked.

There will be administrative work, phone calls, and scheduling, but those are only tools of the position.

The bigger responsibility is making sure patients feel supported, understand their care, and stay engaged throughout their experience.

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------

Your personality and work ethic matter just as much as your resume.

**You're great with people.** You enjoy meeting new people, starting conversations, remembering names, and making others feel comfortable.

**You're confident on the phone.** You don't avoid conversations or rely on text messages. You're comfortable reaching out to new people and consistently following up.

**You understand sales.** We're not looking for pushy sales tactics. We want someone who listens, asks thoughtful questions, communicates value, and confidently helps people make decisions.

**You're highly organized.** If you tell someone you'll call Tuesday, you call Tuesday. You keep track of responsibilities and don't need constant reminders.

**You're motivated by results.** You enjoy working toward goals, measuring progress, and being held accountable. You see feedback as an opportunity to improve.

**You take ownership.** When something becomes your responsibility, you see it through. You don't just report what you attempted; you understand the situation, communicate what happened, and identify the next step.

We're building detailed training systems for patient communication, follow-up, sales, and treatment plan retention. We'll teach you our processes, but we expect you to be coachable, engaged, and willing to continuously improve.

**No Healthcare Experience? No Problem!**
-----------------------------------------

We're open to candidates from a variety of professional backgrounds.

We can teach you about chiropractic, physical therapy, our services, and how patients move through their care. What's harder to teach is confidence, initiative, curiosity, organization, and the ability to connect with people.

You might come from:

* Sales or business development
* Hospitality or customer service
* Fitness, sports, or wellness
* Recruiting or account management
* Retail
* Healthcare
* Athletics or leadership

**Recent college graduates are absolutely encouraged to apply!**

If you're early in your career but motivated, organized, personable, and eager to learn, we'd love to hear from you.

**Why Optimal Health?**
-----------------------

We're not building an average healthcare office.

Optimal Health brings chiropractic, physical therapy, rehabilitation, and additional treatment options together under one roof. Our providers work as a team to help patients move better, feel better, and stay active.

We're busy, growing, and continuously improving our team and systems.

This position offers the opportunity to:

* Work directly with doctors, therapists, clinical staff, and leadership.
* Take ownership of an important part of the patient experience.
* Develop skills in healthcare, communication, sales, and operations.
* Contribute ideas and help improve how the practice functions.
* Grow into additional responsibilities as the practice expands.

You won't simply be another employee sitting at the front desk. You'll become an important part of how our practice operates and grows.

**Schedule & Compensation**
---------------------------

**Employment Details**

**Information**

  

Position

Patient Experience & Engagement Specialist

  

Employment Type

Full-Time

  

Work Environment

In-Person

  

Compensation

Competitive hourly pay based on experience, ability, and fit

  

Additional Earnings

Performance-based bonuses after successful training and demonstrated competency

**Schedule Expectations:**

Our patient hours include early mornings and evenings, so some flexibility is required.

Certain shifts may extend until approximately 6:00–7:00 PM, but you will not work late every night. Expect a combination of earlier and later shifts based on patient volume and team coverage.

We believe strong performance should create greater opportunities for growth and additional compensation.

**Think You're the Right Person?**
----------------------------------

We don't want another generic resume from someone applying to 50 different jobs.

We want to see how you think, communicate, and approach new challenges.

That's why we're including a short application exercise.

### **The Optimal Health Challenge**

**1. Send Us Your Resume**

Submit your current resume outlining your education, experience, and relevant skills.

**2. Spend 10 Minutes Learning About Us**

Visit **www.optimalhealth.fit** and choose one treatment, technique, or service we offer that you weren't previously familiar with.

In 150 words or less, tell us:

* What is it?
* How would you explain it in simple language to a patient who was nervous or confused?
* Why did you choose that particular service?

**Don't copy our website.** We want to see how YOU communicate and explain new information.

**3. Prove You Read Everything**

At the very bottom of your application, include this exact sentence:

**"I read the whole thing."**

If it's missing, your application won't move forward.

**One Last Thing...**
---------------------

After reading this job description, did you find yourself thinking:

*"I'd crush this."*

Good. That's the kind of person we want to meet.

Complete the challenge and send your resume and responses to:

**jess@optimalhealth.fit**

If we think you could be a great fit, we'll reach out to discuss next steps.

We're looking forward to hearing from you!

**About Mindset Care, Inc.**

**Mindset was founded to create a better experience for those with a mental illness and their caregivers in applying for Social Security Disability benefits.**  
  
**Our team of Social Security Disability lawyers and representatives has helped thousands of individuals through the arduous process of obtaining Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and/or Supplemental Security income (SSI) through the Social Security Administration.**

Mindset is seeking an empathetic, detail-oriented SSD Eligibility Specialist to serve as a trusted first point of contact for prospective clients. This role conducts structured phone assessments, gathers sensitive medical and employment information, explains the Social Security Disability (SSD) intake and application process—including SSI and SSDI—and maintains complete, accurate records. The ideal candidate combines direct SSD or disability-benefits experience with strong client service, sound judgment, organization, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

Due to this being a remote role, you’ll need a reliable internet connection with speeds of at least 100 Mbps download and 30 Mbps upload, a comfortable place to work, and a backup plan for occasional internet outages. We will provide your MacBook as well as a headset, keyboard, and monitor as needed. You will be responsible for maintaining a setup that supports a productive workday. During scheduled working hours, employees must be able to perform the position’s essential duties and meet its attendance, availability, productivity, confidentiality, and performance expectations, subject to approved leave, reasonable accommodations, and applicable law.

Job Responsibilities:

* Conduct structured telephone intake and eligibility assessments to understand each client’s medical, employment, and service needs.
* Collect, verify, and document sensitive client information accurately, completely, and confidentially.
* Explain Mindset’s services and next steps in clear, compassionate language.
* Support clients who may be distressed, overwhelmed, or unfamiliar with the SSI/SSDI process.
* Manage inbound and outbound calls, follow-up tasks, and multiple priorities while meeting quality and productivity expectations.
* Maintain accurate client records in case management, CRM, or related systems.
* Coordinate with case management and other internal teams to ensure a smooth client handoff.
* Follow privacy, security, and documentation requirements.
* Participate in coaching, training, quality review, and team meetings.
* Apply critical thinking to analyze intake information, assess the reported severity of a claimant’s conditions and their impact on daily functioning and ability to work, and identify appropriate follow-up questions.
* All other duties as assigned by the leadership team.

Qualifications:

* Demonstrated experience in intake, phone-based customer service, client support, healthcare, public benefits, case support, or a comparable role.
* Direct experience supporting Social Security Disability (SSD) claims—including SSI and SSDI intake, eligibility screening, medical and work history collection, and application preparation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and a consistent record of accurate documentation.
* Empathy, professionalism, and sound judgment when discussing sensitive medical and financial circumstances.
* Ability to organize follow-up work, multitask, and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to connect medical information to reported functional limitations, identify gaps or inconsistencies, ask appropriate follow-up questions, and explain complex processes in plain language.
* Comfort working independently and reliably in a remote environment.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and the ability to learn new systems.
* Reliable internet connection for remote work.
* High school diploma or equivalent, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**About Empower Community Care**
--------------------------------

Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services. Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years — each advancing outcomes for children, families, and the communities we serve.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Implementation Support Specialist provides cross-model implementation, operational, and customer success support for Functional Family Therapy (FFT), Multisystemic Therapy (MST), and Brief Strategic Family Therapy (BSFT). This position leads assigned provider organizations through onboarding and launch and continues to provide support alongside clinical model staff to ensure sustainability, fidelity, and customer success.  
The Specialist coordinates implementation plans, workforce and referral readiness, technical assistance, project milestones, program monitoring, and partner relationships. The position works collaboratively with EBP model teams, which retain responsibility for model-specific clinical consultation, fidelity coaching, certification, and clinical decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Onboarding and Launch**

* **Provider Onboarding:** Lead assigned providers through onboarding, workforce readiness, launch preparation, and early operations for FFT, MST, and BSFT.
* **Planning and Project Management:** Develop and maintain implementation roadmaps, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and launch-readiness documentation, and coordinate project management and technical assistance to keep launches on time, in scope, and responsive to emerging barriers.
* **Workforce Planning:** Collaborate with recruiting and provider leadership to support staffing plans, candidate sourcing needs, role readiness, and workforce preparation for launch.
* **Readiness Assessment:** Assess readiness related to leadership, staffing, training, service capacity, operational infrastructure, and stakeholder engagement.
* **Referral and Access:** Design and strengthen referral and access processes so appropriate populations can reach available program capacity.
* **Organizational Change:** Support operational and organizational change required to adopt new practices and reduce implementation drift.
* **Launch Coordination:** Coordinate launch logistics with EBP clinical technical assistance teams while maintaining clear boundaries between operational implementation support and model-specific clinical responsibilities.
* **Documentation and Escalation:** Document decisions, risks, action items, and progress; promptly elevate barriers requiring leadership or model-specific expertise.

### **Sustainability and Customer Success**

* **Partner Relationships:** Maintain ongoing relationships with assigned provider organizations through proactive check-ins, account health monitoring, responsive support, and escalation management.
* **Program Monitoring:** Monitor staffing stability, referrals, caseloads, utilization, access, financial sustainability, fidelity indicators, outcomes, and other applicable measures, and identify early warning signals related to vacancies, turnover, capacity, referral volume, access barriers, reimbursement, budget pressures, or renewal risk.
* **Risk Response:** Lead the operational response to implementation risks and coordinate joint problem-solving with EBP clinical leadership when clinical or fidelity action is required, including workforce retention, referral pathway troubleshooting, implementation improvement plans, and other actions that strengthen program viability.
* **Renewal and Expansion:** Coordinate renewal and expansion support, identify opportunities to connect partners with other appropriate organizational offerings, and promote partner satisfaction, retention, high-quality service delivery, and long-term program sustainability.
* **Reporting and Records:** Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and status updates that communicate implementation progress, account health, risks, and outcomes; maintain accurate records and provide regular updates to the Director of EBP Implementation.

### **Cross-Functional Responsibilities**

* **Stakeholder Relationships:** Build collaborative relationships with provider leaders, supervisors, clinicians, funders, referral sources, and community stakeholders while maintaining clear expectations and shared accountability.
* **Facilitation and Training:** Facilitate provider and stakeholder training and/or meetings, including provider implementation training on best practices, timelines, and expectations for successful implementation, with agenda development, documentation, decision-making, and follow-up.
* **Data-Informed Decisions:** Use data to guide implementation decisions, monitor readiness and program health, and support continuous quality improvement.
* **Portfolio Management:** Manage multiple programs, priorities, deadlines, and special projects across the EBP portfolio, and participate in EBP initiatives as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in behavioral health, social work, psychology, public health, human services, business, project management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* **Experience:** At least three (3) years of relevant experience in program implementation, project management, provider support, customer success, behavioral health, or human services, including demonstrated experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, monitoring program performance, and supporting implementation from launch through sustainability.
* **Core Skills:** Strong implementation, project coordination, organization, and time-management skills; excellent written, verbal, facilitation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
* **Change and Data Skills:** Ability to support organizational change, resolve operational barriers, and maintain accountability through a collaborative approach; ability to interpret program and account-health data, identify risks, and translate findings into action.
* **Judgment and Independence:** Sound judgment regarding when to act directly and when to engage clinical, model-specific, funding, recruiting, or leadership partners; ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and provide reliable follow-through.
* **Technology:** Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
* **Work Requirements:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States, reside in the United States, work Eastern Time business hours, and be able to travel up to 50% of the time.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Advanced Degree:** Master’s degree in one of the fields above or a related field.
* **EBP Experience:** Experience with evidence-based or evidence-informed programs, including FFT, MST, BSFT, or another structured evidence-based practice.
* **Subject Knowledge:** Knowledge of evidence-based practices, behavioral health, human services, customer success, or implementation science.

**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------

* **Background Check:** Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law and Empower’s standard hiring practices.
* **Confidentiality:** This role may involve exposure to confidential organizational, financial, and/or clinical program information. The employee must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with Empower’s internal data governance and confidentiality policies.
* **Work Environment:** This is a remote, computer-based position requiring prolonged periods of sitting and extended use of a computer, keyboard, and video-conferencing tools, along with travel of up to approximately 50% of the time for in-person provider onboarding, meetings, leadership offsites, or site visits. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the ADA.
* **Other Duties:** This job description reflects the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

$75,000 – $90,000 per year  
Annual base salary; placement within the range is based on experience, skills, and internal equity.

**Benefits**
------------

*Empower Community Care offers a competitive total-rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings; paid time off and holidays; and life insurance.*

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Empower Community Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
