d610b4d111c183ae5578.title: Commander Coordinator
d610b4d111c183ae5578.description:
### **Company Introduction:**

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

### **Own Driver Engagement in Your Region**

The Commander Coordinator is the person who makes sure Airspace's driver network in a region runs well day to day. Where the Regional Network Manager owns the complete supply picture for the region — strategy, agent partners, and escalation — the Commander Coordinator owns the direct, ongoing relationship with every Commander and Copilot driver in that region: keeping Tier 1 drivers engaged, Tier 2 drivers progressing, and Tier 3 drivers identified and resolved before they affect service.

This is a support role to the Regional Network Manager, not a standalone strategy seat. You are the direct line to drivers — the person they know, trust, and call — and the person your Regional NM depends on to know the true state of the driver pool in the region at any given time.

Like agent support, driver support is a tiered model — attention scales with where a driver sits in the network rather than spreading evenly across the whole population. Tier 1 drivers get high-touch, relationship-driven attention. Tier 2 gets consistent, standard engagement and onboarding support. Tier 3 gets focused attention aimed at surfacing issues early and, once authorized, executing deactivation cleanly. Getting that allocation right is the core judgment call in this role.

### 

### **What You'll Do**

**Tier 1 Drivers (High performers)**

* Provide high-touch support to Tier 1 Commander and Copilot drivers, including regular check-ins to maintain engagement, address concerns, and reinforce performance standards
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Tier 1 drivers in your region

**Tier 2 Drivers (General population & new drivers)**

* Support the general driver population and new drivers through onboarding, ramp guidance, and routine engagement — helping drivers build familiarity with Airspace standards and expectations early
* Monitor Tier 2 performance through automated reporting, flagging drivers trending toward Tier 3 before issues escalate

**Tier 3 Drivers (Performance and conduct — managed out)**

* Identify and surface Tier 3 drivers — those whose behavior, reliability, or conduct warrants removal from the network — using automated reporting and case data
* Execute deactivation motions once authorized by the Regional Network Manager, managing the workflow through Salesforce case management

**General**

* Manage the driver case queue in Salesforce, triaging and routing escalations and maintaining accurate records for your region
* Partner with the Network Trainer to ensure onboarding and ongoing training content is being actioned by drivers in your region, flagging completion gaps by tier
* Support your Regional Network Manager with regional context and data, escalating issues with enough detail to enable a fast decision

**Partner Across the Network Organization**

* Work closely with your Regional Network Manager, who owns the complete supply picture for the region and is your escalation point for anything that exceeds your authority
* Partner with the Driver Recruiter to support onboarding as new drivers activate in your region
* Rely on automated performance reporting — built and maintained by the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations — to monitor driver tiers, flagging anomalies or field-level context back through your Regional NM
* Coordinate with Network Quality & Compliance on documentation standards during periodic audits

  

### **Requirements**

* At least 1-3+ years of experience in driver or contractor engagement, dispatch, account management, or another customer/partner-facing operational role — experience in logistics, transportation, or a gig/contractor network environment is strongly preferred
* Comfortable managing a caseload of drivers with different needs across tiers — high-touch relationship management for top performers, consistent standard engagement for the general population, and clear, unemotional documentation for drivers being managed out
* Strong documentation habits; comfortable owning a case queue in Salesforce or a comparable CRM
* Clear, empathetic communicator, comfortable delivering both positive engagement and difficult feedback
* Based within, or willing to be based within, your assigned region (Pacific Time zone preferred); comfortable with regular local travel to meet drivers in person
* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  

### **Success Metrics**

**2026**

Tier 1 drivers in your region are engaged and retained at a high rate. Tier 2 drivers, including new drivers, are onboarding smoothly and building familiarity with Airspace standards. Tier 3 drivers are identified early and resolved through a clean, well-documented process once authorized. The case queue is current with no aging escalations, and your Regional NM has clear, timely visibility into the state of the driver pool.

**2027**

Your region shows measurable improvement in Tier 1 share of active drivers and in driver retention. Onboarding-to-first-segment time for new drivers is trending down. Your Regional NM relies on your judgment on escalations without needing to double-check the underlying work.

  

### **Your First 90 Days**

Get to know the drivers in your region — who they are, where they sit in the tier structure, and what's currently open in the case queue. Build a working relationship with your Regional Network Manager and establish a clear operating cadence together. Learn the automated reporting tools well enough to trust what they're telling you and to know when field context should override them.

### **Your First 180 Days**

Your regional driver engagement cadence is running consistently across all three tiers. The case queue is clean and current. Your Regional NM sees you as a reliable source of ground truth on the driver pool, and new drivers activating in your region are onboarding smoothly with your support.

  

### **Compensation**

* Hourly pay range: $22-$26/hr
* High-quality health, dental, and vision plan options
* Open PTO
* 401K with company match

### **Core Values:**

* **We are One Team**. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
* **We make an Impact**. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
* **We are Passionate**. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
* **We are Transparent**. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
* **We are Innovative**. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

  

**Airspace is proud** to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations.

**A friendly reminder:** Airspace will only contact candidates from an **@airspace.com** email, a no-reply notification from **no-reply@us.greenhouse-mail.io**, or a verified **LinkedIn profile.** We never request fees or sensitive personal/financial information during recruiting. If something seems suspicious or feels off, please reach out to us at **recruiting@airspace.com** before responding.

  

*For this role the acquisition of recruitment agencies is not appreciated, thank you for your understanding.*

Are you looking for a rewarding and fulfilling position that offers challenging work and the opportunity to make a significant impact while collaborating with a team of fun, innovative individuals? Would you prefer to work with an organization that positively contributes to the world? If so, we would love to hear from you!

  

Are you searching for a rewarding, fulfilling position that offers challenging work and the ability to make a big impact while working side-by-side with a team of fun, innovative people? Ideally, would you like this position to be with an organization that makes a positive contribution to the world? If so…we would love to hear from you!

  
  

**About Us**

University of Phoenix is a leading higher education institution founded in 1976 by Dr. John Sperling. Our mission is to improve the lives of our students, their families and future generations through higher education. Our values (which hopefully you share) are: Brave. Honest. Focused.

  

Our University values and embraces all team members and their unique perspectives. We fundamentally believe in fostering an environment which deeply respects, celebrates, and actively encourages a diverse workforce. We are committed to hiring – and learning from – those who share our passion to help others achieve their educational aspirations.

  

We offer excellent benefits, an effective recognition program, and outstanding learning and development tools, including tuition vouchers for employees and their qualified family members.

**About the Position**

Student Support Specialists (Academic Counselors) work in a fast-paced, home-based virtual office environment to provide academic advisement, coaching, and customer service to students throughout the student lifecycle. Student Support Specialists are available throughout their assigned shift to accept/make student calls and complete work items delivered based on system priority. Student Support Specialists (Academic Counselors) use the University’s coaching model to partner with students, build connections, create action plans, motivate, and resolve student issues. Individuals in this role are the bridge for the student and University administration, ensuring students have access to information, policies, procedures, and requirements they need to make informed decisions. Student Support Specialists are natural problem solvers, on many occasions dealing with student issues that require research, de-escalation, and critical thinking. Individuals in this role must be available throughout their assigned shift to accept/make student calls and complete work items delivered based on system priority.

  
  

IMPORTANT:

You must reside in one of the following states: AZ, ID, NV, NM, MT, UT, TX, WY. You must have fully completed a bachelor's degree prior to applying. This position is expected to start on February 1, 2027.

  
  

About You:

* You are known for your ability to connect with people, building trusting relationships, and like to be someone others can count on.

* You thrive in an environment that is supportive with continuous feedback so you can be extremely helpful to those you connect with.

* You are a careful, analytical, thoughtful decision-maker and you enjoy having clear expectations and an opportunity to develop real expertise in your work.

* You have excellent written and interpersonal communication skills and exceptional organizational skills.

* You are known for being dependable, consistent, and methodical.

  

\*You have fully completed and conferred a bachelor's degree prior to applying\*

  
  

Schedule:

This position is required to start on February 1, 2027.

  
  

* Schedule during the first three months of onboarding is Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm AZ Standard Time. The first 6 weeks of employment are considered the "training period". Attendance is mandatory during the training period for success in this job.

* After the training period, your schedule will be either 9:00am - 6:00pm or 10:00am - 7:00pm (in your time zone), as determined by the needs of your department.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

1. Work full-time shift as scheduled to ensure high-quality service and availability for assigned student population, and to support department service levels and performance goals.

2. Engage in meaningful interactions and develop rapport across a diverse population of students to facilitate their academic progression.

3. Engage in meaningful interactions and develop rapport across a diverse population of students to facilitate their academic progression.

4. Assess student needs using all available tools, including the University’s coaching model and resources, to plan interventions to support student progression.

5. Act as a subject matter expert for students with respect to degree options, program requirements and graduation. Provide students with accurate, complete, and timely information on University policies and procedures.

6. Coordinate with students on all credit options to develop an academic plan that is best suited to their needs and career goals while taking into consideration how to minimize cost and time to graduation.

7. Establish and maintain professional working relationships across internal departments to ensure students benefit from a variety of professional knowledge and perspectives.

8. Recommend changes, share student and other feedback on ways to continuously improve the student experience.

9. Perform other duties as assigned or apparent.

Additional Primary Accountabilities for Academic Counselors not on Written team:

1. Complete an average of at least 3-4 Items Per Hour to include receiving and making phone calls and completing work items delivered systematically.

2. Perform and manage multiple tasks efficiently and effectively to maximize availability for incoming student calls while meeting department standards for productivity and quality.

Additional Primary Accountabilities for Academic Counselors on Written team:

1. Complete an average of at least 7-8 Activities Per Hour to include receiving and responding to chats, emails, and SMS work that is delivered systematically.

2. Perform and manage multiple tasks efficiently and effectively to maximize availability for incoming student inquiries while meeting department standards for productivity and quality.

3. Receive and make phone calls and complete work items delivered systematically per business need.

NOTE: The Primary Accountabilities above are intended to describe the general content and requirements of the position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Incumbents may perform all or most of the Primary Accountabilities listed above. Specific goals or responsibilities will be documented in incumbents’ performance objectives as outlined by the incumbents’ immediate manager.

Job Supervisory Responsibilities

None

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND RELATED WORK EXPERIENCE**:

* Bachelor’s Degree

**ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS**:

* Computer proficient with an ability to learn and navigate various complex proprietary software applications.

* Experience with CRMs, Microsoft applications, video conferencing

* General knowledge of the higher education industry

* General knowledge of fields of study, such as business, education, technology, counseling and/or nursing

* Strong analytical skills to assess and evaluate students’ needs and determine appropriate courses of action.

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to engage and influence students accurately and effectively convey UOPX information.

* Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a team environment or independently.

3ace9175314d1317aca0.description:
Join **W.B. Mason** as a **full-time Business Development Sales Specialist** and build your sales career by helping restaurants, local stores and businesses find the supplies they need every day. Your focus will be selling foodservice supplies, paper and janitorial goods, shipping and packaging materials and anything a business may need -connecting with business owners, understanding their purchasing needs, and winning new customers in your assigned territory. If you've worked in hospitality, retail, or customer service and enjoy meeting people and turning conversations into sales opportunities, this is your chance to grow with a supportive team. No sales experience? **No problem**! We'll train you, coach you, and set you up for success.

**THE CULTURE YOU'LL JOIN:**

At W.B. Mason, we help local businesses keep their operations moving. We sell everyday workplace essentials to businesses of all shapes and sizes. That means pizza boxes and napkins to your local MomPop shop, or school supplies and furniture for the public school system. It means keeping breakrooms across "Masonville" stocked with coffee, water, and everyday essentials, or providing the janitorial supplies that keep businesses fresh and clean. As a privately owned company with over a century of history, we've created an atmosphere where employees feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow. Our sales and delivery teams work together to serve customers and build lasting business relationships. We offer competitive pay, outstanding benefits, and ample growth opportunities. We love promoting from within and celebrating success at every level. If you're looking for a company with strong values, a supportive culture, and real career potential, W.B. Mason is the place for you!

**THE BENEFITS YOU'LL ENJOY:**

* **Pay of $60,000 - $65,000 annually with bonus opportunities**
* Blue Cross Blue Shield Health Plans with a $0 deductible (in-network) for all plans, with various plan designs
* Dental
* Vision
* 401k
* Short and long-term disability
* Company paid life
* Supplemental life
* Flexible spending program
* Medical and dependent care
* Company-paid cell phone plan with unlimited texting, calling, and data, including the option to add a family member for just $55 per month per line
* Paid holidays
* Monthly car allowance (rate depending on geography)
* Contest and vendor incentive earning opportunities

Your future in sales starts here - don't wait, apply today!

**IN THIS BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SALES SPECIALIST ROLE YOU WILL:**

You'll prospect by car and on foot throughout your assigned territory, visiting small stores and local businesses to introduce W.B. Mason's selection of almost anything needed to run a business. You'll connect directly with owners and purchasing decision-makers, learn what they use and how they buy, and identify opportunities to earn their business. Using marketing materials and product demonstrations, you'll explain how our supplies fit their day-to-day needs, offer custom pricing, follow up on opportunities, and turn prospects into new customers. As you uncover their needs, you'll introduce customers to additional products across our broad selection of business supplies. Working closely with our Inside Sales team, you'll convert leads, assist with onboarding, and transition new accounts smoothly to our account managers. This is a full-time, first-shift position with local travel within your assigned territory, and weekly branch sales meetings will keep you connected and supported as you grow your territory and your sales career.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR IN THIS BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SALES SPECIALIST POSITION:**

* Experience in restaurant roles (serving, bartending), retail, customer service, etc.
* Outstanding communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently
* Ability to converse, read, and write in English
* Physical ability to lift/move up to 25 lbs.
* Bachelor's Degree (BS or BA) from a four-year college (preferred)

So, what do you think? If you can meet these requirements and successfully perform the sales job as described above, we would be happy to have you join our team as a Business Development Sales Specialist. **No sales experience needed**. Apply now using our quick, easy, and mobile-friendly initial application!

* At least 1 year of hands on mechanical experience required

* At least 2 years of service department administration preferred

---------------------------------------------

Bachelor's degree (B.A. or B.S.) from four-year college or university in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field is preferred. 2+ years of marketing/proposal experience within architecture, engineering, or construction industries

**Physical and Environmental Conditions**
-----------------------------------------

Work schedules may vary based on business needs, including location, time zone, client schedules, staffing needs, and operational demands. The position may require changes to scheduled start and end times and, where applicable, the number of hours scheduled each day or week.

*While performing the office/offsite duties of this job**, the employee is required to:*

* Operate a computer (up to 100% of workweek)
* Regularly required to use hands.
* Repetitive use of hands/fingers for keyboard interaction (frequently)
* Talk and hear
* Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk and hear.
* Occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* The noise level in the home or company office environment is usually quiet.
* Ability to successfully work from a remote location and report to an office or other work location as required.

Not required.
